paper.title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet ensuring correctness in complex, repository-level tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, which limits their ability to guide implementation and may introduce misleading feedback when the tests themselves are incomplete or incorrect. In this paper, we introduce TDD-Agent, which operationalizes the test-driven development paradigm for code generati

summary.core_problem: 在代码生成任务中，现有的基于测试的方法通常将生成的测试用作事后验证器（post-hoc validators），这限制了测试指导实现的能力，且当测试本身不完整或错误时，会引入误导性反馈。特别是在复杂的仓库级（repository-level）任务中，这种局限性更加明显。
summary.importance: 本文将测试驱动开发（TDD）范式引入 LLM 代码生成，提出 TDD-Agent。这不仅是一种新的 Agent 架构，更展示了“测试先行（test-first）”推理如何作为一种可执行的中间表示，帮助模型在编写代码前明确意图和边界条件，对提升复杂代码生成的正确性有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: TDD-Agent 采用单智能体框架，包含两个阶段：1. 测试设计阶段：Agent 利用工具提取仓库上下文，理解目标函数需求，并生成初始单元测试套件。这一步强制模型在实现逻辑前消除需求歧义并定义行为边界。2. 迭代执行与细化阶段：Agent 基于初始测试生成代码，执行测试并获取反馈。如果测试失败，Agent 可以同时修改代码和测试（dual-track refinement），而不是像以往方法那样将测试视为不可变的约束。
summary.experiments: 在函数级基准（LiveCodeBench）和仓库级基准（RepoEval）上进行了评估。结果表明，TDD-Agent 显著优于基线方法。在 LiveCodeBench 上，轻量级的 TDD-prompt 变体证明了测试先行推理的有效性；在 RepoEval 上，TDD-Agent 框架展示了在需要仓库导航和依赖理解的复杂任务中的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Methodology 部分关于 TDD-Agent 工作流的描述（特别是图 2），理解其如何实现代码和测试的双向迭代细化。此外，实验部分在 RepoEval 上的结果值得关注，这展示了该方法在复杂场景下的潜力。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In code generation tasks, existing test-based approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, limiting their ability to guide implementation and potentially introducing misleading feedback when tests are flawed, especially in complex repository-level tasks.
summary_en.importance: This paper introduces TDD-Agent, operationalizing the Test-Driven Development (TDD) paradigm for LLM code generation. It highlights how "test-first" reasoning serves as an executable intermediate representation, helping models clarify intent and boundary conditions before coding, offering significant insights for improving correctness in complex code generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TDD-Agent employs a single-agent framework with a two-phase workflow: 1. Test Design Phase: The agent uses tools to extract repository context, understand target function requirements, and generate an initial unit test suite, forcing the model to disambiguate requirements and define behavioral boundaries before implementation. 2. Iterative Execution and Refinement Phase: The agent generates code based on initial tests, executes them, and receives feedback. Crucially, if tests fail, the agent can refine both code and tests (dual-track refinement), unlike prior methods that treat tests as immutable constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on function-level (LiveCodeBench) and repository-level (RepoEval) benchmarks. Results show TDD-Agent significantly outperforms baselines. On LiveCodeBench, a lightweight TDD-prompt variant isolates the effect of test-first reasoning; on RepoEval, the full framework demonstrates its advantage in complex tasks requiring repository navigation and dependency understanding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section detailing the TDD-Agent workflow (especially Figure 2) to understand the dual-track refinement of code and tests. The experimental results on RepoEval are also key to grasping the method's potential in complex scenarios. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做代码LLM后训练或Agent的可重点看§3的双轨迭代设计，纯基座预训练研究员仅需知道TDD先验能稳定提分。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on code LLM post-training or agents should focus on the dual-track refinement design in §3; pure pretrain researchers only need to note consistent gains from test-first priors.

paper.title: Edit2TikZ: A Comprehensive and Challenging Benchmark for Scientific Figure Editing with TikZ
paper.abstract: Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown substantial potential in visual understanding and graphic code generation, editing scientific figures through code presents a greater challenge: a model must jointly recover visual structure, ground the requested change, generate compilable code, and preserve all unrelated content. While existing TikZ benchmarks mainly focus on figure reconstruction and generation, few systematically evaluate instruction-guided scientific figure editin

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评测 MLLM 通过 TikZ 代码进行科学图形指令编辑能力的 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 和评测协议。它覆盖视觉结构恢复、编辑请求定位、可编译代码生成和无关内容保持，比单纯 TikZ 重建更接近真实科研图形编辑。对 VLM/code 模型评估有价值，但与基座预训练方法本身距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: Edit2TikZ 包含 1,548 个高质量样本，结合真实世界与受控合成编辑案例。任务支持文本定位请求和视觉定位请求，并包含多步编辑及 step-level annotations。作者还构建了人类对齐的评估框架，用来同时衡量 requested edit 是否完成，以及未被要求修改的内容是否被保留。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出被评估模型列表和数值结果。实验应评测当前 MLLM 在科学图形编辑中的能力，包括视觉理解、TikZ 代码生成、编译成功率、编辑完成度和内容保持。
summary.authors_note: Shanghai Jiao Tong University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on instruction-guided scientific figure editing through TikZ code.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. It tests visual-structure recovery, edit grounding, compilable code generation, and preservation of unrelated content, going beyond existing TikZ reconstruction tasks. It is useful for VLM and code-model evaluation, but it is not directly about foundation-model pretraining methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Edit2TikZ contains 1,548 high-quality samples combining real-world and controlled synthetic edit cases. It supports both textual and visual localization requests, includes multi-step editing, and provides step-level annotations. The evaluation framework is designed to be human-aligned, measuring both whether the requested edit is completed and whether irrelevant content is preserved.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the full model list or numerical results. The evaluation likely covers current MLLMs on visual understanding, TikZ code generation, compilation success, edit completion, and preservation of unedited content.
summary_en.authors_note: Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM-code 评测资产知道即可；任务很细，除非关心图形代码生成，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Good to know as a VLM-code evaluation asset; the task is narrow, so skip the full paper unless figure-code generation matters.

paper.title: Do Influence Tactics Matter? Investigating Prompt Framing Effects in LLM Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software engineering workflows, helping developers write, debug, test, and maintain code. While prompt wording and structure are known to influence model performance, the impact of psychologically inspired prompt framings remains unexplored. This study investigates whether different psychology-based communication strategies that humans use to persuade or motivate others can lead to more effective prompt framing, which may, in turn, af

summary.core_problem: 心理学启发的prompt框架（人类说服/激励策略）对LLM代码生成行为的影响尚未被系统研究。
summary.importance: 首次将Yukl & Falbe的影响策略分类用于prompt设计，属于模型行为分析类的增量研究。
summary.technical_approach: 将8种心理学影响策略（如理性说服、讨好、交换）操作化为可复现的prompt模板，在5个主流开源LLM上用LiveCodeBench和SWE-bench Verified两个基准测试，从功能正确性、质量、可维护性等四个维度评估代码输出。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体量化效果数据，仅说明覆盖5个开源LLM和2个代码基准。

summary_en.core_problem: The impact of psychologically inspired prompt framings (human persuasion/motivation strategies) on LLM code generation behavior remains unexplored.
summary_en.importance: First to apply Yukl & Falbe's influence tactics taxonomy to prompt design, an incremental study in model behavior analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Operationalizes eight psychological influence tactics (e.g., rational persuasion, ingratiation, exchange) into reproducible prompt templates; evaluates across five leading open-weight LLMs using LiveCodeBench and SWE-bench Verified, assessing code output on four software quality dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative results provided in the abstract; only notes coverage of 5 open LLMs and 2 code benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 纯prompt措辞效果的实证研究，无预训练或建模方法创新，结论偏应用层技巧，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Empirical study of prompt wording effects with no pretraining or modeling innovation; conclusions are application-level tricks; read abstract only.

paper.title: WebGrader: Training LLMs for Web Development with Self-Evolving Programmatic Grader
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly generate complete websites from natural-language descriptions, and reinforcement learning has become a central approach to closing their remaining functional gap. This training regime is bottlenecked by reward design. Hand-authored browser scripts are executable yet costly to write for open-ended requirements, while VLM and GUI-agent graders scale but may issue verdicts before observing the decisive state. We propose WebGrader, a self-evolving programmatic grad

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 web 开发 RL 的 reward 构造问题。自然语言网站需求通常没有配套的浏览器交互脚本和状态断言，人工写测试成本高，VLM/GUI grader 又可能在没有观察到关键状态前给出判断。WebGrader 试图把开放式网站需求自动转成可执行、可复放、带证据的浏览器测试，用作 RL reward。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 与可验证训练信号有参考价值。它讨论的是如何为复杂代码生成任务构造程序化 reward，而不是依赖单步文本判分或截图判分。这个方向和 GRPO、代码 RL、verifiable reward 的接口有关。启发点在于：当任务输出是交互式程序时，reward 需要先生成“交互流”和“状态证据”，再判定行为是否满足需求。这个思路可以迁移到更一般的软件工程 agent、工具使用和长程交互任务，但论文主要落在 web development，不应放大为通用基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: WebGrader 的核心是 executable reward construction。系统先从用户需求中推导 required interaction flows，并表示成 Flow Contract。随后把模型生成的 React/Vite 项目在真实浏览器中构建、启动和渲染，用源代码、live DOM、视觉状态、网络响应和持久化状态来 grounding 动作与断言。执行层使用 Playwright 生成可复放的 browser program，逐个 flow 收集证据并给出 reward。为了改进 grader，作者构建 WebGen-Verifier-100：每个干净应用配受控的源代码级单故障变体，让 verifier 的错误可以被量化。离线演化过程会把 residual 归因到 planning、grounding、evidence 或 judgment 等阶段，只对对应 skill 做 mutation；候选 skill 需要在隔离验证页面上提升表现才会被 promoted。最终技能被组织成带依赖、组合和冲突关系的 SkillGraph，并在 RL 前冻结。RL 阶段用冻结的 WebGrader 给 8B policy 提供功能性 reward，训练算法为 GRPO。
summary.experiments: 数据构建上，WebGen-Verifier-100 使用 100 个 public WebGen-Instruct 训练查询，覆盖 10 类应用。每个查询配一个本地验证过的 clean React/Vite 应用，并从每个 clean app 生成 8 个自然的源代码级单故障变体。800 个候选故障中保留 778 个 active variants。页面级划分为 60/20/20 的 Train/Eval/Test，分别包含 461/157/160 个 active faults 和 282/95/93 个 active flows；clean app、变体和私有 reference 不跨 split。Train 用于 residual induction 和 mutation，Eval 用于候选提升，Test 只用于报告 verifier 结果。模型训练结果中，WebGrader 训练的 8B policy 相比 matched appearance-plus-script reward 提升 7.88 FSR points，并在 WebGen-Bench 和 WG-core-250 上超过 o4-mini 与 DeepSeek-v4-flash。由于提供内容没有完整表格和消融细节，具体成功率、误判类型分布和 SkillGraph 各模块贡献需要回到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。优先看 Method 中 Flow Contract 的定义、Playwright 执行证据的收集方式、residual attribution 到 skill mutation 的流程。其次看 WebGen-Verifier-100 的构造细节，因为 reward 论文的可信度很大程度取决于 verifier 自身有没有干净的验证环境。实验部分重点找三类表：grader 在 clean/faulty paired sites 上的识别能力、SkillGraph 演化前后的提升、GRPO 训练后 8B policy 在 WebGen-Bench 与 WG-core-250 上的 FSR。对 LLM 基座研究员来说，最值得带走的是“先训练或演化 reward constructor，再冻结用于 RL”的流程，而不是 web 领域本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets reward construction for RL in web development. Open-ended website requests describe UI behavior, navigation, forms, and persistence, but they do not provide executable browser actions or state assertions. Manual scripts are precise but expensive, while VLM or GUI-agent graders may judge without reaching the decisive state. WebGrader turns requirements and generated projects into replayable browser tests with execution evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to the pretrain-to-posttrain interface around verifiable rewards. The main lesson is that for interactive program generation, a reward cannot be a single text score or a screenshot-level judgment. It needs to construct interaction flows, execute them in the real environment, collect state evidence, and then judge behavior. That pattern is useful for code RL, software agents, and long-horizon tool-use training. The scope remains web development, so the result should be treated as a domain-specific reward-construction study rather than a general foundation-model training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: WebGrader frames the problem as executable reward construction. Given a website requirement, it derives required interaction flows and represents them as Flow Contracts. It then materializes the generated React/Vite project in a live browser, grounds target actions against the source code and DOM, and executes Playwright programs. During execution it collects visual evidence, DOM states, network responses, and persistent-state observations, which are used for per-flow judgments. The grader is improved before RL through an offline self-evolution loop. The authors build a controlled environment with clean applications and source-level single-fault variants, run a base verifier, attribute residual errors to stages such as planning, grounding, evidence collection, or judgment, and mutate only the corresponding skills. Promoted skills are organized in a SkillGraph with dependency, composition, and conflict relations. This SkillGraph is frozen before policy training, where WebGrader supplies functional rewards for GRPO training of an 8B policy.
summary_en.experiments: The verifier environment, WebGen-Verifier-100, contains 100 public WebGen-Instruct training queries across 10 application categories. Each query is paired with a locally verified clean React/Vite application. From each clean application, the authors create eight natural source-level single-fault variants by modifying localized business logic. Out of 800 materialized faults, 778 remain active. The page-level split is 60/20/20 for Train/Eval/Test, with 461/157/160 active faults and 282/95/93 active flows. Clean applications, their variants, and private references do not cross splits. Train is used for residual induction and mutation, Eval for candidate promotion, and Test only for reported verifier evaluation. For policy training, the WebGrader-trained 8B model improves over a matched appearance-plus-script reward by 7.88 FSR points and outperforms o4-mini and DeepSeek-v4-flash on WebGen-Bench and WG-core-250. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact verifier precision, failure modes, and per-skill ablations should be checked in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Read the method sections on Flow Contracts, Playwright execution, evidence collection, and residual attribution. The construction of WebGen-Verifier-100 is important because the reliability of the reward depends on how cleanly the verifier itself is measured. In the experiments, look for three tables: verifier accuracy on paired clean and faulty sites, improvements from SkillGraph evolution, and GRPO-trained policy results on WebGen-Bench and WG-core-250. For foundation-model training readers, the transferable idea is the two-stage pipeline: first improve and freeze a reward constructor, then use it as a verifiable reward source for RL.

recommendation.zh: 读 verifier skill 自演化和错误奖励分析；若 reward hacking 控得住，可借鉴到代码 RLVR。
recommendation.en: Read the self-evolving verifier-skill loop and reward-error analysis; if reward hacking is controlled, the idea transfers to code RLVR.

paper.title: COMPAS: Difficulty-Aware Joint Search for Optimizing Code Generation
paper.abstract: Code generation systems make each LLM call with a model, a prompt, and decoding settings. However, existing optimization methods usually tune only part of these choices or use one fixed configuration for all tasks: global optimizers search one configuration for all tasks, routers choose only a model, and prompt optimizers keep the model and decoding settings fixed. This leaves their joint, group-specific interactions unclear. We therefore examine how these choices interact and observe that promp

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成优化仅单独调整模型、prompt或解码配置，未考虑三者交互效应与任务难度差异，导致全局次优的质量-成本 trade-off。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次联合优化代码生成的模型选择、prompt设计、解码策略三个维度，引入任务难度感知的分组路由机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出COMPAS框架：先通过低成本模型筛选+联合搜索prompt-解码配置，学习不同难度任务组的质量-成本前沿；测试时按任务难度直接路由到对应前沿，无需额外搜索开销。
summary.experiments: 在匹配搜索预算的代码生成基准（摘要未明确具体数据集）上开展对比，验证联合搜索+难度路由的效果优于全局单配置、仅模型路由等基线。
summary.authors_note: 含知名软件工程与AI交叉学者Mark Harman，团队长期从事代码智能与LLM推理优化研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code generation optimization methods only tune model, prompt, or decoding settings in isolation, ignoring their interactions and task difficulty differences, leading to suboptimal quality-cost trade-offs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: the first work to jointly optimize model selection, prompt design, and decoding strategy for code generation, with a difficulty-aware group routing mechanism.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes COMPAS: first learns quality-cost fronts for different difficulty task groups via low-cost model selection and joint prompt-decoding search; then routes test tasks to matching fronts online with no extra search cost.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on code generation benchmarks under matched search budgets (specific datasets not disclosed in abstract), outperforming baselines like global single-configuration tuning and model-only routing.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Mark Harman, a well-known researcher in SE-AI intersection; the team has long worked on code intelligence and LLM inference optimization

recommendation.zh: 代码生成推理侧配置优化的增量工作，仅需看方法部分的多维度交互分析结论，无需复现。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on joint inference configuration optimization for code generation; only the multi-dimensional interaction analysis in the method section merits attention, no reproduction needed.

paper.title: ExeCRE: Execution-Consistency Guided Reliability Estimation for Self-Correcting Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made notable progress in code generation, but they still struggle on challenging tasks that require sophisticated algorithms or complex implementations. Recent methods increasingly use code execution as feedback, especially in self-correction pipelines that construct verification signals from generated code. However, these pipelines often depend on supervision signals whose reliability is unknown, which can introduce misleading feedback, unnecessary revisions, a

summary.core_problem: 现有自纠错代码生成依赖测试用例或LLM反馈作为监督信号，但这些信号可靠性未知，易引入误导反馈、无效修订与错误结果。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需标注测试用例或LLM打分的代码可靠性估计范式，基于执行一致性统计推断代码正确性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ExeCRE框架：对候选代码生成大量随机输入，收集执行输出并投影为一致性信号，再用Dawid-Skene模型推断潜在的代码可靠性，用于引导自纠错流程的修订决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体基准数据集与量化结果，仅提及相比依赖测试用例/LLM反馈的基线，可减少误导反馈，提升自纠错后代码的最终正确率。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-correcting code generation pipelines rely on test cases or LLM feedback as supervision signals, but the reliability of these signals is unknown, easily leading to misleading feedback, unnecessary revisions, and incorrect final outputs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a code reliability estimation paradigm without labeled test cases or LLM scoring, based on execution consistency statistics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ExeCRE framework: generates a large number of random inputs for candidate code, collects execution outputs and projects them into consistency signals, then infers latent code reliability via the Dawid-Skene model to guide revision decisions in self-correction pipelines.
summary_en.experiments: Specific benchmark datasets and quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract; it only mentions reduced misleading feedback and higher final code accuracy after self-correction compared to baselines relying on test cases/LLM feedback.

recommendation.zh: 代码自纠错监督信号的增量改进，仅需看§3的执行一致性统计与Dawid-Skene可靠性推断部分，无需复现。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for self-correcting code generation supervision; only §3 execution consistency statistics and Dawid-Skene reliability inference are worth a look, no reproduction needed.

paper.title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a frame

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮代码生成代理中训练目标与真实交互不一致的问题：模型需要根据执行反馈修复代码，但常规 RL 主要优化单轮最终结果。
summary.importance: 这是代码代理后训练方法的增量改进。价值在于把 execution feedback 转成逐轮 dense reward，并用一致的多轮协议衡量 self-repair，而不是只看初始生成能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Test-aware Policy Refinement，使用每轮测试通过率作为 dense reward，在多轮代码生成和修复过程中持续给策略反馈。方法重点不是新模型架构，而是 reward 设计和训练/评测协议对齐。
summary.experiments: 在 LiveCodeBench 的 219 个代码生成问题上，跨 6 个模型评估。TaPR 将 pooled 三轮成功率 Pass@3 提升 2.44 个百分点；在预定义的 7B/8B high-headroom 子集上，pooled accuracy 从 30.25% 提升到 33.56%，提升 3.31 个百分点，并报告 42 个 paired improvements 和 13 个 regressions。摘要还提到对 Qwen3-8B 做了 dense reward ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch in multi-turn code agents: the policy is expected to repair code from execution feedback, while standard RL often optimizes single-shot outcome rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental but relevant post-training method for coding agents. Its main value is converting execution feedback into dense per-turn rewards and evaluating actual self-repair behavior under a consistent interaction protocol.
summary_en.technical_approach: TaPR uses per-turn test-pass ratio as a dense reward during feedback-conditioned code generation. The contribution is not a new architecture, but a reward design and protocol that better align training with multi-turn repair.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on 219 LiveCodeBench code-generation problems across six models. TaPR improves pooled three-turn Pass@3 by 2.44 percentage points. On a predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy rises from 30.25% to 33.56%, a 3.31-point gain, with 42 paired improvements and 13 regressions. The abstract also mentions a matched Qwen3-8B dense-reward ablation.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和 reward 设计即可；提升不大，但它把“会修复”从单轮 pass rate 里拆出来，这点干净。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and reward design; the gains are modest, but separating repair ability from one-shot pass rate is the useful part.

paper.title: Distilling Reasoning Traces into Advisory Prompts for Software Engineering Tasks
paper.abstract: Language models are widely used for generating and otherwise processing code (e.g., identifying code hallucinations, possible inputs, or predicting outputs); however, LLMs can make mistakes, which can be serious. One key issue is that models are trained on (still) largely human-written, and thus imperfect, code; it's not easy to find sufficiently large code corpora that are entirely free of bugs. Thus, other inference-time ways of reducing LLM errors, without additional training, are desirable.

summary.core_problem: 研究能否把 reasoning mode 产生的错误分析和反思压缩成 advisory prompts，从而在软件工程任务上减少错误而不总是支付推理开销。
summary.importance: 贡献是代码任务中的 inference-time prompting 策略，试图把昂贵 reasoning traces 转化为可复用的轻量提示。它对后训练和推理时计算分配有轻微信号，但不是预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法模拟人类学习编程错误的过程：先识别 LLM 在代码相关任务中的错误，再使用 reasoning/thinking mode 反思导致错误的认知失误，抽取通用规则或 lesson，最后把这些规则作为 advisory prompts 注入后续非 reasoning 推理。整体更像提示蒸馏，而不是参数蒸馏或 SFT。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到面向代码生成、代码幻觉识别、输入推断、输出预测等软件工程任务，目标是在不开启完整 reasoning 的情况下改善表现；未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 数值、成本下降比例或统计显著性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether reasoning-mode traces can be compressed into advisory prompts that reduce errors on software-engineering tasks without always paying the cost of reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time prompting strategy for code tasks. It turns expensive reasoning traces into reusable lightweight guidance. It is mildly relevant to post-training and test-time compute allocation, but it is not a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method mimics how programming students learn from mistakes: identify model errors, use reasoning mode to reflect on the cognitive lapses behind them, infer general rules or lessons, and inject those lessons as advisory prompts during later non-reasoning inference. This is closer to prompt distillation than parameter distillation or SFT.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract discusses software-engineering tasks such as code generation, code-hallucination identification, input inference, and output prediction. It aims to improve performance without full reasoning mode, but does not provide model names, dataset sizes, baseline numbers, cost reductions, or significance tests in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 reasoning trace 压缩成提示的弱信号保留；若正文没有成本-质量曲线，就不值得细读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a weak signal on compressing reasoning traces into prompts; without a cost-quality curve, it is not worth a close read.

paper.title: Effective and Efficient Context Retrieval via Partial Dependency Graph for Repository-Level Code Generation
paper.abstract: LLM-based repository-level code generation aims to generate code using the context available in a software repository, requiring LLMs to reason over complex code dependencies. Due to limited context windows and insufficient repository-specific understanding, LLMs typically rely on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to incorporate relevant code. Early RAG approaches primarily employ similarity-based retrieval, which often fails to retrieve code snippets that the target function depends on. Rece

summary.core_problem: 仓库级代码生成需要检索目标函数依赖的代码片段，现有相似度检索无法有效捕捉依赖关系，静态图检索依赖人工规则与全局图，灵活性差且构建维护成本高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，受人类开发者上下文收集行为启发，提出动态部分依赖图的检索范式，提升仓库级代码检索的效率与准确性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DyRetriever方法，通过动态构建部分依赖图，迭代式地沿依赖关系检索相关代码上下文，避免静态全局图的高成本与不灵活性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验设置与量化结果，仅介绍了方法的设计思路与核心动机。

summary_en.core_problem: Repository-level code generation requires retrieving code snippets that the target function depends on; existing similarity-based retrieval fails to capture dependencies, and static graph-based retrieval relies on manual rules with high construction and maintenance costs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a dynamic partial dependency graph retrieval paradigm inspired by human developers' context collection behavior, improving efficiency and accuracy of repository-level code retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DyRetriever, which dynamically constructs partial dependency graphs and iteratively retrieves relevant code context along dependency relations, avoiding the high cost and inflexibility of static global graphs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not fully disclose experimental settings or quantitative results, only introduces the design motivation and core idea of the method.

recommendation.zh: 代码仓库RAG的增量改进，核心是检索策略优化，对LLM基座预训练无直接启发，仅做领域常识了解即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to code repository RAG focused on retrieval strategy optimization, no direct insight for LLM base pretraining, only for domain awareness.

paper.title: RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks,

summary.core_problem: 代码模型的执行反馈训练大多只用到正确性信号，忽略了运行时性能；而直接把 runtime 作为 reward 又很脆弱——只有在程序正确时才有意义，跨任务量纲不一致，且当一组 rollout 全部失败时 GRPO 拿不到任何有效排序。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train 范畴的 RL 奖励设计工作，对预训练研究的间接启发在于：把稀疏、异质、依赖前置条件的执行信号拆成分阶段 reward，是一种可迁移的 reward shaping 思路；对关心 RLVR、代码 RL、可验证奖励设计的研究者有参考价值，但不触及基座预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RLPF，用 GRPO 训练代码 agent。reward 分两段：失败段按执行管线进度排序（可抽取 → 可编译 → 可执行 → 通过 oracle），给失败样本提供 progress 信号；成功段按相对性能排序，用 (baseline_runtime − candidate_runtime)/(baseline_runtime − reference_runtime) 衡量候选实现相对 baseline 与专家参考的性能差距闭合比例，从而把不同任务的 runtime 归一化到可比尺度。
summary.experiments: 在 PerfCodeBench 的 family-disjoint 测试集上，基于 Qwen3-32B，correct-and-runnable 率从 11.1% 提升到 54.6%，CGRE 从 8.1% 提升到 38.6%；多数正确输出同时快于 baseline。在 EffiBench-X 上有一定迁移。消融显示完整 staged reward 优于 correctness-only 和 runtime-only；用 GPT-5.4 生成的性能参考有帮助但稳定性不如人工专家实现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 reward 公式与两段式设计的衔接逻辑，以及 GRPO 在全失败组场景下的处理；消融表和 EffiBench-X 迁移结果可快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Execution-feedback training for code models mostly stops at correctness, ignoring runtime; yet using runtime directly as a reward is fragile—it is only meaningful after correctness, has task-dependent scale, and provides no useful ordering under GRPO when an entire group of rollouts fails.
summary_en.importance: A post-training RL reward-design paper. Its indirect relevance to pretraining research is the staged shaping of a sparse, heterogeneous, precondition-dependent execution signal into a comparable reward—a pattern transferable to RLVR and verifiable-reward design. It does not touch base-model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: RLPF trains a code agent with GRPO using a two-regime reward. In the failure regime, rollouts are ordered by progress through the execution pipeline (extractable → compilable → runnable → oracle-passing), giving partial credit before correctness. In the success regime, correct programs are ranked by relative performance: (baseline_runtime − candidate_runtime)/(baseline_runtime − reference_runtime), normalizing runtime across tasks against a task-specific baseline and an expert reference.
summary_en.experiments: On the family-disjoint split of PerfCodeBench, Qwen3-32B improves correct-and-runnable rate from 11.1% to 54.6% and CGRE from 8.1% to 38.6%; most correct outputs also beat the baseline. Modest transfer to EffiBench-X. Ablations show the full staged reward beats correctness-only and runtime-only variants; GPT-5.4-generated performance references help but are less stable than curated expert references.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the reward formulas and how the two regimes connect, plus the handling of all-failure groups under GRPO. The ablation table and EffiBench-X transfer results can be scanned quickly.

recommendation.zh: 将代码执行效率引入 RL 奖励函数，设计了分阶段的 reward 机制解决 runtime reward 稀疏和脆弱的问题，对做 Code RL 和后训练对齐的研究员有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Introduces code execution efficiency into the RL reward function, designing a staged reward mechanism to solve the sparsity and fragility of runtime rewards. Valuable reference for researchers working on Code RL and post-training alignment.

paper.title: Try Again, Don't Look Back: Blind Resampling Outperforms Self-Repair in Small Code Models
paper.abstract: Self-repair - returning a failed program to the model together with its test output and asking for a correction - is a standard component of code agents, and is almost always evaluated against a baseline that does not retry at all. We argue that this comparison confounds the value of the feedback with the value of the extra attempt. Using a placebo-controlled design on MBPP+ at three model scales (1.5B, 3B, 7B), we compare four matched-budget retry conditions: blind resampling, a content-free fa

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的问题很具体：代码模型自修复到底是在利用执行反馈，还是只是在多试一次。已有代码 Agent 往往把“失败程序 + 测试输出 + 请修正”与单次生成比较，这会把反馈价值和额外采样机会混在一起。论文用安慰剂对照把两者拆开，发现小模型里真正有效的是重新采样，而不是看回自己的失败答案。
summary.importance: 对基座和代码模型研究的价值主要在评测方法和训练信号理解。它提醒代码自修复、反思、执行反馈这类能力不能只和 single-shot 比；必须和同预算的 blind resampling 比。否则会高估反馈闭环的作用。对预训练和后训练接口也有直接启发：如果训练数据里大量包含“错误答案 + 修正”的轨迹，小模型可能学到局部编辑和锚定，而不是学会真正利用错误信号。论文的贡献不是提出新的训练 recipe，而是给自修复范式做了一个干净的因果拆解，量级上属于方法论层面的强证据。
summary.technical_approach: 实验设计的关键是把失败后的第二步拆成四个同预算条件。resample 只保留原始题目并重新采样，用来测“多试一次”的价值；placebo 给模型看失败程序和一个无内容的错误通知，用来测“看回自己失败输出”的影响；feedback 再加入真实执行反馈，包括失败输入、期望输出和实际输出，用来测诊断信息的增益；reflect 在 feedback 前要求模型先用自然语言诊断，再重写代码，用来测显式反思是否能绕开锚定。四个条件除后缀内容外保持一致。重试阶段都用 temperature 0.8；作者明确指出 greedy decoding 会反复生成字节级相同程序，因此不能用于评估重采样。每个任务最多 k=8 次尝试，并从同一条轨迹读取不同 k 下的 pass@1。统计上使用 McNemar exact test 做配对比较，bootstrap 给任务级差异区间，Holm correction 控制多重检验。机制分析集中在 anchoring：包含失败程序的 prompt 会让下一次生成更像上一次失败程序，模型倾向做局部修改，而 blind resampling 可以跳到解空间的其他区域。
summary.experiments: 主实验使用 Qwen2.5-Coder Instruct 的 1.5B、3B、7B 三个规模，量化为 Q4_K_M，本地单张 6GB 消费级 GPU 运行。主 benchmark 是 MBPP+ 的 378 个任务；HumanEval+ 的 164 个任务作为次要结果，但作者说明其失败样本量较小，只有每个 cell 约 32–75 个失败任务，而 MBPP+ 是 110–164 个，因此统计功效不足。核心结果是：在 1.5B 和 3B 上，blind resampling 的 pass rate 最高；在 7B 上，它与最佳条件统计上打平。执行反馈本身没有可检测收益：feedback 相对 placebo 的差异在 1.5B、3B、7B 分别为 +0.000、+0.026、+0.008，均不显著。看回失败程序反而有害：placebo 相对 resample 在 1.5B 上为 -0.061，p=0.006；在 3B 上为 -0.069，p<0.001。摘要还报告 blind resampling 在 token 开销上比自修复条件少 2.5–5.5 倍。反思条件能减弱锚定，但没有带来足以抵消成本的收益。作者还做了两个重要排除：检索其他任务经验的空结果说明问题不是长 prompt 本身导致；复制实验排除了量化和模型家族作为主要解释，并显示惩罚幅度与基线能力有关。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Method、Retrying Beats Repairing 和 anchoring 机制分析部分。Introduction 给出最重要的因果拆解：single-shot 对照不够，必须用 blind resampling 做 placebo。Method 值得细看，因为这里的实验控制比很多 Agent 论文更扎实，尤其是四个条件的定义、temperature 选择、共享轨迹读取 k≤8 的做法，以及 McNemar 配对检验。结果表和 Figure 1/2 是核心证据，重点看 resample、placebo、feedback 的相对顺序，而不是只看最终 pass rate。机制部分建议关注文本相似度如何解释不同条件排序；这对构造自修复训练数据、反思数据和执行反馈数据都有参考意义。可进一步深挖的问题是：更强模型、非 MBPP 类任务、更复杂测试反馈、以及训练过 repair trace 的模型是否仍存在同样锚定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: does code self-repair work because the model uses execution feedback, or because it simply gets another stochastic attempt? Prior evaluations usually compare repair loops against single-shot generation, which conflates feedback with persistence. This work introduces a placebo-controlled comparison and shows that, for small code models, asking again without showing the failed program is better than self-repair.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological and diagnostic. It shows that self-repair, reflection, and execution-feedback loops should be compared against budget-matched blind resampling, not against one-shot decoding. Otherwise the effect of feedback is overestimated. For pretraining and post-training work on code models, the implication is concrete: traces of the form “failed solution plus correction” may teach small models to anchor on bad local edits rather than to use error signals. The paper is not a new pretraining method, but it gives strong evidence about the quality of a common training and evaluation signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The design decomposes the repair packet into four retry conditions with matched budgets. In resample, the model sees only the original prompt again. In placebo, it sees its failed program plus a content-free notice that it was wrong. In feedback, it also receives the actual failing input, expected output, and observed output. In reflect, it is asked to diagnose the failure in prose before rewriting the code. This separates the value of another draw, self-exposure, diagnostic feedback, and verbal reflection. Retry attempts use temperature 0.8; the authors explicitly avoid greedy retry because it would return byte-identical programs and make resampling meaningless. Each trajectory allows up to k=8 attempts, and pass@1 for all k≤8 is read from the same trajectory. Paired contrasts are tested with exact McNemar tests, task-level bootstrap intervals, and Holm correction. The proposed mechanism is anchoring: once the failed program is in the context, the next sample tends to stay near it and perform local edits, while blind resampling can explore a different region of the solution space.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen2.5-Coder Instruct at 1.5B, 3B, and 7B, quantized as Q4_K_M and run locally on a single 6GB consumer GPU. MBPP+ with 378 tasks is the primary benchmark. HumanEval+ with 164 tasks is secondary and is treated as underpowered because each cell has only about 32–75 failing tasks, compared with 110–164 on MBPP+. On MBPP+, blind resampling reaches the highest pass rate at 1.5B and 3B, and is statistically tied with the best condition at 7B. The diagnostic content of execution feedback is not detectable: feedback minus placebo is +0.000, +0.026, and +0.008 across the three model sizes, with no significant effect. Self-exposure is harmful at smaller scales: placebo minus resample is -0.061 at 1.5B with p=0.006, and -0.069 at 3B with p<0.001. The abstract also reports that blind resampling uses 2.5–5.5 times fewer tokens than self-repair-style conditions. Reflection weakens the anchor but does not pay for itself. Additional checks rule out prompt length, quantization, and model family as sufficient explanations, and suggest that the penalty is governed by baseline model capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction, Method, the main result section on retrying versus repairing, and the anchoring analysis closely. The Introduction contains the key causal argument: single-shot baselines are not enough. The Method section is unusually important because the treatment definitions, temperature choice, shared retry trajectories, and paired statistical tests determine whether the comparison is fair. In the result tables and Figure 1/2, focus on the ordering of resample, placebo, and feedback, not just the endpoint pass rates. The anchoring section is the part most relevant to training-data design: it explains why failed-solution-conditioned traces can become a liability for small models. Useful follow-up questions include whether the pattern holds for stronger models, harder programming tasks, richer execution traces, and models explicitly trained on repair trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 非常干净的 ablation study，揭示了小模型在 self-repair 时的 anchoring 现象，证明了 blind resampling 的高性价比，直接改变了对代码 Agent 重试策略的 prior 认知。
recommendation.en: A very clean ablation study revealing the anchoring effect in small models during self-repair, proving the high cost-effectiveness of blind resampling, and directly challenging the prior understanding of retry strategies in code agents.

paper.title: Beyond "What to Retrieve": Uncertainty in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
paper.abstract: Repository-level code generation relies on heterogeneous evidence whose relevance, compatibility, and completeness are inherently uncertain. Similar-code examples, repository context, and project-specific APIs may provide complementary information, but can also introduce noisy, redundant, or conflicting signals. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches primarily optimize retrieval relevance without explicitly modeling how uncertainty in retrieved evidence affects downstream generation. We introdu

summary.core_problem: 现有检索增强代码生成方法仅优化检索相关性，未显式建模异构检索证据的不确定性对下游生成的影响。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出不确定性感知的检索增强代码生成框架，首次通过因子分析揭示不同证据源间存在显著交互效应，无通用加性排序。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OpenCoder框架，估计不同来源证据的不确定性，用于过滤和排序异构证据，并指导生成、验证和修复流程；通过因子分析拆解API知识、仓库上下文、相似代码三类证据的交互作用。
summary.experiments: 在扩展的32任务RepoExec-inline评测上验证，基于GPT的基线取得提升；因子分析覆盖多类证据源与不同LLM后端。
summary.authors_note: 北京航空航天大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing retrieval-augmented code generation methods only optimize retrieval relevance, without explicitly modeling how uncertainty in heterogeneous retrieved evidence affects downstream generation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes an uncertainty-aware retrieval-augmented code generation framework, and first reveals via factorial analysis that there are significant interaction effects between different evidence sources with no universal additive ranking.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces OpenCoder, which estimates source-specific uncertainty to filter and rank heterogeneous evidence, and guides generation, verification, and repair; uses factorial analysis to disentangle interactions among API knowledge, repository context, and similar-code evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on an expanded 32-task RepoExec-inline evaluation, improving GPT-based baselines; factorial analysis covers multiple evidence sources and different LLM backends.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 因子分析揭示检索证据源无通用加性排序这点有启发，其余为工程增量，看摘要和因子分析部分即可。
recommendation.en: The factorial analysis finding of no universal additive ranking for retrieval evidence sources is insightful; the rest is incremental engineering — read only the abstract and factorial analysis section.

paper.title: AssumptionMiner: Extracting, Tracing, and Revising Implicit Assumptions in LLM Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate code from natural-language prompts, yet real-world prompts rarely provide complete specifications. When prompts leave input formats, error handling, or design decisions unspecified, LLMs fill these gaps with implicit assumptions that shape the generated code's behavior and correctness. Because these assumptions remain hidden, generated code may satisfy tests while violating developer intent. We present AssumptionMiner, a framework that makes implicit assumpt

summary.core_problem: LLM代码生成时，自然语言prompt存在未明确规范，模型填充的隐式假设不可见，导致代码通过测试但违反开发者意图的问题。
summary.importance: 方法+数据贡献，提出隐式假设的显式化框架，同时发布含676条标注假设的180个歧义编程任务基准。
summary.technical_approach: 1) AssumptionMiner框架生成代码同时输出显式假设层，结构化表示推断的约束和设计决策；2) 基于AST的依赖图实现假设修改后仅重生成受影响代码；3) 构建180个歧义编程任务benchmark，含人工验证子集。
summary.experiments: 构建180个歧义编程任务，含676条标注假设，包含人工验证的子集用于评测假设提取的准确性。
summary.authors_note: Michigan Technological University，无知名作者识别。

summary_en.technical_approach: 1) AssumptionMiner framework outputs an explicit assumption layer alongside code, structurally representing inferred constraints and design decisions; 2) AST-based dependency graph enables targeted regeneration of only code affected by revised assumptions; 3) Builds benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with human-verified subset.
