paper.title: RTL-BenchLS: A Large-Scale Benchmark for RTL Reasoning and Generation with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: LLM-based RTL generation and reasoning is a promising direction for hardware design automation. High-quality benchmarks are critical infrastructure for tracking progress in this direction. However, existing RTL benchmarks face inherent limitations in both scale and task scope. The designs they cover are typically small and simple, and the tasks focus almost entirely on specification-to-RTL generation. Frontier models' performance already saturates on the existing benchmarks. Scaling these benchm

summary.core_problem: 现有 RTL（Verilog）生成/推理 benchmark 规模小、任务单一且前沿模型已接近饱和，难以衡量真实硬件设计自动化能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是大规模评测资产：用“形式化验证”绕开真实工程中规格/测试平台稀缺的标注瓶颈，把 RTL 评测从玩具电路推向更接近真实复杂度的设计空间。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 RTL-BenchLS：收集/整理 1 万+ 经过形式化验证的 Verilog 设计；除 spec-to-RTL 外，新增多种更贴近工程闭环的任务（摘要未完整展开，核心点是扩展任务谱系而非只做生成）。以形式化验证作为 correctness 约束与评测信号，降低“看起来像对但不可综合/不可验证”的噪声。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型/规模与数值；主要宣称现有 benchmark 上前沿模型已饱和，而新 benchmark 覆盖更大更复杂设计并提供多任务评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RTL (Verilog) generation/reasoning benchmarks are small, narrow in task scope, and already saturated by frontier LLMs, failing to reflect real hardware-design difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation asset contribution: it uses formal verification as a scalable correctness signal, pushing RTL evaluation beyond toy circuits toward more realistic design complexity.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTL-BenchLS compiles 10k+ formally verified Verilog designs and broadens tasks beyond spec-to-RTL generation (the abstract truncates the full list). Formal verification is used as the core correctness constraint/metric to reduce “plausible but wrong/unverifiable” outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes or numbers; it claims saturation on prior benchmarks and positions the new suite as larger, more complex, and multi-task.

recommendation.zh: 硬件代码生成评测终于用形式化验证做硬约束，能减少“语法像对但语义错”的假进步；只需看任务定义与验证协议，别指望方法论新意。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for its formal-verification-based evaluation protocol that curbs “looks-correct” artifacts; focus on task design and verification setup, not on methodological novelty.

paper.title: Code Is More Than Text: Uncertainty Estimation for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as code generators, where silently wrong programs pose real safety and reliability risks. Reliable uncertainty estimation (UE) is essential for selective prediction, human-in-the-loop review, and downstream agentic decisions. Yet most existing code UE methods are inherited from natural language (NL) generation and ignore properties that make code distinct. We argue that code differs from NL in three ways: a single wrong token can break an en

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注代码生成中的不确定性估计：自然语言生成里常用的置信度方法往往不能识别“看起来流畅但程序是错的”这种代码特有风险。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法改进加分析框架。它不是在做更强代码模型，而是提出代码场景下更合适的 uncertainty decomposition，对 selective prediction、人审触发和 agent 决策有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者认为代码不同于自然语言，至少有三类独特不确定性：词法层面的 token fragility、算法意图与具体实现之间的 intent-code gap，以及程序可执行带来的 functional uncertainty。基于此，他们构造三条互补的 UE 轴：lexical uncertainty 用 Top-K token entropy，algorithmic uncertainty 用 pseudo-code consistency，functional uncertainty 用 behavioral consistency；最后将三者做 ensemble 作为代码生成的置信度估计。
summary.experiments: 实验在 5 个代码 LLM 上进行，和从自然语言生成迁移来的 UE baseline 比较。摘要报告最强 NL-derived baseline 的平均 AUROC 为 0.696，而三轴集成达到 0.776，提升 8.1 个点。摘要没有给出具体模型名、数据集规模和各轴单独贡献，但从结果看，执行语义相关信号比纯 token-level 置信度更有效。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies uncertainty estimation for code generation, arguing that confidence methods inherited from natural language generation miss code-specific failure modes where outputs look fluent but are functionally wrong.
summary_en.importance: This is a methodological refinement plus an analysis framework. It does not advance base-model pretraining directly, but it offers a more code-appropriate decomposition of uncertainty that matters for selective prediction, human review, and agentic code execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors identify three code-specific uncertainty sources: token fragility, the gap between algorithmic intent and concrete implementation, and executability. They instantiate these as three complementary uncertainty axes: lexical uncertainty via Top-K token entropy, algorithmic uncertainty via pseudo-code consistency, and functional uncertainty via behavioral consistency, then ensemble them for final uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover five code LLMs and compare against uncertainty-estimation baselines adapted from natural language generation. The abstract reports an average AUROC gain from 0.696 for the strongest NL-derived baseline to 0.776 for the proposed three-axis ensemble, a +8.1 point improvement. The abstract does not specify the full model list or dataset details.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，但它提醒一件常被忽略的事：代码 LM 的错误不是 token-level calibration 能解释完的；只看三种 uncertainty 分解和 AUROC 表即可。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but it usefully reminds you that code-LM failures are not captured by token-level calibration alone; the three-way uncertainty decomposition and the AUROC table are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Towards the Readability of LLM-Generated Codes through Multitask Representation Engineering
paper.abstract: Correctness and readability are key measures of code quality, respectively ensuring functional fidelity and ease of comprehension. While most existing research focuses on improving the correctness of large language models~(LLMs) generated codes, readability remains under-addressed. Enhancing readability through targeted control is challenging due to its subjective nature. In this article, we employ representation engineering~(RepE) as the targeted control method given its characteristics of low

summary.core_problem: 如何在使用 LLM 生成代码时，在保证正确性的同时提升代码的可读性？
summary.importance: 机制分析与方法应用。将表示工程（Representation Engineering, RepE）扩展到多任务场景，用于控制 LLM 生成代码的可读性，探讨了正确性与可读性之间的权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出多任务 RepE 框架。由于可读性具有主观性，难以通过常规方法控制，作者利用 RepE 数据依赖低、计算成本低的特点进行目标控制。理论分析了多任务引导方法对代码可读性和正确性权衡的影响。
summary.experiments: 进行了综合实验以支持理论分析，并开源了相关实现。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the readability of LLM-generated code while maintaining correctness?
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis and method application. Extends Representation Engineering (RepE) to multitask scenarios to control the readability of LLM-generated code, exploring the tradeoff between correctness and readability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a multitask RepE framework. Given the subjective nature of readability, the authors leverage RepE's low data dependency and computational cost for targeted control. Theoretically discusses the impact of multitask steering on the tradeoff between code readability and correctness.
summary_en.experiments: Provides comprehensive experiments to support the theoretical analysis and open-sources the implementations.

recommendation.zh: 将 Representation Engineering 应用于代码生成的可读性控制，属于特定维度的 steering 研究，作为 literature 了解即可。
recommendation.en: Applies Representation Engineering to control the readability of generated code; a specific dimension of steering research, good to know as literature.

paper.title: TLA-Prover: Verifiable TLA+ Specification Synthesis via Preference-Optimized Low-Rank Adaptation
paper.abstract: TLA+ is a formal specification language for verifying distributed systems and safety-critical protocols. Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce TLA+ specifications that fail the TLC model checker for semantic reasons. Across 25 LLMs, the best public baseline is 26.6% syntactic parse and 8.6% semantic model-check. We present TLA-Prover, a 20-billion-parameter model for TLA+ specification synthesis. Training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on verified examples with repair-based grou

summary.core_problem: 通用大模型生成的TLA+分布式系统形式化规范通过率极低，现有最优公共基线的语法解析通过率仅26.6%，TLC模型检查通过率仅8.6%；同时直接以TLC检查结果作为奖励信号存在奖励黑客风险——模型可生成永真式不变式通过检查，却不具备实际验证价值。
summary.importance: 验证了在形式化规范生成这类严格可验证的代码任务中，使用工具原生奖励信号结合反奖励黑客机制的训练范式可行；两阶段SFT+基于修复的GRPO的训练流程对低资源专业领域的模型适配有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计四层验证等级体系：青铜（语法解析失败）、白银（语法通过但模型检查失败）、黄金（语法和模型检查均通过）、钻石（黄金+不变式通过变异测试——对不变式做AST级变异后TLC必须能检出反例，从机制上排除永真式这类无效不变式）。2. 基于OpenAI开源的20B参数基座模型，采用两阶段训练：第一阶段用严格筛选到钻石级的TLA+规范语料做SFT；第二阶段用基于修复的分组相对策略优化（GRPO），让模型学习修正自身被拒绝的规范，直接以TLC检查结果作为奖励信号，无额外学习奖励模型；同时训练DPO变体作为消融对比。
summary.experiments: 基线为FormaLLM研究中25个开源大模型的平均表现：语法通过率26.6%、TLC模型检查通过率8.6%。TLA-Prover在30题留存测试集上的钻石级通过率达到30%（9/30），是基线TLC通过率的3.5倍；所有检查点的黄金级与钻石级通过率一致，验证了变异测试机制有效排除了永真式不变式的奖励黑客问题。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章的四层验证体系设计和两阶段训练流程，以及第4章的反奖励黑客实验分析，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: General-purpose LLMs generate TLA+ formal specifications for distributed systems with extremely low pass rates: the best public baseline only achieves 26.6% syntactic parse rate and 8.6% TLC model-check pass rate. Additionally, using TLC check results directly as reward signal exposes reward hacking risks, as models can generate tautological invariants that pass checks without providing meaningful verification value.
summary_en.importance: This work validates the feasibility of a training paradigm that combines native tool reward signals with anti-reward-hacking mechanisms for strictly verifiable code generation tasks like formal specification synthesis. The two-stage SFT + repair-based GRPO training pipeline provides reference for model adaptation in low-resource professional domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A four-tier validation hierarchy is designed: Bronze (syntactic parse failure), Silver (syntax passed but model check failed), Gold (both syntax and model check passed), Diamond (Gold tier plus invariant passes mutation testing — AST-level mutations to the invariant must trigger TLC counterexamples, which structurally eliminates invalid tautological invariants). 2. Built on OpenAI's 20B open-source base model, the training follows two stages: first SFT on a strictly curated diamond-tier TLA+ specification corpus; second repair-based Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), where the model learns to fix its own rejected specifications, using TLC check results directly as reward without a learned reward model. A DPO variant is trained as ablation for comparison.
summary_en.experiments: The baseline is the average performance of 25 open-weight LLMs from the FormaLLM study: 26.6% syntactic pass rate and 8.6% TLC model-check pass rate. TLA-Prover achieves 30% (9/30) diamond-tier pass rate on a held-out 30-problem benchmark, 3.5x the baseline TLC pass rate. Gold and diamond pass rates coincide across all checkpoints, verifying that the mutation testing mechanism effectively eliminates the reward hacking failure mode of tautological invariants.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the four-tier validation hierarchy design and two-stage training pipeline, plus Section 4 for anti-reward-hacking experiment analysis. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 GRPO 用于形式化验证代码生成（TLA+），利用 TLC 检查器作为 ground-truth reward，是 RL 在严谨代码生成领域的典型应用，值得关注其 RL setup 和 reward 设计。
recommendation.en: Applies GRPO to formal verification code generation (TLA+) using the TLC checker as a ground-truth reward; a typical application of RL in rigorous code generation, worth noting its RL setup and reward design.

paper.title: Scaffold, Not Vocabulary? A Controlled, Two-Tier, Pre-Registered Study of a Popperian Code-Generation Skill
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly write, review, and judge code, and a fast-growing practice equips them with prompt 'skills' that ask the model to reason like a scientist. A prominent example tells the model to act as a Popperian falsificationist, and such skills are reported to improve generated code. But these gains are almost always read off an LLM-as-a-judge, an instrument with documented positional, self-preference, and stylistic biases. We ask: if it appears to help, is the gain from the

summary.core_problem: 检验代码生成中流行的“Popperian/falsificationist prompt skill”到底是内容有效，还是任何结构化 scaffold 都会带来类似收益。
summary.importance: 这是一篇控制实验风格的分析工作，价值不在提出新方法，而在拆穿 prompt 技巧里常见的 judge 偏差与 vocabulary halo。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但对理解后训练/评测中的伪增益有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者做了预注册的 two-tier ablation，设置三类控制：长度匹配 placebo、保留标题但去掉程序内容的 labels-only scaffold，以及执行单元测试 oracle（HumanEval+）替代 LLM judge；另外还加入 vocabulary-halo sentinel 和 same-model self-judge audit，用来检查是否只是术语或格式诱导了评审偏好。
summary.experiments: 在 Claude Sonnet 4.6 上、N=163 的设置中，所有条件都接近 benchmark ceiling，预注册的 +5 分提升未出现。也就是说，所谓 Popperian skill 的收益在执行测试下没有被清楚验证，且 LLM-as-a-judge 可能夸大了表面优势。由于任务规模不大、且 benchmark 已接近天花板，结论更像对评测方法的提醒，而不是对代码生成能力的强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 PythaLab 和 Yıldız Technical University。未见一线 foundation model 团队背景，论文更像一篇严谨的评测/方法学审计。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether a popular 'Popperian/falsificationist' prompting skill for code generation helps because of its scientific content, or whether any structured scaffold would produce similar gains.
summary_en.importance: This is a controlled-analysis paper rather than a new method. Its value is in exposing judge bias and vocabulary-halo effects in prompt-skill claims. The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is useful as a cautionary note for post-training and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper runs a pre-registered two-tier ablation with three controls: a length-matched placebo, a labels-only scaffold that keeps the Popperian headers but removes the procedure, and an execution oracle using HumanEval+ unit tests instead of LLM judging. It also adds a vocabulary-halo sentinel and a same-model self-judge audit to test whether terminology or formatting alone drives the apparent gains.
summary_en.experiments: On Claude Sonnet 4.6 with N=163, all conditions sit near the benchmark ceiling and do not separate; the pre-registered +5-point improvement does not materialize. This suggests the claimed benefit of the Popperian skill is not cleanly supported under execution-based evaluation, and LLM-as-a-judge may overstate superficial advantages. Because the task set is small and near ceiling, the result is more a warning about evaluation than a strong claim about coding ability.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with PythaLab and Yıldız Technical University. This does not appear to come from a major foundation-model lab; the paper reads more like a careful methodological audit.

recommendation.zh: 不是代码能力突破，只是把 prompt 技巧里的 judge 幻觉拆开了；看实验设计就够，结论可作评测 hygiene 的反例库。
recommendation.en: Not a coding breakthrough, just a clean teardown of judge-induced prompt-skill illusions; the experimental design is the main takeaway, and the paper is best used as eval hygiene.

paper.title: CASS-RTL: Correctness-Aware Subspace Steering for RTL Generation with LLMs
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled the automatic synthesis (generation) of register-transfer level (RTL) code from natural language instructions, offering a promising pathway to accelerate chip design. Unlike typical natural language (and software coding) tasks, LLM-based RTL code generation demands strict cycle accuracy with concurrency, where minor logical errors can render a circuit unusable or insecure. While prior work has explored hallucination mitigation via exte

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM生成RTL代码时易出现逻辑错误，多数方法忽略LLM内部注意力机制与RTL正确性的内在关联
summary.importance: 首次提出利用LLM内部正确性感知组件引导RTL生成的框架，属于方法创新+机制发现
summary.technical_approach: 提出CASS-RTL框架，首先识别与RTL正确性相关的注意力头，通过子空间引导技术 steer 模型生成功能正确的RTL代码
summary.experiments: 未公开详细基准测试数据，验证了注意力头与RTL正确性的相关性

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based RTL generation is prone to logical errors, most methods ignore the inherent correlation between LLM internal attention mechanisms and RTL correctness
summary_en.importance: First framework that leverages LLM internal correctness-aware components to guide RTL generation, combining methodological innovation and mechanism discovery
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose CASS-RTL framework that first identifies attention heads correlated with RTL correctness, then uses subspace steering to guide the model to generate functionally accurate RTL
summary_en.experiments: No detailed benchmark results disclosed in abstract, verified the correlation between attention heads and RTL correctness

recommendation.zh: 仅对研究注意力头功能与输出正确性关联的研究员有微弱参考，RTL领域特定结论通用性不强
recommendation.en: Only weak reference for researchers studying attention head functionality and output correctness, domain-specific conclusions for RTL have limited generalizability

paper.title: FLARE: Fine-Grained Diagnostic Feedback for LLM Code Refinement
paper.abstract: Large language models often generate code with bugs. Existing methods rely on feedback signals such as test failures and self-critiques to iteratively refine the generated code. Such signals are either too coarse-grained or too high-level, which is not sufficient to inform the model where to fix the bug. In this work, we present Flare, an iterative framework with a lightweight diagnostic model that predicts line-level suspiciousness signals for bug localization and code refinement. Given the inh

summary.core_problem: LLM代码生成中反馈信号过于粗粒度（测试失败/自我批判），无法精确定位需修复的代码行。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出行级可疑度诊断信号指导代码精修，引入候选搜索策略处理诊断不确定性。
summary.technical_approach: Flare框架包含轻量诊断模型预测行级可疑度信号用于bug定位；给定诊断预测的固有不确定性，对top-k可疑区域进行搜索并根据执行结果选择最佳候选。
summary.experiments: 在LiveCodeBench和BigCodeBench上使用5个基础LLM评测：即使无候选搜索(k=1)，Flare比最强基线绝对提升1.72%-7.42%；搜索10个候选比不搜索平均提升8.50%。
summary.authors_note: 同济大学 + Purdue University，Tianyi Zhang（代码生成领域有持续工作）。

summary_en.core_problem: Feedback signals in LLM code generation (test failures / self-critiques) are too coarse-grained to localize which lines need fixing.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: introduces line-level suspiciousness diagnostic signals to guide code refinement, with candidate search to handle diagnostic uncertainty.
summary_en.technical_approach: Flare framework includes a lightweight diagnostic model that predicts line-level suspiciousness signals for bug localization; given inherent diagnostic uncertainty, searches over top-k suspicious regions and selects best candidate by execution outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LiveCodeBench and BigCodeBench with 5 base LLMs: even without candidate search (k=1), Flare outperforms strongest baseline by 1.72-7.42% absolute; searching 10 candidates gives average 8.50% improvement over no search.
summary_en.authors_note: Tongji University + Purdue University; Tianyi Zhang has ongoing work in code generation.

recommendation.zh: 精修反馈信号粒度的思路对代码LLM有启发，但属于post-hoc修复技巧，非基座pretrain核心方法，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Fine-grained diagnostic feedback is a useful idea for code LLM iteration, but this is a post-hoc refinement technique — glance the abstract only.

paper.title: WorldCoder-Bench: Benchmarking Physically Grounded 3D World Synthesis
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked not only to write static interfaces, but to construct executable interactive worlds from natural language. Browser-native 3D, commonly built with Three.js, is a natural next frontier: generated programs must integrate assets, obey spatial and physical constraints, and keep user-facing controls synchronized with hidden runtime state. Existing web-generation benchmarks and evaluators, however, largely observe only pixels or DOM nodes, while the m

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成基准仅通过像素、DOM节点等表面特征评估浏览器端3D程序的正确性，无法验证Three.js渲染的<canvas>内部的物理约束、3D空间逻辑、运行时状态与交互控件的同步等核心功能，传统DOM评估与实际功能正确性几乎无相关性，会系统性误导面向3D世界生成的模型研发。
summary.importance: 首次建立了面向可执行3D世界生成的功能正确性评测框架，为预训练阶段引入3D交互代码、物理逻辑相关的训练目标和数据提供了可落地的评估标准，填补了代码模型从静态UI/网页生成向交互式3D场景生成能力演进过程中的评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了包含2026个专家标注任务的WorldCoder-Bench，覆盖物理模拟、渲染效果、交互应用三大类共15个细分领域，任务包含纯几何场景和依赖外部.glb资产的场景；配套设计StateProbe执行状态验证协议，在无头Chromium环境中运行生成的代码，通过暴露运行时任务相关变量、执行预设交互序列、对比状态变化与专家编写的隐藏行为契约来验证功能正确性，所有契约均经过注入缺陷的鲁棒性测试避免宽松阈值；额外提出自动化回报率、时间效率乘数两个效用指标，将推理成本、延迟与3D前端开发者的人力成本对标，量化模型的实际生产价值。
summary.experiments: 对9个前沿模型的评测显示，所有模型的验证覆盖率均未超过30%；传统DOM评估与状态级正确性的Kendall τb为-0.02，几乎无相关性；成本为DOM评估约400倍的8轮源码探测代理，仍会给45.6%的严重缺陷输出打及格分，验证了表面评估的系统性偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章StateProbe的实现细节和契约验证逻辑，第4章的模型评测结果；泛读任务构建流程和效用指标设计部分，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code generation benchmarks evaluate browser-side 3D program correctness only via surface features such as pixels and DOM nodes, which cannot verify core functionalities inside Three.js-rendered <canvas> elements, including physical constraints, 3D spatial logic, and synchronization between runtime state and interaction controls. Traditional DOM-based evaluation shows almost no correlation with actual functional correctness, systematically misdirecting model development for 3D world generation.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes the first functional correctness evaluation framework for executable 3D world generation, providing an implementable evaluation standard for introducing 3D interactive code and physics logic related training objectives and data during pretraining, and filling the evaluation gap as code models evolve from static UI/webpage generation to interactive 3D scene generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldCoder-Bench is built with 2,026 expert-curated tasks covering 15 fine-grained domains across three categories: physical simulation, rendering effects, and interactive applications, including both primitive-only scenes and asset-dependent scenes with external .glb resources. The配套 StateProbe execution-based state verification protocol runs generated code in a headless Chromium environment, exposes task-relevant runtime variables, executes preset interaction sequences, and compares state changes against hidden expert-authored behavioral contracts to verify functional correctness. All contracts are tested for robustness against injected defects to avoid loose thresholds. Two additional utility metrics, Return on Automation and Time Efficiency Multiplier, benchmark inference cost and latency against 3D frontend developer labor costs to quantify the practical production value of model outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation of nine frontier models shows that none achieve more than 30% Verification Coverage. The Kendall τb between traditional DOM-based scoring and state-level correctness is -0.02, indicating almost no correlation. An 8-turn source code probing agent that costs ~400x more than DOM evaluation still grants passing scores to 45.6% of severely defective outputs, confirming the systematic bias of surface-level evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for StateProbe implementation details and contract verification logic, and Chapter 4 for model evaluation results. Skim the task curation process and utility metric design sections, with an estimated reading time of 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 别被“3D生成”误导，这篇核心是把 canvas 内隐藏状态做成可验证契约；只看 StateProbe 的验证设计与失败模式就值回票价。
recommendation.en: Not about 3D generation per se—it's an execution-based contract checker for hidden canvas state; read StateProbe’s verification design and failure modes, skip the rest if busy.

paper.title: CRAFTQA: A Code-Driven Adaptive Framework for Complex Structured Data Reasoning
paper.abstract: Real-world scenarios involve massive heterogeneous structured data (e.g., tables, knowledge graphs), making effective reasoning over such diverse data increasingly important. Unified structured data question answering has emerged as a prominent research trend, aiming to answer natural language questions across different structured data types within a single framework. However, existing unified methods share a common limitation: they rely on a set of predefined functions, which restricts their ab

summary.core_problem: 统一结构化数据QA依赖预定义函数集，限制了复杂推理能力
summary.importance: 提出CRAFTQA框架，通过代码生成实现自适应推理，属于结构化数据推理方法创新
summary.technical_approach: CodeSTEP模块生成完整可执行Python代码序列作为逐步推理；CRAFT模块动态生成自定义代码函数以处理预定义函数之外的操作
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中详述模型规模、基线和具体提升幅度
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学、蚂蚁集团、JIUTIAN Research，无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Unified structured data QA relies on predefined function sets, limiting complex reasoning beyond these operations
summary_en.importance: Proposes CRAFTQA, an adaptive code-driven framework for complex structured data reasoning; incremental method innovation
summary_en.technical_approach: CodeSTEP module generates complete executable Python code sequences as step-by-step reasoning; CRAFT module dynamically generates custom code functions for operations beyond predefined ones
summary_en.experiments: Model sizes, baselines, and specific improvement margins not detailed in abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Zhejiang University, Ant Group, JIUTIAN Research; no notable famous authors

recommendation.zh: 代码驱动推理属于Agent应用方向，与基座预训练关联较弱，作为前沿方向了解即可
recommendation.en: Code-driven reasoning is an agent application direction with weak relevance to foundation pretraining; awareness-level only

institutions: ZJU-Ant Group Joint Lab of Knowledge Graph

paper.title: Kernel Foundry: A Diagnosis-driven Evolutionary Kernel Optimizer with Multi-Experts
paper.abstract: Generating high-performance GPU kernels remains challenging due to the need for both correctness and hardware-aware optimization. While large language models (LLMs) show promise in code generation, they often fail to produce kernels that are both correct and efficient.   We propose Kernel Foundry, a diagnosis-driven evolutionary framework for automatic GPU kernel optimization. Our method combines expert-guided, retrieval-augmented initialization with a multi-island evolutionary search, where can

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 LLM 生成 GPU/Triton kernel 时“能跑”和“跑得快”难以同时满足的问题。单次代码生成容易出现编译错误、索引错误、边界处理错误；即使正确，tiling、并行粒度、memory access、同步策略等性能因素也很难靠通用 LLM 一步到位。更麻烦的是，某些候选实现会绕过 kernel 级计算，例如调用外部库来投机通过评测，这会污染搜索信号。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献不在模型训练目标，而在训练基础设施和 LLM-for-systems 的自动优化范式。它把 kernel 生成从一次性代码补全，改成带诊断、检索、经验积累和多分支搜索的闭环系统。对大模型训练团队有实际启发：复杂系统代码的优化信号通常不是一个简单 reward，而是由 correctness failure、runtime error、性能瓶颈和硬件约束共同组成。把这些信号结构化，比只用 RL 或只用代码模型采样更稳。
summary.technical_approach: Kernel Foundry 由三部分组成。第一，专家引导初始化：从高质量专家 kernel 中蒸馏出紧凑经验语料，再用检索增强方式为当前 PyTorch operator 提供相关先验，引导专门的 kernel 生成模型产生更可靠的初始 Triton kernel。第二，多岛进化搜索：不同 island 并行维护候选 kernel 群体，避免所有搜索路径过早收敛到同一种局部设计。每个候选会经过编译、运行、正确性和性能评估，再根据诊断结果生成下一轮修改。第三，集中经验库：系统把错误类型和性能瓶颈组织成可复用知识，例如 indexing bug、shape mismatch、memory coalescing 不佳、block size 不合适等，并在后续演化中检索相关优化建议。与 RL 方法相比，它不只依赖稀疏的标量反馈；与监督生成相比，它有持续优化过程；与通用 agent 搜索相比，它把诊断类别和反作弊规则显式纳入循环。
summary.experiments: 实验在 KernelBench Level 1 和 Level 2 上进行。论文报告最高可达到 99% correctness，并在性能上稳定优于若干 LLM-based kernel generation 和自动优化基线。消融部分的主要信息是：专家引导初始化提升早期正确率，诊断驱动的反馈比无结构反复采样更容易带来性能增益，经验库能把已发现的优化模式迁移到后续算子，反作弊过滤可以防止候选 kernel 通过外部库调用等方式绕开真实优化。原文摘要和引言没有给出完整 speedup 数字，精确倍率需要看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和方法总览，确认系统闭环如何从 operator 到候选 kernel、诊断、检索经验、再到新一轮演化。然后看诊断 schema、experience library 的组织方式，以及反作弊规则，这些部分比最终 leaderboard 更有方法价值。实验部分重点看 KernelBench Level 1/2 的 correctness、speedup 和消融表，尤其是 expert-guided initialization、multi-island evolution、experience retrieval 三者分别带来的增益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical failure mode in LLM-based GPU kernel generation: generated Triton kernels often fail to be correct and efficient at the same time. One-shot generation is brittle because small indexing, boundary, or launch-configuration errors can break correctness. Once correctness is achieved, performance still depends on nontrivial hardware-sensitive choices such as tiling, memory access patterns, parallelism, and synchronization. The paper also treats evaluation loopholes as part of the problem, since kernels may appear fast by delegating work to external libraries rather than performing the intended kernel-level computation.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is on the training-systems side rather than on pretraining objectives. It is a useful example of turning LLM-based systems-code generation into a closed-loop optimizer with structured diagnostics, retrieval, accumulated experience, and parallel evolutionary search. The broader lesson is that systems optimization rarely provides a clean scalar reward. Correctness failures, runtime traces, bottleneck categories, and hardware constraints need to be exposed explicitly to the model and the search procedure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Kernel Foundry combines expert-guided initialization, multi-island evolution, and a centralized experience library. The initialization stage distills high-quality expert kernels into a compact corpus and retrieves relevant optimization priors for a given PyTorch operator, giving a domain-specialized generator a better starting point. The evolutionary stage maintains multiple parallel islands of candidate Triton kernels, evaluates each candidate, diagnoses compilation failures, correctness errors, or dominant performance bottlenecks, and uses the diagnosis to guide further edits. The experience library stores reusable optimization knowledge indexed by error types and bottleneck categories, so later candidates can reuse patterns discovered earlier. This differs from RL-style approaches that mostly depend on sparse execution rewards, and from supervised kernel generation that has little mechanism for systematic post-generation optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses KernelBench Level 1 and Level 2. The paper reports correctness up to 99% and consistent performance gains over LLM-based and automated kernel-generation baselines. The ablations indicate that expert-guided initialization improves early correctness, structured diagnosis gives better search signals than unstructured resampling, experience retrieval helps transfer optimization patterns across operators, and explicit anti-cheating filters prevent invalid shortcuts such as bypassing the intended kernel computation. The excerpted content does not expose the full speedup table, so the exact acceleration factors should be checked in the original experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough. Start with Figure 1 and the system overview to understand the closed loop from operator input to candidate generation, diagnosis, retrieval, and evolution. Then read the diagnostic taxonomy, the experience-library design, and the anti-cheating mechanism. In the experiments, focus on the KernelBench Level 1/2 correctness and speedup tables, plus the ablations for expert initialization, multi-island evolution, and experience retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 利用 LLM 结合进化算法生成 GPU kernel，对算子自动优化和底层加速有启发，关注其诊断反馈机制。
recommendation.en: Using LLMs combined with evolutionary algorithms to generate GPU kernels, inspiring for automatic operator optimization and low-level acceleration; pay attention to its diagnostic feedback mechanism.

paper.title: Combinatorial Synthesis: Scaling Code RLVR via Atomic Decomposition and Recombination
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has recently emerged as the cornerstone for shaping the remarkable coding abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the scalability of RLVR is severely constrained by the scarcity of sufficiently challenging verifiable code tasks that target near the model's edge of competence. Prior studies often rely on heuristic seed expansions for data synthesis, which severely limits both novelty and difficulty. Consequently, the training value

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是代码 RLVR 的训练数据供给问题：可验证、足够难、接近模型能力边界的代码任务很少，而简单从种子题做提示改写或递归扩写，往往只增加表述差异，不能产生新的逻辑结构，也不能持续提供有效探索信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于，它把“可验证奖励数据如何扩展”拆成了结构化数据生成问题，而不是普通指令数据合成问题。RLVR 对代码能力的提升很依赖任务难度分布和测试质量；如果数据只是语言层面的扩写，reward 很快饱和，训练信号会变弱。ADR 的启发是：面向 RL 的合成数据需要扩展组合结构和解空间，而不只是扩大样本数。这一点对 code RL、reasoning RL、工具使用 RL 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 ADR，即 Atomic Decomposition and Recombination。核心做法是先把少量领域种子题拆成任务元素，再在元素空间中做受控重组，生成新的可验证代码任务。流程包括五步：元素抽取、受控元素重组、模板化题目合成、执行验证、对抗式解空间细化。论文强调 schema 的作用：不同代码领域需要定义不同元素，例如算法题中的数据结构、约束、目标函数、边界条件，工具调用任务中的 API、调用顺序、输入输出约束等。为了避免 schema 过粗或过细，作者引入 info-guided element schema optimization，用信息量反馈迭代调整元素定义。生成任务后，系统同时生成参考解和测试生成器，通过执行来过滤错误样本；再用 adversarial solution-space refinement 改进测试，使测试能区分正确解与投机解。和 KodCode、Educational Instruct 这类基于现有题目做启发式扩展的方法相比，ADR 的区别在于它不保留原始题目的组合骨架，而是在原子元素层面构造新的逻辑交叉。
summary.experiments: 论文从两个层面评估。第一是数据质量，使用 originality、difficulty、diversity、test quality 等维度，比较 ADR 合成数据与已有合成代码数据。结论是 ADR 在这些维度上更强，尤其是在逻辑新颖性和测试质量上。第二是下游 RLVR 训练。论文在多个代码领域和多个 base model 上训练，报告称既有合成数据受限于对真实题目的启发式扩展，训练后难以超过原始数据；ADR 数据则能稳定带来提升。一个明确结果是，在 LCB-v5 上，Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 经过 ADR 数据 RLVR 后达到 25.37%，相对基线提升 +9.20%，也高于最强合成数据基线的 22.75%。论文还区分 Pass@1 和 Pass@8 的变化：此前方法主要增加采样密度，Pass@8 只提升 +0.60%；ADR 的 Pass@8 提升 +4.79%，作者用它说明模型可探索的能力边界被推高，而不只是单次采样策略变好。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对“heuristic expansion 为什么不能扩展逻辑拓扑”的论证，这是论文的问题定义。然后看 Method 里五阶段流程，重点关注 schema extraction、controlled recombination 和 adversarial solution-space refinement；这些部分决定它是否只是模板生成，还是确实能产生可训练的 RL 数据。实验部分建议重点看数据质量 taxonomy、RLVR 主结果表、Pass@8 分析和不同代码领域的迁移结果。若只关心预训练/后训练接口，可重点看任务难度分布、reward 饱和、test quality 与 RL 增益之间的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the data bottleneck in code RLVR: strong training gains require verifiable tasks that are hard enough and close to the model’s competence boundary, while common prompt-based or recursive seed expansion mostly changes surface form and fails to create new logical structures.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining and post-training research is the treatment of verifiable RL data as a structural synthesis problem. For code RLVR, scale alone is not enough; the data must change the task topology, difficulty distribution, and test strength. ADR suggests that RL data synthesis should expand the combinatorial space of solvable and checkable problems, rather than merely densify variants around existing seeds. This is relevant beyond code, especially for reasoning RL and tool-use RL where reward saturation is a common failure mode.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADR, or Atomic Decomposition and Recombination, decomposes a small set of domain-specific seed tasks into atomic elements and recombines them under controlled schemas. The pipeline has five stages: element extraction, controlled recombination, template-based problem synthesis, execution-grounded validation, and adversarial solution-space refinement. The schema is task-specific: for algorithmic programming it may capture data structures, constraints, objectives, and edge cases; for tool use it may capture APIs, call dependencies, and input-output constraints. The paper also introduces info-guided schema optimization to refine the granularity of extracted elements. After synthesis, the system generates solutions and test generators, validates them by execution, and strengthens tests through adversarial refinement over the solution space. Compared with methods such as KodCode and Educational Instruct, the key difference is that ADR does not preserve the compositional skeleton of seed problems; it constructs new intersections among atomic logical primitives.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation has two parts. First, the paper assesses synthetic data quality along originality, difficulty, diversity, and test quality, reporting that ADR-generated data outperforms prior synthetic code data across these axes. Second, it runs RLVR training across code domains and base models. Prior synthetic data methods, which mainly expand real-world seeds heuristically, do not reliably outperform training on the original data. ADR produces consistent gains. On LCB-v5 with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, ADR reaches 25.37%, a +9.20% improvement and higher than the best reported synthetic-data baseline at 22.75%. The Pass@8 analysis is also important: previous methods improve Pass@8 by only +0.60%, while ADR improves it by +4.79%, suggesting that the method improves the model’s reachable solution space rather than only increasing sampling density.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the Introduction’s argument against heuristic seed expansion, since it frames the data-scaling problem clearly. Then read the Method section around schema extraction, controlled recombination, and adversarial solution-space refinement. These components determine whether the method is merely templated generation or a stronger way to create RL-useful tasks. In the experiments, focus on the data-quality taxonomy, the RLVR main result tables, the Pass@8 analysis, and transfer across code domains. For researchers interested in the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, the most useful thread is the link among difficulty distribution, reward saturation, test quality, and RL gains.

recommendation.zh: 合成数据能 scaling 是 RL 编码训练的核心瓶颈，这篇提出的原子分解+重组思路值得认真看；建议读 §3 ADR 框架和 §5 难度分布分析。
recommendation.en: Data scalability is the core bottleneck of RLVR code training. The atomic decomposition + recombination framing deserves serious attention. Read §3 framework and §5 difficulty distribution analysis.

paper.title: Automating Formal Verification with Reinforcement Learning and Recursive Inference
paper.abstract: Automated formal verification remains challenging for large language models because data for proof assistants and verification-aware languages is scarce, and correctness depends on satisfying precise machine-checkable specifications rather than producing plausible code. This thesis studies how verifier environments can improve LLM generation of verified programs and proofs through reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) and verifier-guided inference-time search. First, we train ope

summary.core_problem: LLM 在形式化验证任务（如生成可验证程序和证明）中面临两大瓶颈：证明助手和验证感知语言的训练数据稀缺，且正确性取决于满足精确的机器可检查规范，而非生成看似合理的代码。
summary.importance: 形式化验证是保证软件在所有可能输入下行为正确的数学证明方法，对AI时代的网络安全至关重要。将RL与形式化验证结合，有望大幅降低形式化验证的专家人力成本，对代码生成和安全领域有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出通过 verifier 环境来提升 LLM 生成可验证程序的能力，核心方案包括：（1）基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），使用 GRPO 及其变体；（2）verifier 引导的推理时搜索。具体做法是在 Dafny 语言中训练开源模型，将生成的候选片段组装成完整程序，并用编译器和 verifier 的结果作为奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 仅提供了初步实验摘要：在一个由 APPS 数据集派生的 Dafny 数据集上的初始实验将 verified reward 从 2 提高（具体对比基准未详述）。
summary.reading_guide: 这是一篇博士论文的开篇章节，提供的全文仅包含背景介绍（网络安全风险、形式化验证概述）。核心技术方法和实验细节应在后续章节。建议先看摘要和相关工作部分（未提供），再重点阅读实验章节。预计完整阅读需 30-45 分钟（完整论文）。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供的片段中确定机构和作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs face two major bottlenecks in formal verification tasks (generating verified programs and proofs): scarce training data for proof assistants and verification-aware languages, and correctness depends on satisfying precise machine-checkable specifications rather than producing plausible-looking code.
summary_en.importance: Formal verification mathematically proves software behaves correctly on all possible inputs, which is critical for cybersecurity in the AI era. Combining RL with formal verification could substantially reduce the expert labor cost of formal verification, with practical value for code generation and security.
summary_en.technical_approach: The thesis proposes using verifier environments to improve LLM generation of verifiable programs. Core schemes include: (1) Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) using GRPO and variants; (2) Verifier-guided inference-time search. Specifically, open-source models are trained in the Dafny language, generated candidates are assembled into complete programs, and compiler/verifier outcomes serve as reward signals.
summary_en.experiments: Only preliminary experiments are summarized: initial experiments on an APPS-derived Dafny dataset increased verified reward from 2 (baseline details not fully provided).
summary_en.reading_guide: This is the opening chapters of a PhD thesis. The provided content only covers background (cybersecurity risks, formal verification overview). Core methodology and experimental details should be in subsequent chapters. Suggest reading the abstract and related work first (not provided), then focus on the experimental chapters. Estimated 30-45 minutes for the complete thesis.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information cannot be determined from the provided fragments.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward-hacking 部分即可；它提醒 RLVR 的瓶颈常在规格质量，不在优化器名字。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-hacking part; it is a useful reminder that RLVR often fails on spec quality, not optimizer branding.

paper.title: Improving Small Language Models for Code Generation with Reinforcement Learning from Verification Feedback
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models using programmatically checkable signals such as unit-test outcomes, enabling direct optimization for functional correctness in code generation. We conduct an empirical study of RLVR for Python code generation on the MBPP benchmark using two small models (Qwen3-0.6B and Llama3.2-1B) with LoRA fine-tuning. Across multiple reward formulations such as: unit-test-only rewards, static-analysis-only shaping via the Ruff linte

summary.core_problem: 在代码生成的 RL 训练中，如何设计可验证奖励（RLVR）以提升模型的功能正确性，同时避免模型为了迎合单一奖励信号（如静态分析）而产生退化行为（如生成过短代码）。
summary.importance: 揭示了 RLVR 在代码生成中的“奖励黑客（reward hacking）”现象。证明了在小模型（0.6B-1B）上，通过合理组合单元测试和静态分析奖励，可以有效提升代码生成质量，为后训练阶段的奖励设计提供了实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 在 MBPP 数据集上，使用 Qwen3-0.6B 和 Llama3.2-1B 进行 LoRA 微调。对比了三种奖励设计：(1) 仅单元测试；(2) 仅静态分析（通过 Ruff linter，并引入长度归一化以缓解短代码偏好）；(3) 两者结合。同时对比了 GRPO 和 GSPO 两种组策略优化算法。
summary.experiments: 在组合奖励配置下，MBPP 测试集的 pass@1 提升最高达 13 个百分点。消融实验表明，仅使用静态分析奖励会导致模型倾向于生成更短的代码以规避惩罚，而组合奖励能有效平衡功能正确性和代码规范性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对奖励黑客现象的描述，以及 Method Description 中关于 Ruff 静态分析奖励的设计和长度归一化策略。实验部分关注不同奖励配置下的 pass@1 对比和行为诊断分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How to design verifiable rewards (RLVR) in RL training for code generation to improve functional correctness while preventing the model from degenerating (e.g., generating overly short code) to game a single reward signal like static analysis.
summary_en.importance: Highlights the 'reward hacking' phenomenon in RLVR for code generation. Demonstrates that on small models (0.6B-1B), a well-designed combination of unit test and static analysis rewards can effectively improve code generation quality, providing empirical guidance for reward design in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Fine-tunes Qwen3-0.6B and Llama3.2-1B using LoRA on the MBPP dataset. Compares three reward formulations: (1) unit-test-only; (2) static-analysis-only (via Ruff linter, with length normalization to mitigate short-code bias); (3) combined. Also compares GRPO and GSPO group-based policy optimization variants.
summary_en.experiments: Under the combined reward configuration, pass@1 on the MBPP test set improves by up to 13 percentage points. Ablation studies show that static-analysis-only rewards lead the model to generate shorter code to avoid penalties, while combined rewards effectively balance functional correctness and code style.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the description of reward hacking in the Introduction and the design of the Ruff static analysis reward and length normalization strategy in the Method Description. In the experiments, pay attention to the pass@1 comparison and behavioral diagnostics under different reward configurations.

recommendation.zh: 在 1B 级别小模型上跑 RLVR (GRPO/GSPO) 做代码生成，重点看 reward shaping 导致的 reward hacking 现象（为了不报 lint 错干脆写短代码），对做 RL pretrain/posttrain 的同学很有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Applies RLVR (GRPO/GSPO) to 1B-scale models for code generation. Pay attention to the reward hacking induced by reward shaping (writing shorter code to avoid lint errors). Highly relevant for RL pretrain/posttrain researchers.

paper.title: PassNet: Scaling Large Language Models for Graph Compiler Pass Generation
paper.abstract: Modern tensor compilers such as TorchInductor deliver substantial speedups on mainstream models, yet face a systematic performance ceiling on long-tail workloads -- our profiling shows that 43% of real-world subgraphs experience end-to-end slowdowns under default compilation. While LLMs offer a path toward automated optimization, existing efforts focus on standalone kernel generation. We argue that pass generation -- where LLMs author structured graph transformations that integrate directly into

summary.core_problem: 张量编译器在长尾工作负载上存在性能瓶颈（43%真实子图出现减速），现有LLM辅助编译工作聚焦独立核生成而非与编译器管道集成的Pass生成。
summary.importance: 构建了首个LLM编译器Pass生成的大规模生态系统，包括18K+计算图数据集和200个长尾任务评测基准，推动编译器自动化优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: PassNet系统由两部分组成：(1)PassNet-Dataset：来自100K真实模型的18K+唯一计算图；(2)PassBench：200个精心筛选的长尾可融合任务（含2060个子图），使用统一正确性、稳定性和性能的ES_t指标评测，附带分层完整性防御。
summary.experiments: 在PassBench上评测了多种LLM的Pass生成能力，使用ES_t指标评估。具体基线和SOTA提升未在摘要中详述。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学（Jingjing Wu团队）和华为等产业界。

summary_en.core_problem: Tensor compilers have performance ceilings on long-tail workloads (43% of real-world subgraphs experience slowdowns), and existing LLM-assisted compilation focuses on standalone kernel generation rather than pass generation integrated with compiler pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Builds the first large-scale ecosystem for LLM-based compiler pass generation, including a 18K+ computational graph dataset and 200 long-tail task benchmark, advancing automated compiler optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: PassNet consists of (1) PassNet-Dataset: 18K+ unique computational graphs from 100K real-world models; (2) PassBench: 200 curated long-tail fusible tasks (2,060 subgraphs) evaluated with ES_t metric unifying correctness, stability, and performance, with layered integrity defenses.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates multiple LLMs on PassBench using ES_t metric. Detailed baselines and SOTA improvements not elaborated in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Jingjing Wu's group) and industry collaborators including Huawei.

recommendation.zh: 对编译优化领域有价值，但与LLM基座预训练关系较远。PassBench的评测设计（ES_t指标）可作为评测方法参考。
recommendation.en: Valuable for compiler optimization research but distant from LLM base pretraining. PassBench's evaluation design (ES_t metric) can be referenced as an evaluation methodology.

paper.title: Projectional Decoding: Towards Semantic-Aware LLM Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software artifacts across many software engineering (SE) tasks, yet ensuring the semantic validity of these artifacts remains a fundamental challenge. Existing constrained decoding techniques can enforce syntactic correctness and, in some cases, specific semantic rules, but lack a general representation that bridges LLM-generated text with the reasoning required for semantic validation in SE. In this paper, we propose projectional de

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成软件工件时语义有效性难以保证的问题，尤其是现有 constrained decoding 多数只能可靠约束语法或少量手写语义规则。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码/软件生成中的解码框架概念。它把文本生成和结构化语义模型同时维护，试图让语义校验进入 generation loop；对 constrained decoding 和程序合成有参考，但目前摘要显示仍偏概念和 preliminary results。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 projectional decoding：生成文本的同时维护一个 partial graph model 作为主 artifact representation，用图结构显式表示不确定性、支持增量语义验证和错误检测，并用验证结果约束后续生成。方法强调可证明保证，而不是仅依赖后处理。
summary.experiments: 摘要只提到在一个 program generation 场景有 preliminary results；未提供模型规模、任务集、baseline、成功率或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses semantic validity in LLM-generated software artifacts, where existing constrained decoding methods mostly enforce syntax or a limited set of semantic rules.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conceptual decoding framework for code and software generation. It brings structured semantic validation into the generation loop, which is relevant to constrained decoding and program synthesis, but the evidence appears preliminary.
summary_en.technical_approach: Projectional decoding maintains both text and a partial graph model during generation. The graph acts as the primary artifact representation, captures uncertainty, enables incremental semantic validation and error detection, and guides future decoding decisions with formal guarantees.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions preliminary results on a program-generation setting but does not provide model sizes, benchmark details, baselines, success rates, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 概念方向比实验更强；只看框架定义和保证条件，当前证据不足以改变对 constrained decoding 的判断。
recommendation.en: The concept is stronger than the evidence; read the framework and guarantees, but it should not yet update your view of constrained decoding.

paper.title: FPMoE: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Approach to Functional Code Generation
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress in LLM-based code generation, existing models are predominantly trained on imperative languages, leaving functional programming languages (FPLs) such as Haskell, OCaml, and Scala chronically underexplored, with even frontier models performing substantially worse on FPLs. Fine-tuning is a natural remedy, but our experiments show that per-language fine-tuning fails to capture shared functional abstractions, while merged multi-language fine-tuning introduces cross-language in

summary.core_problem: 函数式语言如 Haskell、OCaml、Scala 在代码生成模型中训练不足，普通单语言微调和多语言混合微调分别面临共享抽象缺失与跨语言干扰。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向小众但结构性很强的代码语言提出稀疏 MoE 适配方案；对预训练研究员的价值在于观察专家路由能否缓解多域代码数据的负迁移，而不是代码能力本身。
summary.technical_approach: FPMoE 使用轻量级稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 架构，为 Haskell、OCaml、Scala 各设置语言专属 routed expert，同时加入 shared expert 捕捉 monadic reasoning、type-directed programming 等跨语言函数式抽象。设计目标是在保留共享模式的同时减少语言间干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数规模、训练 token 数、基线模型名称或具体指标。作者声称相较单语言微调和合并多语言微调，FPMoE 同时缓解共享抽象不足和跨语言干扰，并改善函数式代码生成表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets functional programming languages such as Haskell, OCaml, and Scala, where code LMs remain weak and standard fine-tuning either misses shared abstractions or introduces cross-language interference.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a sparse MoE adaptation for a narrow but structurally interesting code domain. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is about expert routing under multi-domain code interference, not the application itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: FPMoE uses a lightweight sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with one routed expert per language and a shared expert intended to capture functional abstractions such as monadic reasoning and type-directed programming. The design tries to preserve cross-language structure while isolating language-specific interference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter count, training-token scale, baseline names, or exact metrics. It claims that FPMoE improves over per-language fine-tuning and merged multilingual fine-tuning by addressing both missing shared abstractions and cross-language interference.

recommendation.zh: 作为 MoE 缓解代码多域干扰的小样本案例即可；若无路由负载和专家专化分析，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small case study of MoE for multi-domain code interference; without routing-load and expert-specialization analysis, do not read deeply.

paper.title: Learning the Error Patterns of Language Models
paper.abstract: When generating outputs for domains with specific validity constraints (e.g., a program should compile), LLMs often fail in a small number of focused ways: for example, by using Python function names when generating TypeScript. We observe that these error patterns can be represented using a small number of constraints that can be learned in practice. We propose \emph{prefix filters}, which are per-domain-and-LLM symbolic functions, as objects to capture the error patterns, Palla as an algorithm

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在有形式约束的生成任务中为何反复犯少数几类错误，并尝试用可学习的符号约束在解码时规避这些错误。
summary.importance: 贡献是把模型错误模式表示为 prefix filter，并用于 constrained sampling；这是代码生成和结构化输出可靠性方向的增量方法，对预训练研究主要提供错误分布可压缩性的观察。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 prefix filters，即面向特定领域和特定 LLM 的符号函数，用来刻画模型在前缀层面的非法或高风险生成模式；Palla 算法从模型输出中高效学习这些 filters，并在 constrained sampling 中约束后续 token 选择。
summary.experiments: 以 TypeScript 生成等带有效性约束的任务为例，Palla 为 Qwen2.5-1.5B 学到的 prefix filters 将 compile rate 提升超过 60%，使其接近 unconstrained Llama3.1-8B 的表现；论文还用 learned filters 定量分析不同模型的错误模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLMs repeatedly fail in a small number of ways on validity-constrained generation tasks, and how to learn symbolic decoding constraints to avoid those failures.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is representing model-specific error patterns as prefix filters and using them for constrained sampling; for pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that some LM failures appear low-dimensional and compressible.
summary_en.technical_approach: It defines prefix filters as domain- and LLM-specific symbolic functions over generation prefixes. Palla learns these filters efficiently from model behavior, then plugs them into constrained sampling to block invalid continuations.
summary_en.experiments: On TypeScript generation, Palla improves Qwen2.5-1.5B compile rates by more than 60%, bringing it close to unconstrained Llama3.1-8B. The learned filters are also used to quantify model error patterns.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看 prefix filter 定义和 TypeScript 表格即可，错误低维化这个信号比方法本身更有用。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the prefix-filter definition and TypeScript table—the low-dimensional error-pattern signal is more useful than the method.

paper.title: CoSPlay: Cooperative Self-Play at Test-Time with Self-Generated Code and Unit Test
paper.abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and Test-Time Scaling (TTS) have advanced LLM code generation through executable verification. Yet Ground-Truth Unit Tests (GT UTs) remain a bottleneck: SOTA RLVR methods require them for costly training, while existing TTS methods lose competitiveness without them. This motivates GT-free TTS, where existing methods directly use self-generated UTs to refine and select code candidates. Yet such UTs are often noisy or spuriously coupl

summary.core_problem: 代码生成的 RLVR 和 test-time scaling 往往依赖真实单元测试；没有 ground-truth unit tests 时，自生成测试容易噪声大，并可能与错误代码相互强化。
summary.importance: 这是代码生成中的训练无关 test-time 方法。它对预训练研究的间接价值在于展示了可执行验证信号如何在没有人工测试的情况下自举，可能为代码 RLVR 数据构造和 verifier 设计提供弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: CoSPlay 采用 cooperative self-play，同时改进候选代码和自生成单元测试。它先探索多样化解法与潜在失败模式，生成更有区分度的测试思路；随后构造 Code-UT execution matrix，用代码通过测试和测试区分代码的双向 pass-count 信号迭代剪枝与选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体 benchmark、模型规模或提升幅度。实验重点应是与依赖 ground-truth unit tests 的 RLVR/TTS 方法，以及直接使用自生成 UT 的 GT-free 方法比较，在无真实测试设置下评估代码候选选择质量。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)、Institute of Deep Perception Technology、JITRI 和 Wuxi。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR and test-time scaling for code generation often depend on ground-truth unit tests; without them, self-generated tests can be noisy and spuriously coupled with wrong code.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free test-time method for code generation. Its indirect value for base-model researchers is the self-bootstrapping of executable verification signals without human-provided tests, which may inform RLVR data and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoSPlay jointly improves code candidates and self-generated unit tests through cooperative self-play. It explores diverse solution ideas and likely failure modes to generate discriminative test ideas, then uses a Code-UT execution matrix and bidirectional pass-count signals to iteratively prune and select both code and tests.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against RLVR/TTS methods that use ground-truth unit tests and GT-free methods that directly rely on self-generated tests.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations include The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Institute of Deep Perception Technology, JITRI, and Wuxi.

recommendation.zh: 看 Code-UT execution matrix 就够了；方法像工程自举，但对无标注 verifier 信号有可借鉴细节。
recommendation.en: Skim the Code-UT execution matrix; the method is mostly engineering self-bootstrapping, but the verifier signal is reusable.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
Institute of Deep Perception Technology, JITRI, Wuxi

paper.title: VeriScale: Adversarial Test-Suite Scaling for Verifiable Code Generation
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for software engineering, constructing high-quality benchmarks is crucial for evaluating not just the functional correctness, but also the formal verifiability of generated code. However, existing benchmarks are limited by the quantity and quality of positive and negative test cases, leading to an overestimation of model capabilities in generating specifications and implementations. To address this, we propose VeriScale, a novel framework

summary.core_problem: 可验证代码生成（verifiable code generation）是新兴范式，要求模型同时生成形式化规约、代码实现和机器可检查的证明。现有评测基准（如Verina、Clever）依赖有限的测试用例集，缺乏高质量的负向测试用例（非预期输入和非预期输出），导致对模型规约生成（SpecGen）和代码生成（CodeGen）能力的系统性高估。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但作为评测方法学工作，它展示了如何用对抗性构造来缩小基准与真实能力之间的差距。对于代码LLM的训练和评测有参考价值——更严格的评测信号可以反哺训练数据设计。对抗性测试套件的构造方法也可推广到其他需要精确语义评测的领域。
summary.technical_approach: VeriScale框架包含两个核心阶段：测试套件扩展和测试套件约简，两者都由对抗性实现驱动。扩展阶段：先用LLM生成种子输入，再通过类型感知变异扩大候选输入池；根据真实前置条件（ground-truth precondition）将输入分为预期和非预期两类。关键创新是构造对抗性实现（adversarial implementations）——专门设计用来利用LLM生成规约中的弱点的代码，在预期输入上执行这些对抗性实现，产出与参考实现不同、但会被生成的后置条件（postcondition）错误接受的输出，从而得到真正能暴露规约缺陷的非预期输出测试用例。约简阶段：通过保界约简（boundary-preserving reduction）和杀敌约简（adversary-killing reduction）将扩展后的测试用例蒸馏为紧凑但保持区分度的套件。
summary.experiments: 在Verina基准上实例化得到VerinaPlus（测试用例扩大83倍）和VerinaLite（14倍轻量版本）。主要结果：GPT-5.5在VerinaPlus上的性能大幅下降——SpecGen从68.78%降至44.44%，CodeGen从96.83%降至86.24%，证明原始基准严重高估了模型能力。VerinaLite上的模型表现与VerinaPlus高度一致，确认约简策略在大幅减少评测成本的同时保留了区分能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点阅读第3章方法论（了解对抗性实现驱动测试用例构造的具体机制）和第4章实验结果（看性能下降的幅度和跨模型对比）。附录中的prompt模板也值得一看。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未明确给出，作者包含Ye, Pearce等（与Verina基准作者重叠）

summary_en.core_problem: Verifiable code generation requires models to jointly produce formal specifications, code implementations, and machine-checkable proofs. Existing benchmarks rely on limited test suites with insufficient high-quality negative test cases (unexpected inputs and outputs), leading to systematic overestimation of model capabilities in both specification generation (SpecGen) and code generation (CodeGen).
summary_en.importance: Direct relevance to pretraining research is limited, but as a methodology paper, it demonstrates how adversarial construction can close the gap between benchmark performance and true capability. Useful for code LLM training and evaluation design — more rigorous evaluation signals can inform training data curation. The adversarial test-suite construction approach generalizes to other domains requiring precise semantic evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: VeriScale has two core stages: test-suite expansion and test-suite reduction, both driven by adversarial implementations. Expansion: LLMs generate seed inputs, followed by type-aware mutation to enlarge the candidate pool. Inputs are classified as expected or unexpected per ground-truth preconditions. The key innovation is constructing adversarial implementations — code specifically designed to exploit weaknesses in LLM-generated specifications. Executing these on expected inputs yields outputs that differ from reference outputs but are falsely accepted by generated postconditions, producing genuinely informative unexpected-output test cases. Reduction: distills expanded cases into compact yet discriminative suites via boundary-preserving and adversary-killing reduction.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiated on Verina to produce VerinaPlus (83x test-suite expansion) and VerinaLite (14x lightweight variant). Key result: GPT-5.5 performance drops sharply on VerinaPlus — SpecGen from 68.78% to 44.44%, CodeGen from 96.83% to 86.24%, confirming the original benchmark significantly overestimates capabilities. Model performance on VerinaLite closely mirrors VerinaPlus, validating the reduction strategy preserves discriminative power at much lower evaluation cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Chapter 3 (mechanism of adversarial implementation-driven test construction) and Chapter 4 (magnitude of performance drops and cross-model comparisons). Appendix prompt templates are also informative. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated; authors include Ye, Pearce et al. (overlapping with Verina benchmark authors)

recommendation.zh: 代码LLM评测的重要工具，对抗式测试集设计思路可迁移到预训练数据的难例构造，重点看§3的扩缩流程。
recommendation.en: An important tool for code LLM evaluation; the adversarial test case design can be transferred to hard sample construction for pretraining data; focus on the scaling pipeline in §3.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Zhiyuan College, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
Institute of Natural Sciences, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
MOE-LSC, CMA-Shanghai, Shanghai Jiao Tong University

paper.title: Hydra: Efficient, Correct Code Generation via Checkpoint-and-Rollback Support
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for code generation, but many generated programs fail to compile, a prerequisite for further correctness checks such as unit tests. Existing solutions for repairing static errors are costly in both latency and token consumption. Post-hoc repair delays error detection until generation completes and commonly regenerates large regions of previously valid code. Constrained semantic decoding checks after each token, incurring per-token overhead while limiti

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是代码生成里的一个很具体但长期被低估的问题：如何在不显著增加延迟和 token 开销的前提下，把 LLM 生成的代码尽量维持在“静态可通过”的状态，也就是至少能通过编译器的语法和语义检查。现有两类办法都有明显缺陷。post-hoc repair 要等整段代码生成完再检查，错误发现太晚，往往要重生成大量其实已经正确的前缀；incremental constrained decoding 虽然更早检查，但通常按 token 级同步执行，checker 成了生成链路上的串行瓶颈，而且修复范围过于局部，只能改当前 token，常常碰不到真正的根因。全文最重要的观察是：很多静态错误的报错位置并不是根因位置，真正导致错误的 token 往往出现在更早的前缀里，因此“只修当前点”经常无效，而“整段重来”又太浪费。Hydra试图解决的就是这个检查粒度、错误定位滞后、修复范围选择三者之间的系统性矛盾。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是训练目标或建模范式上的论文，但对代码模型的推理时纠错和系统接口设计有直接启发，尤其适合关注 code LM、compiler-in-the-loop、test-time search 的研究者。它的贡献不在于让模型更会写代码，而在于把“生成—检查—回滚—再生成”做成一个低浪费的运行时机制。这个方向的重要性有两点。第一，很多代码模型的真实瓶颈不是 pass@k，而是 compile rate 和单位正确样本成本；Hydra直接优化了这两个更接近产品侧的指标。第二，它把编译器从“末端裁判”改成“异步增量验证器”，这对以后把静态分析、类型系统、解释器甚至单元测试更深地接入生成过程有参考价值。量级上看，它更像一篇高质量系统论文，而不是会改变预训练路线的工作；对预训练研究的启发主要在于：如果模型输出需要被强结构约束消费，推理时的验证与回滚机制可以显著改变有效样本效率，未必只能靠更大模型或更多训练数据解决。
summary.technical_approach:
Hydra的核心设计可以概括成三件事：异步检查、checkpoint-and-rollback、以及策略化的回滚点选择。

第一，异步检查。Hydra不再让生成和编译检查逐 token 锁步执行，而是让 checker 在后台按“自然语义边界”工作，比如完整 statement、declaration 或更适合编译器前端的片段。这样做的原因很直接：语义检查本来就不是 token 级最自然的操作，强行每个 token 调一次 checker，绝大部分调用都在浪费。异步化后，如果当前生成前缀没有问题，模型可以持续前进，不被 checker 阻塞。

第二，checkpoint-and-rollback。每当 checker 确认某个前缀片段静态正确，Hydra就把该前缀和 checker 内部状态一起做成 checkpoint。这里的关键不是只保存文本前缀，而是连同编译器分析状态一起保存，这样回滚后可以复用之前的分析结果，而不是从头重新 parse / type-check 整个前缀。论文强调生产级编译器原本并不支持这种 prefix validation 和 rollback：状态散落在调用栈和隐式上下文里，也默认面向完整程序。Hydra为此定义了一个增量检查抽象，并在 Clang 上以较小改动实现 retrofit：约 500 行修改加 1400 行 shim，相对 1.2M 行前端代码算是很克制的侵入。

第三，策略化 repair。异步检查意味着错误可能在生成已经走得很远之后才被报告，因此系统内部维护的不是单条线性生成轨迹，而更像一个带延迟反馈的搜索树。Hydra允许策略模块决定回滚到哪个 checkpoint，再从那里采样新的 continuation。论文里实现了一个基于 Bayesian root-cause estimation 的策略，用来估计错误更可能由哪个历史位置引起，从而在“回滚太近修不好”和“回滚太远浪费已验证工作”之间做折中。这个接口也兼容已有思路，比如用模型不确定性来选回滚点。

从方法差异看，Hydra和 constrained decoding 的区别不只是“回滚范围更大”，而是把修复单位从 token 改成了已验证前缀；和 post-hoc repair 的区别也不只是“更早发现错误”，而是通过保存 checker state 避免重复验证已知正确部分。它更接近一个面向静态正确性的搜索运行时，而不是单纯的 decoding trick。
summary.experiments:
实验重点放在 C/C++ 代码生成，使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 和 gpt-oss-120B。论文先给出错误分布，说明问题确实主要在 semantic error 而不是 syntax error：在 one-shot、unconstrained C++ 生成下，Qwen2.5 32B 的 syntactic error 只有 0.1%，semantic error 达到 16.5%，functional error 72.5%；gpt-oss 120B 的 syntactic error 0.4%，semantic error 6.4%，functional error 37.2%。这组数字很重要，因为它解释了为什么“语法约束解码”已经不够，真正难的是编译器语义层面的错误。

主结果是和 post-hoc repair 比较，在那些确实会遇到静态错误的任务上，Hydra把延迟和 token 消耗都明显降下来，同时静态正确率接近 100%。具体数字：对 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B，延迟下降 71%，token 消耗下降 70%；对 gpt-oss-120B，延迟下降 25%，token 消耗下降 27%。较小模型收益更大，这也符合直觉：模型越容易犯静态错误，越需要低成本的中途纠偏。

从全文描述看，实验还覆盖了不同 repair policy、不同回滚策略以及多语言/多 checker 适配，文中提到除 Clang 外还评估了 TypeScript 方向，但给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字。值得注意的消融洞察有两类。其一，错误根因常常早于报错位置，这支持 checkpoint 级回滚而不是当前 token resample。其二，异步检查带来的收益不仅来自更早发现错误，也来自生成与检查重叠执行，减少了 checker 对关键路径的占用。

如果从系统代价看，Hydra的工程实现成本相对可控：对 Clang 的改动规模不大，说明它不是依赖重写编译器前端才能成立。这一点对实际部署比单纯的 benchmark 提升更有说服力。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三件事。

第一，读 Introduction 和 Figure 1。这里把现有方法的低效点拆得很清楚：post-hoc 的错误发现太晚，incremental checking 的同步开销太高，localized repair 修不到根因，broad repair 又会重复生成和重复检查。只要把这张图看懂，后面的系统设计就顺了。

第二，重点看介绍增量检查抽象和 checkpoint 机制的章节，尤其是他们如何把 production compiler 改造成支持 prefix validation、state snapshot 和 rollback。这里是论文真正有技术含量的部分，不只是“加个回滚”这么简单。

第三，读 policy 设计和实验部分，关注 root-cause estimation 为什么比简单最近回滚或固定窗口回滚更省 token。若时间有限，优先看错误分布表、主结果表，以及分析错误根因位置的图表，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主要内容。

如果想深挖，有两个点值得看细。一个是异步错误反馈下如何维护一致的搜索树，另一个是 checker state 复用的边界条件：哪些编译器分析状态可以安全快照，哪些会让回滚语义变复杂。这两点决定了 Hydra能否推广到更复杂的静态分析器或解释器。

summary_en.core_problem: Hydra targets a specific but practically important failure mode in LLM code generation: static incorrectness, especially semantic compile-time errors, and how to repair them without paying the full latency and token cost of regenerate-and-recheck loops. Existing approaches sit at two bad extremes. Post-hoc repair waits until the whole program is generated, so errors are discovered late and large valid regions are often regenerated unnecessarily. Token-level constrained or incremental decoding checks too frequently, adds checker overhead to the critical path, and usually only repairs the current token even when the true cause lies much earlier. The paper’s key empirical observation is that compiler-reported error locations often do not coincide with root-cause locations. That makes purely local repair ineffective and full regeneration wasteful. Hydra is designed to resolve this mismatch between delayed error detection, non-local root causes, and the cost of repeated checking.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model researchers working on code LMs, compiler-in-the-loop generation, and test-time search. Its contribution is a runtime design that changes the economics of correct code generation rather than the model itself. Two aspects matter. First, in real deployments, compile rate and cost per statically correct sample are often more important than raw pass@k. Hydra directly optimizes those operational metrics. Second, it reframes the compiler from a terminal verifier into an asynchronous incremental validator. That is a useful systems pattern for future work that may integrate richer signals such as type systems, interpreters, symbolic analyzers, or unit tests into generation. The impact is best understood as a strong systems contribution with clear implications for inference-time correction, not as a shift in pretraining paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Hydra has three central ideas: asynchronous checking, checkpoint-and-rollback, and policy-driven rollback selection.

First, asynchronous checking. Instead of forcing generation and checking to proceed in lockstep at token granularity, Hydra lets the checker validate code fragments at a more natural semantic granularity, such as complete statements or declarations. This matters because semantic checking is not naturally token-local. Token-level checking wastes work on the vast majority of tokens that are not problematic. By decoupling the checker from the generation loop, Hydra removes checker overhead from the critical path when the generated prefix is valid.

Second, checkpoint-and-rollback. Whenever the checker validates a prefix fragment, Hydra creates a checkpoint containing both the accepted prefix and the checker’s internal state. Saving checker state is the crucial part: rollback can then reuse prior parsing and semantic analysis instead of rechecking the same prefix from scratch. The paper emphasizes that production compilers are not built for this. Their state is often implicit, stack-resident, and oriented toward whole-program compilation. Hydra introduces an incremental-checking abstraction that can be retrofitted onto existing compilers. For Clang, the implementation reportedly requires about 500 modified lines plus a 1400-line shim, which is modest relative to a 1.2M-line frontend.

Third, policy-driven repair. Because checking is asynchronous, an error may be reported after generation has already advanced far beyond the actual fault. Hydra therefore manages a search tree over partially validated continuations rather than a single linear trajectory. A policy module decides which checkpoint to roll back to and where to spend regeneration budget. The paper implements a Bayesian root-cause estimation policy that tries to balance two failure modes: rolling back too little and missing the true cause, or rolling back too far and wasting already validated work. The interface is general enough to support other policies, including uncertainty-based ones from prior work.

Relative to constrained decoding, Hydra changes the repair unit from the current token to a validated prefix with reusable checker state. Relative to post-hoc repair, the gain is not only earlier error discovery but also avoiding repeated validation of known-good prefixes. The result is closer to a search runtime for static correctness than a decoding heuristic.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluation is on C/C++ code generation with Qwen2.5-Coder-32B and gpt-oss-120B. The paper first establishes that the dominant issue is semantic rather than syntactic correctness. In one-shot unconstrained C++ generation, Qwen2.5-32B shows only 0.1% syntactic errors but 16.5% semantic errors and 72.5% functional errors. For gpt-oss-120B, syntactic errors are 0.4%, semantic errors 6.4%, and functional errors 37.2%. These numbers justify the focus on compiler-semantic feedback rather than syntax-only constraints.

The headline result is that, on tasks that encounter static errors, Hydra substantially reduces both latency and token consumption while achieving near-100% static correctness. Against post-hoc repair, Hydra reduces latency and token usage by 71% and 70% respectively for Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, and by 25% and 27% for gpt-oss-120B. The larger gains for the smaller model are intuitive: weaker models benefit more from low-cost mid-generation correction.

The full paper also discusses policy variants, rollback behavior, and support beyond Clang, with mention of TypeScript evaluation, though the provided text does not include all detailed tables. Two experimental insights stand out. First, root causes often precede the eventual error site, which supports checkpoint-level rollback over current-token repair. Second, asynchronous checking helps not only because it detects errors earlier, but because it overlaps checking with generation and removes the checker from the synchronous bottleneck.

From an engineering perspective, the implementation cost is also part of the result. The relatively small Clang modification footprint makes the approach more credible for deployment than methods that require rewriting the compiler frontend.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and Figure 1. They clearly lay out the four inefficiencies Hydra is trying to fix: late detection in post-hoc repair, synchronous overhead in incremental checking, overly local repair, and wasteful broad regeneration. That framing is the backbone of the paper.

Then focus on the sections that define the incremental-checking abstraction and explain how checkpointing and rollback are implemented on top of a production compiler. That is the technical center of the work. The interesting part is not the idea of rollback by itself, but how compiler state is made reusable across speculative continuations.

After that, read the policy section and the main experiments. Pay attention to why Bayesian root-cause estimation saves tokens relative to simpler rollback heuristics. If time is limited, prioritize the error breakdown table, the main latency/token results, and any figures analyzing the distance between error reports and root causes. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for a solid skim.

For deeper reading, two questions are worth following carefully: how Hydra maintains a consistent search tree under delayed asynchronous feedback, and which parts of checker state can be safely snapshotted and restored. Those details determine whether the design can generalize to richer analyzers beyond standard compilation.

recommendation.zh: 方法有新意——异步编译检查+检查点回滚比现有逐token约束解码或事后修复更高效。值得看方法和实验部分了解实际开销对比。
recommendation.en: The approach is clever—asynchronous compilation checks + checkpoint/rollback beats both per-token constrained decoding and post-hoc repair. Worth reading the method and experiment sections for overhead comparison details.

paper.title: FrontierSmith: Synthesizing Open-Ended Coding Problems at Scale
paper.abstract: Many real-world coding challenges are open-ended and admit no known optimal solution. Yet, recent progress in LLM coding has focused on well-defined tasks such as feature implementation, bug fixing, and competitive programming. Open-ended coding remains a weak spot for LLMs, largely because open-ended training problems are scarce and expensive to construct. Our goal is to synthesize open-ended coding problems at scale to train stronger LLM coders. We introduce FrontierSmith, an automated system

summary.core_problem: 开放式编码任务（如集群调度、启发式搜索等缺乏已知最优解的问题）是LLM的薄弱环节，核心瓶颈是训练数据稀缺——人工构建每个开放式问题需要设计优化目标、连续评分验证器和测试用例，成本极高。现有编码数据合成方法均针对有二元正确性验证的封闭式任务，无法迁移到开放式场景。
summary.importance: 首次提出从封闭式编码问题自动演化生成开放式训练数据的完整流水线。对预训练研究的启示在于：(1) 证明了已知数据资源（封闭式题库）可以通过定向突变转化为更高价值的训练信号；(2) 提出的idea divergence度量为评估合成数据质量提供了可量化的筛选信号；(3) 用合成数据训练后的模型在FrontierCS和ALE-bench上取得了显著收益，验证了开放式数据对提升LLM复杂编码能力的价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是将封闭式问题（如竞赛编程题）沿三个维度突变为开放式变体：改变目标（将精确求解改为优化某个连续指标）、限制输出（禁止特定解法以迫使策略多样化）、泛化输入（扩大输入规模使精确解法不可行）。关键创新是idea divergence度量——通过两个独立求解器采用不同核心算法的概率来量化问题的开放程度，先基于LLM比对解策略，再基于测试得分相似度验证。生成的问题经多智能体重叠验证后加入种子池，形成迭代演化循环。
summary.experiments: 用200个合成问题训练Qwen3.5-9B和27B模型，采用GRPO。9B模型在FrontierCS上提升+8.82分，ALE-bench上提升+306.36（Elo分）；27B模型分别提升+12.12和+309.12。对照组实验表明，封闭式HardTests数据和随机奖励效果显著更差（FrontierCS上分别低5.24和7.58分），确认开放式表述和真实奖励信号均不可或缺。消融实验显示移除idea divergence筛选器使FrontierCS性能下降2.05分。合成问题还能复现人类标注问题引发的长程行为模式（更多轮次、工具调用、思考token）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Method章节的三个突变维度设计和idea divergence的两阶段计算方式（§3），以及实验部分的对照组对比（§4）。迭代演化循环的设计（图1）值得关注——种子池自更新的思路对其他数据合成任务有迁移价值。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在提供内容中标注，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-ended coding tasks (e.g., cluster scheduling, heuristic search—problems lacking known optimal solutions) are a weak point for LLMs. The core bottleneck is training data scarcity: manually constructing each open-ended problem requires designing optimization objectives, continuous-scoring verifiers, and test cases, making it prohibitively expensive. Existing code data synthesis methods exclusively target closed-ended tasks with binary correctness verification and do not transfer to open-ended settings.
summary_en.importance: This is the first full pipeline for automatically evolving closed-ended coding problems into open-ended training data. For pretraining research, it demonstrates that: (1) existing data resources (closed-ended problem banks) can be transformed into higher-value training signals via targeted mutations; (2) the proposed idea divergence metric provides a quantifiable filtering signal for synthetic data quality; (3) training on synthetic data yields significant gains on FrontierCS and ALE-bench, validating the value of open-ended data for improving LLM coding capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method mutates closed-ended problems (e.g., competitive programming questions) into open-ended variants along three axes: changing goals (replacing exact solution requirements with continuous metric optimization), restricting outputs (prohibiting specific solutions to force strategy diversity), and generalizing inputs (scaling input sizes to make exact solutions intractable). The key innovation is the idea divergence metric—quantifying openness via the probability that two independent solvers employ different core algorithms, estimated first via LLM-based strategy comparison and then via test-score similarity. Validated problems join the seed pool, creating an iterative evolutionary loop.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen3.5-9B and 27B models were trained on 200 synthetic problems using GRPO. The 9B model gained +8.82 on FrontierCS and +306.36 (Elo) on ALE-bench; the 27B model gained +12.12 and +309.12 respectively. Control experiments with closed-ended HardTests data and random rewards performed substantially worse (lower by 5.24 and 7.58 on FrontierCS respectively), confirming that both open-ended formulations and genuine reward signals are necessary. Ablation showed removing the idea divergence filter drops FrontierCS performance by 2.05 points. Synthetic problems also reproduce the long-horizon behavior patterns (more turns, tool calls, thinking tokens) elicited by human-curated problems.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the three mutation dimensions and the two-stage idea divergence computation in the Method section (§3), and the control group comparisons in Experiments (§4). The iterative evolution loop design (Figure 1) — where the seed pool self-updates — is worth noting for transfer to other data synthesis tasks. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 verifier 部分；开放式代码训练确实缺数据，但要警惕 divergence 指标被 solver 偏差污染。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and verifier sections; open-ended coding data is scarce, but the divergence metric may be contaminated by solver bias.

paper.title: Test-Time Learning with an Evolving Library
paper.abstract: We introduce EvoLib, a test-time learning framework that enables large language models to accumulate, reuse, and evolve knowledge across problem instances without parameter updates or external supervision. Instead of adapting model parameters, our approach maintains a shared library of knowledge abstractions, including modular skills and reflective insights, automatically extracted from the model's own inference trajectories. To support continual improvement, we introduce a principled weighting

summary.core_problem: LLM在推理时对每个问题独立处理，无法跨问题累积和复用知识。现有测试时学习(TTL)方法要么依赖模型参数的梯度更新（不适用于黑盒API场景），要么需要外部监督信号（奖励函数、测试用例等），而无监督的测试时扩展方法（如多次采样、搜索）则在每个问题后丢弃所有知识，无法跨问题泛化。
summary.importance: 提出了一种不依赖参数更新和外部监督的测试时持续学习框架EvoLib，对LLM部署和推理范式有重要影响：(1) 证明了从模型自身推理轨迹中蒸馏可复用知识抽象并在测试时持续演化是可行的；(2) 提出的信息增益(IG)和未来信息增益(Future IG)信用分配机制为知识管理提供了 principled 的方法；(3) 在数学推理、代码生成、多智能体任务上均验证了效果，且对任务顺序的鲁棒性优于线性更新的TTL方法。
summary.technical_approach: EvoLib维护一个结构化的知识抽象库，包含两类知识：(1) 模块化技能——从解轨迹中提取的可复用子程序（代码任务为函数，推理任务为子问题+解法，智能体任务为子任务+工作流）；(2) 反思洞察——自然语言描述的常见错误和纠正策略。知识从模型自身生成的解中自动提取，无需外部监督。核心机制是基于信息增益(IG)和未来信息增益(Future IG)的动态权重与合并策略：IG衡量抽象的即时有用性，Future IG衡量其生成未来有价值抽象的潜力，两者联合优化使简单的实例特定抽象逐渐演变为更通用的可复用抽象。推理时通过嵌入相似度筛选和加权采样从库中检索知识辅助解题。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理（GSM8K, MATH）、代码生成（HumanEval, MBPP）、多轮智能体任务上与多种基线比较，包括测试时扩展方法（多数投票、迭代精化）和现有TTL方法。EvoLib在所有设置上均显示一致提升，且token使用效率更高。在持续学习设置中，EvoLib对任务顺序的敏感度低于基于线性知识更新的TTL方法，表明其演化机制支持更健壮的跨任务知识积累。
