summary.reading_guide: 精读§3.2.2的信用分配机制（IG和Future IG的具体定义和计算），这是EvoLib区别于其他记忆/检索方法的核心创新。§3.1的知识提取过程和§3.3的合并策略也值得仔细阅读。实验部分重点关注持续学习场景的顺序鲁棒性实验（§4.2）。图2的框架示意图值得打印出来对照理解。建议全文精读，预计30-40分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在提供内容中标注，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs process each problem independently at inference time and cannot accumulate or reuse knowledge across problems. Existing test-time learning (TTL) methods either rely on gradient updates to model parameters (inapplicable to black-box API scenarios) or require external supervision signals (reward functions, test cases). Unsupervised test-time scaling methods (multi-sampling, search) discard all knowledge after each problem, preventing cross-problem generalization.
summary_en.importance: EvoLib presents a test-time continual learning framework that requires neither parameter updates nor external supervision. Key implications for LLM research: (1) it demonstrates that distilling reusable knowledge abstractions from a model's own inference trajectories and continuously evolving them at test time is feasible; (2) the Information Gain (IG) and Future Information Gain (Future IG) credit assignment mechanism provides a principled approach to knowledge management; (3) consistent improvements are verified across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn agent tasks, with greater robustness to task ordering than linear-update TTL methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoLib maintains a structured library of knowledge abstractions with two categories: (1) modular skills—reusable sub-procedures extracted from solution trajectories (functions for coding, sub-problem+solution for reasoning, sub-task+workflow for agent tasks); (2) reflective insights—natural language descriptions of common errors and corrective strategies. Knowledge is automatically extracted from the model's own generated solutions without external supervision. The core mechanism is a dynamic weighting and consolidation strategy based on Information Gain (IG) and Future Information Gain: IG measures immediate utility of an abstraction, while Future IG measures its potential to spawn valuable future abstractions. Their joint optimization enables simple, instance-specific abstractions to evolve into more general, reusable ones over time. At inference, knowledge is retrieved via embedding similarity filtering and weighted sampling.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across mathematical reasoning (GSM8K, MATH), code generation (HumanEval, MBPP), and multi-turn agent tasks against multiple baselines including test-time scaling (majority voting, iterative refinement) and existing TTL methods. EvoLib shows consistent improvements across all settings with more efficient token usage. In the continual learning setting, EvoLib is less sensitive to task ordering than TTL methods based on linear knowledge updates, indicating its evolution mechanism supports more robust cross-task knowledge accumulation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the credit assignment mechanism (§3.2.2) carefully—the formal definitions of IG and Future IG are the core innovation distinguishing EvoLib from other memory/retrieval approaches. The knowledge extraction process (§3.1) and consolidation strategy (§3.3) also merit close attention. In experiments, focus on the ordering robustness experiments in the continual learning setting (§4.2). The framework diagram in Figure 2 is useful for understanding the full pipeline. Recommend full close reading, estimated 30-40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看方法和消融即可；若无标注轨迹能稳定沉淀技能，pretrain 数据课程和记忆机制都该重想。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if unlabeled traces really yield stable reusable skills, it pressures both data curriculum and memory design priors.

paper.title: 3D Primitives are a Spatial Language for VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit a striking paradox: they can generate executable code that reconstructs a 3D scene from geometric primitives with correct object counts, classes, and approximate positions, yet the same models fail at simpler spatial questions on the same image. We show that 3D geometric primitives (cubes, spheres, cylinders, expressed in executable code) serve as a powerful intermediate representation for spatial understanding, and exploit this through three contributions.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 VLM 的空间理解为何在自然语言 QA 中表现差，但在生成 3D primitive 场景代码时能显露出更好的结构化空间信息。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，代码形式的 3D primitive 可能是一种有效的空间中间表示。它把形状、尺度、位置和方向放进可执行结构里，比直接用自然语言回答更接近模型在代码数据中学到的表示。对 native multimodal pretraining 来说，这提示空间能力不只取决于视觉 encoder 或图文对齐，也取决于输出通道和训练语料里是否存在可复用的结构化空间 token。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SpatialBabel，用同一批场景同时评估 3D scene-code reconstruction 和 spatial QA。primitive split 包含 1,000 个程序生成的 Blender 场景，每个场景有 3 到 20 个几何体，形状包括 cube、sphere、cylinder、cone、torus、pyramid，并控制遮挡以减少感知歧义；Hypersim split 用于更接近真实照片的室内场景验证。评估覆盖六种 scene-code language，并测试 14 个 VLM。方法上有两个关键设计：Code-CoT 先让模型生成 3D primitive reconstruction code，再基于自己的 reconstruction 回答空间问题；S3-FT 则解析模型自己生成的 Three.js 代码，构造成多任务空间标注数据，用于无人工标签、无 teacher model 的 self-supervised spatial fine-tuning。
summary.experiments: SpatialBabel 的设置包括 512×512 单视角渲染、primitive 场景复杂度从 3 个物体到 20 个物体、Hypersim 405 个场景并评估其中 200 个。实验显示，不同 VLM 对不同 scene-code language 的适应差异明显；在 primitive spatial QA 上，Code-CoT 能提高一部分中等能力 frontier VLM 的表现；在真实照片 CV-Bench-3D 上，具备较强代码能力的 VLM 也能从这种 code-mediated reasoning 中获益。S3-FT 在仅使用 primitive images 构造训练数据的情况下，可以迁移到真实照片 benchmark，并在五个 base VLM 上显示可迁移性。给出的内容没有包含具体准确率表和提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解同一模型在 QA 与 scene-code generation 上的矛盾；再看 SpatialBabel 的数据构造和评估协议，确认它如何减少感知噪声；最后看 Code-CoT 与 S3-FT 的实验表。对基座预训练研究，重点不是空间 QA 分数，而是 3D primitive code 作为空间表示和训练信号的作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why VLMs often fail direct natural-language spatial QA while being able to generate executable 3D primitive scene code that contains more accurate object counts, categories, and approximate positions.
summary_en.importance: The useful pretraining signal is representational. 3D primitive code acts like a structured spatial language: it packages shape, scale, orientation, and position into a format that many VLMs have likely seen through code training. This matters for multimodal pretraining because spatial competence may depend not only on visual encoders and image-text alignment losses, but also on whether the training mixture contains structured output channels that make spatial variables explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces SpatialBabel, a benchmark pairing primitive-based 3D reconstruction with spatial QA. The primitive split has 1,000 procedurally generated Blender scenes with 3–20 objects, controlled colors, simple shapes, and reduced occlusion, so errors are less likely to come from object recognition ambiguity. The Hypersim split adds photo-realistic indoor scenes for transfer evaluation. Fourteen VLMs are evaluated across six scene-code languages. The proposed Code-CoT pipeline first asks the model to reconstruct the scene as executable primitive code, then answers questions conditioned on that reconstruction. S3-FT parses a model’s own Three.js reconstructions into structured spatial annotations and fine-tunes on the resulting multi-task data, without human labels or a separate teacher model.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark uses 512×512 single-view renders, five primitive-scene complexity tiers, and a Hypersim setting with 405 scenes, of which 200 are evaluated. Results show strong dependence on the target scene-code language and model-specific reconstruction patterns. Code-CoT improves primitive-scene spatial QA for some mid-tier frontier models and also helps on real-photo CV-Bench-3D when the model has sufficient coding capability. S3-FT trained from primitive images transfers to real-photo benchmarks and is reported across five base VLMs. Exact accuracy numbers and deltas are not present in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the motivating contradiction in the introduction, the SpatialBabel construction, the table comparing scene-code languages across models, and the Code-CoT and S3-FT results. For pretraining researchers, the main point is not the benchmark score itself, but the evidence that executable 3D primitive code can expose and train spatial structure more effectively than direct natural-language QA.

recommendation.zh: 将3D代码作为VLM空间推理的中间语言（Code-CoT），揭示了模态翻译（图像->代码）对激发推理能力的价值，对多模态对齐和CoT设计有启发。
recommendation.en: Using 3D code as an intermediate language for VLM spatial reasoning (Code-CoT) reveals the value of modality translation (image->code) in eliciting reasoning capabilities, inspiring multimodal alignment and CoT design.

paper.title: Reward-Weighted On-Policy Distillation with an Open Property-Equivalence Verifier for NL-to-SVA Generation
paper.abstract: LLM-based generation of SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) is often reported as nearing saturation, with the strongest specialized model reaching ${\sim}76\%$ accuracy on NL2SVA-Human. We show that this aggregate hides a temporal gap: models that appear strong overall still collapse to a few implication templates on bounded-delay and liveness specifications. The core issue is that the dominant recipe, supervised fine-tuning on NL/SVA pairs, optimizes token-level mimicry rather than the \emph{propert

summary.core_problem: 现有基于监督微调（SFT）的自然语言转SystemVerilog断言（SVA）方法存在模板坍塌问题：模型整体准确率看似接近饱和，但在有界延迟、活性等时序复杂场景下会退化为少数蕴含模板，核心原因是SFT优化token级与参考样本的匹配度，而非定义SVA正确性的属性语义等价性；同时商用闭源的属性等价验证器调用成本过高，无法直接用于强化学习训练的每步反馈。
summary.importance: 它验证了形式化验证信号与稠密蒸馏结合的训练范式，用验证器输出作为过滤和加权条件，解决了稀疏奖励信号不足的问题，为需要语义正确性而非表面token匹配的代码、形式化语言生成类任务的后训练优化提供了可复用的方法路径；开源的属性等价验证器降低了形式化验证与LLM训练结合的落地门槛。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法为奖励加权在策略蒸馏（RWOPD），流程分为三步：1）通过分层课程SFT训练7B参数量+LoRA的学生模型，使其覆盖不同时序复杂度的SVA类型；2）从学生模型采样输出，用开源的SymbiYosys+Z3属性等价检查器（PEC）过滤，仅保留通过验证的输出；3）对保留的输出按验证器给出的等价奖励加权，基于冻结的14B教师模型计算前向KL梯度更新学生模型。另外开源了针对有界模型检查片段的属性等价检查器，作为训练阶段的过滤信号，商用闭源验证器仅用于最终效果评测。
summary.experiments: 在NL2SVA-Human和NL2SVA-Machine基准上，7B+LoRA的RWOPD模型在pass@1、pass@5、pass@10指标上超过了此前最优的14B专用模型CodeV-SVA-14B和671B的通用基线模型；收益集中在时序复杂类别，其中C2类（有界时序）准确率提升7.5个百分点，C3类（活性）提升11.5个百分点，C1类（组合逻辑）已饱和无明显提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章的模板坍塌问题分析、第4章的RWOPD方法设计和开源PEC的实现逻辑、第5章的消融实验结果；关注验证器信号与稠密蒸馏结合的核心设计思路，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing SFT-based natural language to SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) methods suffer from template collapse: while aggregate accuracy appears near saturation, models degrade to a small set of implication templates on temporally complex scenarios such as bounded delay and liveness specifications. The core cause is that SFT optimizes for token-level match with reference samples rather than the property semantic equivalence that defines SVA correctness. Additionally, closed-source commercial equivalence verifiers have too high invocation cost to provide per-step feedback for reinforcement learning training.
summary_en.importance: It validates a training paradigm that combines formal verifier signals with dense distillation, using verifier outputs as filtering and weighting conditions to address the sparse reward signal problem. This provides a reusable method path for post-training optimization of code and formal language generation tasks that require semantic correctness rather than surface token matching. The open-source property equivalence checker also lowers the implementation barrier for integrating formal verification with LLM training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method is Reward-Weighted On-Policy Distillation (RWOPD), with a three-step workflow: 1) A 7B-parameter student model with LoRA is trained via stratified curriculum SFT to cover SVA types of different temporal complexity levels. 2) Rollouts are sampled from the student model and filtered by an open-source SymbiYosys+Z3 Property-Equivalence Checker (PEC), retaining only verifier-passed outputs. 3) The retained outputs are weighted by the equivalence reward from the verifier, and the student model is updated with forward-KL gradients computed from a frozen 14B teacher model. The open-source PEC for the bounded model checking fragment is used as a training-time filter, while the closed-source commercial verifier is only used for final performance evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: On NL2SVA-Human and NL2SVA-Machine benchmarks, the 7B+LoRA RWOPD model outperforms both the prior best 14B specialized model CodeV-SVA-14B and 671B general-purpose baselines on pass@1, pass@5, and pass@10 metrics. The accuracy gain is concentrated on temporally complex classes: +7.5 percentage points for C2 (bounded temporal) and +11.5 percentage points for C3 (liveness), while the C1 (combinational) class is already saturated with no significant improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Chapter 3 for analysis of the template collapse problem, Chapter 4 for RWOPD method design and implementation logic of the open-source PEC, and Chapter 5 for ablation study results. Focus on the core design idea of combining verifier signals with dense distillation. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用形式化验证器做 reward 进行 on-policy distillation，思路类似 R1-Zero 在代码领域的应用，证明了 token-level SFT 在逻辑任务上的局限性，值得关注其 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Uses a formal verifier as a reward for on-policy distillation, similar to R1-Zero applied to code; proves the limitations of token-level SFT on logical tasks. The loss design is worth noting.

paper.title: The Readability Spectrum: Patterns, Issues, and Prompt Effects in LLM-Generated Code
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming software development, the functional quality of generated code has become a central focus, leaving readability, one of critical non-functional attributes, understudied. Given that LLM-generated code still needs human review before adoption, it is important to understand its readability especially compared with human-written code and the role of prompt design in shaping it. We therefore set out to conduct a systematic investigation into the code re

summary.core_problem: 系统评估 LLM 生成代码的可读性，以及不同 prompt 设计如何影响可读性这一非功能质量指标。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是代码生成评测维度的补充。它把关注点从功能正确性转向人类审查成本，对 coding agent 的验收标准有一定参考，但不直接推进预训练或代码模型训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建一个综合代码可读性模型，合并文本特征、结构特征、程序特征和视觉特征，用于量化 LLM 生成代码与人类代码的可读性差异，并分析 prompt 对结果的影响。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖从 World of Code 和 LeetCode 抽取的 5,869 个场景，比较主流 LLM 生成代码和人类编写代码。摘要给出的主要结论是：当前 LLM 生成代码整体可读性接近人类代码，但存在可读性谱系上的模式差异；具体模型列表、提升幅度和统计显著性需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和武汉大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures the readability of LLM-generated code and studies how prompt design changes this non-functional quality attribute.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is an evaluation contribution for code generation. It moves beyond functional correctness toward human review cost, which is relevant to coding-agent acceptance criteria but not to foundation-model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a code readability model combining textual, structural, program-level, and visual features, then use it to compare LLM-generated code with human-written code and to analyze prompt effects.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates mainstream LLMs across 5,869 scenarios extracted from World of Code and LeetCode. The abstract reports that LLM-generated code has overall readability comparable to human-written code, while showing distinct readability patterns; model-level details and effect sizes are not available from the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Wuhan University.

recommendation.zh: 作为代码评测特征库备查即可；若做代码模型训练，读可读性特征定义比读结论更有用。
recommendation.en: Useful as a feature catalog for code evaluation; for code-model training, the readability taxonomy matters more than the headline result.

paper.title: HLS-Seek: QoR-Aware Code Generation for High-Level Synthesis via Proxy Comparative Reward Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) compiles algorithmic C/C++ descriptions into hardware, with Quality of Results (QoR) -- latency and resource utilization -- critically governed by pragma configurations and code structure. Existing LLM-based HLS approaches train for functional correctness but ignore QoR entirely. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) for HLS does not require absolute synthesis results -- only relative comparisons between candidates. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{HLS-S

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成高层次综合 HLS 代码时只优化功能正确性、忽略延迟和资源利用等 QoR 指标的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向硬件代码生成的 RL 训练与 reward 设计；对 LLM 基座预训练较远，但对代码模型后训练中的昂贵外部评测、proxy reward 和 reward hacking 控制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HLS-Seek，一个 QoR-aware 的自然语言到 HLS 代码生成框架。核心是用比较式 proxy reward model 替代昂贵的 synthesis-in-the-loop RL；reward 不预测绝对综合结果，而判断候选间 Pareto dominance。为降低 reward hacking，引入 uncertainty-aware MC dropout switching，在低置信样本上调用真实 Vitis HLS 综合，并在线更新 proxy reward。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 proxy reward model 达到 99.53% Pareto-dominance accuracy；HLS-Seek 在 HLS-e 基准上取得 81.5% syntax correctness pass@1 和 81.4% Func@5。未给出底座模型规模、训练数据规模和完整 baseline 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National University of Singapore；Bingsheng He 和 Weng-Fai Wong 在高性能计算、数据库系统和硬件相关方向有长期工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses LLM-based HLS code generation that optimizes functional correctness while ignoring quality-of-result metrics such as latency and resource utilization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an RL and reward-design method for hardware code generation. It is distant from LLM pretraining, but it is useful as a case study for expensive external evaluators, proxy rewards, and reward-hacking control in code-model post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: HLS-Seek is a QoR-aware NL-to-HLS framework. It replaces expensive synthesis-in-the-loop RL with a comparative proxy reward model that predicts Pareto dominance between candidates rather than absolute synthesis outcomes. To reduce reward hacking, it uses uncertainty-aware MC dropout switching: low-confidence candidates are sent to real Vitis HLS synthesis, and the proxy is updated online.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 99.53% Pareto-dominance accuracy for the proxy reward model. HLS-Seek achieves 81.5% syntax correctness pass@1 and 81.4% Func@5 on HLS-e. The provided abstract does not specify base model size, training data scale, or full baseline details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the National University of Singapore. Bingsheng He and Weng-Fai Wong have long-standing work in high-performance computing, database systems, and hardware-related systems.

recommendation.zh: 领域很窄；可借鉴的是“比较式 proxy reward + 低置信真实评测”这套省预算 RL 设计。
recommendation.en: The domain is narrow; the reusable piece is the budget-aware RL design: comparative proxy reward plus real evaluation on low-confidence cases.

paper.title: Primal Generation, Dual Judgment: Self-Training from Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Code generation is typically trained in the primal space of programs: a model produces a candidate solution and receives sparse execution feedback, often a single pass/fail bit. Test-time scaling enriches the inference procedure by sampling multiple candidates and judging among them, but the comparative information this process reveals is discarded after inference. We argue that this information defines a dual judgment space that provides a far richer training signal: the model learns not from a

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成模型的训练仅使用单样本执行的稀疏二元（通过/失败）反馈，测试阶段生成多候选并排序的比较信息仅用于推理，没有被回用于训练，导致模型持续给看似合理但错误的代码分配高概率，生成能力提升受限；同时现有方法没有明确的机制将排序学习的判别能力迁移回生成能力。
summary.importance: 提出了生成-判断的原-对偶训练范式，证明仅在对偶判断空间做强化学习训练，不需要直接的生成奖励，就可以同时提升模型的判断能力和原生生成能力，为代码大模型、推理大模型的自训练提供了新的信号来源，对RL预训练、自改进范式的研究有重要参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DuST（对偶自训练）框架，分为三个步骤：1）从当前模型的分布中采样多个代码候选，通过沙箱执行获得每个候选的二元正确性标签；2）筛选同时包含正确和错误候选的分组，构造对偶判断任务；3）使用GRPO算法训练同一个模型，让模型学习按照执行正确性对候选排序，所有监督信号都来自模型自身生成的候选对的正确性对比，没有直接的生成奖励。核心假设是：模型在对偶空间学习区分正确和错误代码的过程中，会获得对正确性敏感的特征，这些特征可以迁移到原空间的生成任务中。
summary.experiments: 在LiveCodeBench v6数据集上验证，Qwen3-30B-Thinking模型经过DuST训练后，判断质量的NDCG提升6.2个点，Best-of-4测试缩放精度提升4.1个点，单样本生成的pass@1提升3.1个点，且不需要直接的生成奖励。该增益在5种不同基座模型（覆盖两个模型家族、3个参数规模4B到30B）上均可复现。消融实验显示：在相同排序数据上做监督微调只能提升判断能力，无法提升生成能力，而GRPO的在线强化学习可以将对偶空间的判断学习迁移回原空间的生成能力。
summary.reading_guide: 精读§3的原-对偶框架定义，理解对偶空间信号比原空间稀疏奖励更稠密的核心逻辑；重点看§4.2的消融实验部分，对比SFT和GRPO的效果差异，掌握迁移机制的关键变量。可深挖的点包括该范式向通用推理任务、数学推理任务的迁移，以及对偶任务设计的优化空间。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code generation models are only trained with sparse binary (pass/fail) feedback from single-sample execution. The comparative information generated by multi-candidate sampling and ranking during test phase is only used for inference, not reused for training, leading to the model continuously assigning high probability to plausible but incorrect code, which limits the improvement of generation capability. Meanwhile, existing methods lack a clear mechanism to transfer the discriminative ability of ranking learning back to generation capability.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a primal-dual training paradigm for generation-judgment, and proves that reinforcement learning training only in the dual judgment space, without direct generation reward, can improve both the model's judgment capability and native generation capability. It provides a new signal source for self-training of code large models and reasoning large models, and has important reference value for research on RL pretraining and self-improvement paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The DuST (Dual Self-Training) framework is proposed, which consists of three steps: 1) Sample multiple code candidates from the current model's distribution, and obtain binary correctness labels for each candidate through sandbox execution; 2) Filter groups that contain both correct and incorrect candidates to construct dual judgment tasks; 3) Train the same model using the GRPO algorithm to rank candidates according to execution correctness. All supervision signals come from the correctness comparison of candidate pairs generated by the model itself, with no direct generation reward. The core hypothesis is that during the process of learning to distinguish correct and incorrect code in the dual space, the model will acquire correctness-sensitive features that can be transferred to the generation task in the primal space.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on the LiveCodeBench v6 dataset, the Qwen3-30B-Thinking model, after DuST training, achieves 6.2 NDCG points improvement in judgment quality, 4.1 points improvement in Best-of-4 test-time scaling accuracy, and 3.1 pass@1 points improvement in single-sample generation, without direct generation reward. This gain is reproducible across 5 different base models covering two model families and three parameter scales from 4B to 30B. Ablation experiments show that supervised fine-tuning on the same ranking data can only improve judgment capability, not generation capability, while online reinforcement learning with GRPO can transfer the dual-space judgment learning back to the primal-space generation capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read the definition of the primal-dual framework in §3 to understand the core logic that dual-space signals are denser than sparse primal-space rewards. Focus on the ablation experiments in §4.2, compare the effect difference between SFT and GRPO, and master the key variables of the transfer mechanism. Potential directions for further exploration include the migration of this paradigm to general reasoning tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks, and the optimization space of dual task design.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法部分：它把推理时搜索转成排序监督，比只收集成功样本更干净，适合复现到内部代码 RLVR 管线。
recommendation.en: Read the method: converting inference-time search into ranking supervision is cleaner than success-only filtering and is a good candidate for internal code-RLVR ablations.

paper.title: Vision2Code: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating Image-to-Code Generation
paper.abstract: Image-to-code generation tests whether a vision-language model (VLM) can recover the structure of an image enough to express it as executable code. Existing benchmarks either focus on narrow visual domains, depend on paired executable reference code, or rely on generic rubrics that miss domain-specific reconstruction errors. We introduce Vision2Code, a reference-code-free benchmark and evaluation framework for multi-domain image-to-code generation. Vision2Code contains 2,169 test examples from 1

summary.core_problem: 现有图像转代码benchmark覆盖视觉域窄、依赖配对参考代码、通用评估指标遗漏域特定重构错误，无法准确评测VLM的代码生成能力
summary.importance: 基准贡献，构建了首个无参考代码的多域图像转代码评测基准，提出了与人类判断对齐度更高的评估协议
summary.technical_approach: 整合15个源数据集共2169个测试样本，覆盖图表、几何、科学图像、文档、3D场景等6大类；模型生成代码后渲染为图像，用带领域定制规则的VLM打分器评估质量，同时分离代码执行失败与重构质量的诊断指标
summary.experiments: 人工验证显示评估协议与人类判断对齐度优于现有方法，完成了多个主流SOTA VLM的图像转代码能力基准测试
summary.authors_note: 杜克大学团队，Bhuwan Dhingra为NLP与多模态领域知名研究者，长期从事语义理解相关研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image-to-code benchmarks have narrow visual domain coverage, rely on paired reference code, and generic metrics miss domain-specific reconstruction errors, failing to accurately evaluate VLM code generation capability
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, builds the first reference-free multi-domain image-to-code evaluation benchmark, proposes an evaluation protocol with higher alignment with human judgment
summary_en.technical_approach: Integrates 15 source datasets with 2169 test samples covering 6 categories including charts, geometry, scientific imagery, documents, 3D scenes; renders generated code to images, evaluates quality with VLM rater with domain-specific rubrics, and separates diagnostic metrics for code execution failures and reconstruction quality
summary_en.experiments: Human validation shows the evaluation protocol aligns better with human judgment than existing methods, completes benchmark testing of image-to-code capability for multiple mainstream SOTA VLMs
summary_en.authors_note: Duke University team, Bhuwan Dhingra is a well-known researcher in NLP and multimodal fields, focusing on semantic understanding research

recommendation.zh: 作为图像转代码方向的基准资源，仅做评测参考备查，无需精读正文
recommendation.en: Serves as a benchmark reference for image-to-code tasks, only for evaluation reference, no need for in-depth reading

paper.title: PaT: Planning-after-Trial for Efficient Test-Time Code Generation
paper.abstract: Beyond training-time optimization, scaling test-time computation has emerged as a key paradigm to extend the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, most existing methods adopt a rigid Planning-before-Trial (PbT) policy, which inefficiently allocates test-time compute by incurring planning overhead even on directly solvable problems. We propose Planning-after-Trial (PaT), an adaptive policy for code generation that invokes a planner only upon verification failure. This a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 test-time code generation 里的计算分配问题：现有很多方法默认先规划再生成，也就是对所有样本都先付出 decomposition / planning 的成本，但真实任务难度分布并不均匀，很多题目直接生成就能过。论文要回答的是，能不能把昂贵的 planning 从默认前置步骤，改成只在直接尝试失败后再触发，从而把测试时算力集中到真正困难的样本上。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练论文，也不是通用 LLM 架构论文，而是代码生成场景下的 test-time compute 策略优化。对基座研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它把“是否需要额外推理步骤”变成了一个基于失败信号的自适应决策问题，而不是固定流程，这和近来很多推理时扩展计算的工作形成了一个很实用的对照。第二，它明确展示了 heterogeneous model configuration 的价值：小模型负责高频尝试，大模型只在少数难例上承担规划角色。这种角色分工对未来训练-推理协同设计有参考意义，尤其是在把强模型能力蒸馏成流程控制器或规划器时。贡献量级上，它更像是策略层面的有效重排，而不是新的建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很直接，但设计得比较完整。作者把已有方法概括为 Planning-before-Trial，简称 PbT：先让模型做问题分解、生成子任务和顶层框架，再递归求解。PaT 则把顺序反过来。给定一个编程任务，先由 generator 模型做 Best-of-N 直接生成，得到若干候选程序；然后用构造出的测试集在沙箱里执行验证。如果其中任一候选通过全部测试，就立即返回，不再触发任何规划开销。

只有当所有候选都失败时，系统才把这视为“直接求解能力不足”的信号，调用 planner 模型做 decomposition。planner 产出一个顶层实现草案和若干子问题描述，子问题再递归地走同样的 trial-first 流程：先直接尝试，失败后再规划。所有子问题都得到通过验证的 helper functions 后，再通过 Compose 组装回父问题，并重新在父问题测试集上验证。如果组合结果仍失败，则 planner 继续介入或进入下一轮递归。

这个框架的关键不是递归本身，而是 failure-triggered planning policy。它依赖一个假设：如果 Best-of-N 的直接尝试全部失败，这更像是问题复杂度超出了 generator 的直接推理能力，而不是偶然采样失误。于是 planning 只在“失败证据”足够强时才值得付费。

论文还强调 heterogeneous configuration。M_G 和 M_P 不必是同一个模型。小模型可以承担 generator，因为大部分样本只需要廉价直接尝试；大模型则作为 planner，只在少数难题上出场，负责更复杂的 decomposition。这样把强模型算力集中在规划而不是所有 token 生成上，成本结构会更合理。

从方法视角看，这篇工作的创新不在新的训练目标，也不在新的 verifier，而在于把 execution feedback 纳入控制流设计：验证不只是最终评测，而是决定是否升级计算预算的门控信号。
summary.experiments:
实验主结论有两层。第一，PaT 相比代表性的 PbT 基线 FunCoder，在不同模型规模和 benchmark 上都取得更好的 cost-performance，比后者平均只用约 60% 的推理成本，同时性能更高。第二，异构模型配置进一步改善效率：一个小 generator 配一个强 planner，在 homogeneous 大模型方案下，性能差距可以压到不到 1%，但成本只需 31%。

引言里给出的背景数字也很说明问题：例如 Qwen3-4B 直接标准推理已经有 76% Pass@1，说明大量样本根本不需要规划；而某些先规划的方法甚至会让 4B 模型的总成本高于 32B 模型的标准推理，却还拿不到更好结果。PaT 的收益正来自对这种难度分布的利用。

阅读实验时，建议不要只看最终 pass rate，而要同时看平均调用 planner 的比例、Best-of-N 的 N 如何设置、异构组合下 generator/planner 的模型规模搭配，以及不同 benchmark 上收益是否主要来自减少简单样本的无效 planning。若正文有分 bucket 的难度分析，那部分会最能说明方法成立的条件：直接尝试成功率越高，PaT 相对 PbT 的优势通常越明显。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，理解作者为什么认为 PbT 在难度分布不均的任务上浪费算力。然后看方法部分里 PaT 的控制流：Best-of-N 直接尝试、测试验证、失败后触发 planner、递归求解子问题、Compose 回父问题。接着重点看 heterogeneous setting 的实验，因为这部分最有现实意义，也最能体现“强模型做稀缺规划，小模型做高频生成”的成本结构。最后看与 FunCoder 的对比表和成本定义，确认作者如何计算 cost-performance frontier。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses compute allocation in test-time code generation. Many existing methods follow a planning-before-trial policy: they pay the cost of decomposition and planning for every problem instance, even though a large fraction of tasks can already be solved by direct generation. The question here is whether planning can be deferred and triggered only after direct attempts fail, so that extra test-time compute is spent mainly on genuinely hard cases.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper and not a new foundation-model architecture. It is a test-time compute policy paper for code generation. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from two ideas. First, it turns the decision of whether to spend extra reasoning compute into an adaptive control problem driven by failure signals rather than a fixed pipeline. Second, it shows the practical value of heterogeneous model roles: a small model handles frequent generation attempts, while a stronger model is reserved for rare planning interventions. That division of labor is useful when thinking about future train-inference co-design, even though the contribution here is mainly at the policy level rather than the modeling level.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is simple but well structured. The paper characterizes prior systems as Planning-before-Trial (PbT): first decompose the problem, generate subproblems and a top-level scaffold, then solve recursively. PaT reverses this order. Given a coding task, a generator model first performs direct Best-of-N generation to produce candidate programs. These candidates are executed against a constructed test set in a sandboxed runtime. If any candidate passes all tests, the system returns immediately and avoids any planning overhead.

Only when all direct attempts fail does the system interpret that failure as evidence that the task exceeds the generator’s direct reasoning ability. At that point, a planner model is invoked to decompose the task into a top-level implementation plus subproblem specifications. Each subproblem is then solved recursively with the same trial-first policy: direct attempts first, planning only after failure. Once all subproblems have verified helper functions, they are composed back into the parent solution and re-verified on the parent test set. If the composed solution still fails, planning can continue recursively.

The key idea is not recursion by itself, but failure-triggered planning. The policy assumes that repeated failure under Best-of-N direct generation is a useful signal that more expensive decomposition is justified. In other words, verification is not only an evaluator; it becomes a gate for escalating compute.

The paper also emphasizes a heterogeneous configuration. The generator M_G and planner M_P need not be the same model. A small model can serve as the generator because many tasks are easy enough for cheap direct attempts, while a stronger model can serve as the planner for the minority of hard cases that require decomposition. This concentrates expensive model usage on planning rather than on all token generation.
summary_en.experiments:
There are two main empirical claims. First, PaT consistently outperforms the representative PbT baseline FunCoder on cost-performance, achieving higher performance across model scales and benchmarks while using only about 60% of the inference cost on average. Second, the heterogeneous setup improves efficiency further: a small generator paired with a strong planner can come within less than 1% of a larger homogeneous setup while using only 31% of the cost.

The motivation is supported by the paper’s background numbers. For example, standard inference with Qwen3-4B already reaches 76% Pass@1, which means a large portion of tasks do not need planning at all. Some planning-first methods can even make a 4B pipeline more expensive than standard inference with a 32B model while still underperforming. PaT gains by exploiting this difficulty distribution.

When reading the experiments, do not focus only on final pass rates. Also check how often the planner is invoked on average, how Best-of-N is configured, how generator/planner model sizes are paired in the heterogeneous setting, and whether the gains mainly come from avoiding unnecessary planning on easy instances. If the paper includes difficulty-bucket analysis, that section is especially important because it reveals when the policy is most effective: the higher the direct-solve rate, the larger the advantage of PaT over PbT.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the main figures to understand why planning-before-trial wastes compute under a skewed difficulty distribution. Then read the method section for the control flow: direct Best-of-N generation, execution-based verification, planner invocation after failure, recursive subproblem solving, and composition back to the parent task. After that, focus on the heterogeneous-model experiments, since they are the most practically relevant and best illustrate the intended cost structure: strong models for rare planning, small models for frequent generation. Finish with the comparison tables against FunCoder and the paper’s cost definition. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但它把“验证失败才升级算力”做得很干净；只看方法图和成本曲线即可，适合拿来想 post-train/test-time compute 的资源分配。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the 'escalate compute only after failed verification' policy is clean; read the method figure and cost-performance plots if you care about post-train or test-time compute allocation.

institutions: Graduate School of Artificial Intelligence, POSTECH

paper.title: Mage: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLM-Generated Executable Game Scenes Beyond Compile-Pass Rate
paper.abstract: Compile-pass rate is the dominant evaluation signal for LLM code generation, yet for multi-component domain-specific artifacts it can be actively misleading. We demonstrate this on executable game scene synthesis with a four-axis evaluation protocol (named `Mage') -- compile success, runtime success, structural fidelity, and mechanism adherence -- applied to 858 generation attempts across four open-weight LLMs (7B--30B), 26~hand-crafted Unity goal pattern playable concepts, and two automatically

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM代码生成的主流评估指标编译通过率，在多组件领域特定工件（如可执行游戏场景）的生成任务中会产生严重误导，无法检测编译通过但功能缺失、结构不符合要求等多种失效模式。
summary.importance: 该工作对代码类任务的后训练评估和训练信号设计有明确启发：单一的二元通过/失败指标无法衡量复杂结构生成的功能正确性，需要多维度的自动化评估协议，才能避免训练信号和实际需求的对齐偏差，这对复杂代码生成任务的SFT和RL训练的奖励设计有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 该工作提出四轴评估协议Mage，分别覆盖编译成功、运行时成功、结构保真度（4个子维度）、机制符合度（6个子维度）；构造了26个手工设计的Unity小游戏场景作为基准，自动提取两种粒度的中间表示（IR）：仅行为级（脚本逻辑和检查器值）、全场景级（增加被动物理对象和相机）；在四种7B-30B参数量的开源代码模型上开展控制变量实验，共完成858次生成尝试，仅改变IR粒度、模型、随机种子，其他变量（提示模板、API映射规则、真值语料）全部固定。
summary.experiments: 直接自然语言转C#的运行时通过率最高（平均43%，最强模型可达80%），但生成的场景结构和行为空洞，机制F1仅0.12，与无基线水平相当；基于行为级IR的条件生成运行时通过率降到14%，但机制F1提升到0.82-1.00；行为级IR和全场景级IR在所有评估轴上无统计显著差异（McNemar p=1.0），说明输入级的IR粒度设计已经饱和。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读研究动机和相关工作对比部分，重点关注四轴评估协议的定义和核心实验结论，预计阅读时间20分钟，无需深入实验细节和统计检验部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The dominant evaluation metric for LLM code generation, compile-pass rate, is actively misleading for generation of multi-component domain-specific artifacts such as executable game scenes. It fails to detect multiple failure modes where generated code compiles but lacks functionality or does not conform to required structural specifications.
summary_en.importance: This work provides clear insights for evaluation and training signal design for code generation post-training. Single binary pass/fail metrics cannot measure functional correctness of complex structured generation. Multi-dimensional automated evaluation protocols are required to avoid alignment drift between training signals and practical requirements, which has direct reference value for reward design in SFT and RL training for complex code generation tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: This work proposes Mage, a four-axis evaluation protocol covering compile success, runtime success, structural fidelity (4 sub-dimensions), and mechanism adherence (6 sub-dimensions). It constructs a benchmark of 26 hand-designed Unity mini-game scenes, and automatically extracts intermediate representations (IR) at two granularities: behavior-only (script logic and inspector values) and full-scene (adding passive physics objects and camera). Controlled experiments are run on four open-source code models with 7B to 30B parameters, totaling 858 generation attempts. All variables except IR granularity, model identity, and random seed (including prompt template, API mapping rules, and ground-truth corpus) are held constant.
summary_en.experiments: Direct natural language to C# generation achieves the highest runtime-pass rate (43% mean, up to 80% for the strongest model), but produces structurally and behaviorally vacuous scenes with a mechanism F1 of only 0.12, equivalent to a no-trace baseline. Conditioning on behavior-level IR reduces runtime-pass rate to 14% but increases mechanism F1 to 0.82-1.00. Behavior-only and full-scene IR show no statistically significant difference across all evaluation axes (McNemar p=1.0 across all four models), indicating that input-level IR granularity design has reached saturation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the research motivation and related work comparison. Focus on the definition of the four-axis evaluation protocol and core experimental conclusions. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes; no need to dive into experimental details or statistical testing sections.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了代码评测的核心盲区，做领域代码能力评估时可复用其四维度框架，只看评测协议和核心实验结果即可
recommendation.en: Reveals a core blind spot in code evaluation; reuse its four-dimension framework when evaluating domain-specific code ability, only read the evaluation protocol and key experiment results.

institutions: Chalmers University of Technology and University of Gothenburg

paper.title: GameGen-Verifier: Parallel Keypoint-Based Verification for LLM-Generated Games via Runtime State Injection
paper.abstract: LLM-based game generation promises to turn natural-language specifications into executable games, but progress is limited by the lack of reliable automated verification. Unlike conventional code generation, game correctness is defined over long-horizon interaction: a game may appear correct while violating core mechanics such as state updates, interaction rules, and phase transitions. Existing Agent-as-a-Verifier approaches collapse verification into open-ended gameplay, making verdicts reachabi

summary.core_problem: LLM生成游戏缺乏可靠的自动化验证——游戏正确性由长程交互定义，而现有Agent-as-a-Verifier方法将验证坍缩为开放式游戏玩法，存在可达性边界、耗时、覆盖有限等问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出基于关键点的并行验证范式GameGen-Verifier，将规范分解为可验证关键点并独立注入运行时状态进行验证。
summary.technical_approach: 将游戏规范分解为可验证关键点，每个关键点注入游戏运行时到特定目标状态，执行有界交互并根据关键点断言判断结果，实现并行验证。
summary.experiments: 实现了GGV-Harness可扩展代理框架，在120个LLM生成的游戏上与Agent-as-a-Verifier对比，具体提升数值未在摘要中完整列出。
summary.authors_note: Lionrock AI Lab和独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based game generation lacks reliable automated verification — game correctness depends on long-horizon interactions, and existing Agent-as-a-Verifier approaches reduce verification to open-ended gameplay with reachability bounds and coverage limits.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: GameGen-Verifier, a parallel keypoint-based verification paradigm that decomposes specs into verifiable keypoints with runtime state injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes game specs into verifiable keypoints; each unit patches game runtime into a target state, executes bounded interaction, and judges against keypoint assertions — enabling parallel verification.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented GGV-Harness scalable agentic harness; compared against Agent-as-a-Verifier on 120 LLM-generated games. Exact improvement metrics not fully available in the abstract snippet.
summary_en.authors_note: Lionrock AI Lab + independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 游戏生成领域的验证方法，对agent验证方法论有微弱启发但过于垂直，了解思路即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Domain-specific verification approach for game generation. Marginally inspiring for agent verification methodology but too niche — skim the idea only.

paper.title: Constraint Decay: The Fragility of LLM Agents in Backend Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents demonstrate strong performance in autonomous code generation under loose specifications. However, production-grade software requires strict adherence to structural constraints, such as architectural patterns, databases, and object-relational mappings. Existing benchmarks often overlook these non-functional requirements, rewarding functionally correct but structurally arbitrary solutions. We present a systematic study evaluating how well agents handle structural

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM代码生成Agent的评测基准忽略生产级后端代码的非功能约束（架构模式、数据库、对象关系映射等），无法衡量Agent在严格结构约束下的多文件代码生成能力。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前代码生成Agent在生产场景落地的核心短板，为代码大模型的预训练数据优化、SFT对齐目标设计提供了明确的改进方向，也补充了更贴近工业场景的代码生成评测标准。
summary.technical_approach: 基于OpenAPI规范构建评测pipeline，固定功能需求（统一API契约），系统调整非功能约束维度（框架选择、架构模式、数据库后端、对象关系映射集成），通过端到端行为测试和静态检查结合的方式，分离功能正确性和结构合规性的评估。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖8个Web框架的80个从零开始生成任务、20个功能实现任务测试集上，观测到约束衰减现象：结构约束密度提升时，Agent平均断言通过率下降30分；轻量显式框架（如Flask）下的表现明显优于重约定框架（如FastAPI）；45%的逻辑错误来自数据层缺陷，主要是查询组合错误和对象关系映射运行时违规。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章评测方法论设计、第4章约束衰减的实验结果、第5章错误根因分类，预计阅读时长20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation benchmarks for LLM code generation agents ignore non-functional constraints of production-grade backend code (architectural patterns, databases, ORM mappings, etc.), and cannot measure the multi-file code generation capability of agents under strict structural constraints.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the core gap of current code generation agents for production deployment, provides clear improvement directions for pre-training data optimization and SFT alignment target design of code LLMs, and complements code generation evaluation standards closer to industrial scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds an evaluation pipeline based on OpenAPI specifications, fixes functional requirements with a unified API contract, systematically varies non-functional constraint dimensions (framework choice, architectural pattern, database backend, ORM integration), and separates evaluation of functional correctness and structural compliance through a combination of end-to-end behavioral tests and static checks.
summary_en.experiments: On the test set covering 8 web frameworks, 80 greenfield generation tasks and 20 feature implementation tasks, the constraint decay phenomenon is observed: when structural constraint density increases, the average assertion pass rate of agents drops by 30 points; agents perform significantly better on lightweight explicit frameworks (e.g. Flask) than on convention-heavy frameworks (e.g. FastAPI); 45% of logical errors come from data layer defects, mainly incorrect query composition and ORM runtime violations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for evaluation methodology design, Chapter 4 for constraint decay experimental results, and Chapter 5 for error root cause classification. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示的 constraint decay 现象对 code agent 的评测设计有参考价值——现有 benchmark 只测功能正确性确实不够。看 §4 的实验发现部分即可
recommendation.en: The constraint decay phenomenon is informative for code agent benchmark design — existing benchmarks only measuring functional correctness is indeed insufficient. Read §4 for experimental findings only.

paper.title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems for code generation face a fundamental routing problem: the optimal orchestration topology depends on the structural complexity of the code under modification, yet existing systems select topologies without consulting the codebase. We present Retrieval-Guided Adaptive Orchestration (RGAO), an architecture that closes this loop by extracting a structural complexity vector from a hierarchical code index before selecting the orchestration topology. RGAO operates within Code-

summary.core_problem: 多智能体代码生成系统在选择编排拓扑时不参考代码库结构，导致路由决策与任务复杂度不匹配；同时缺乏对动态拓扑下资源预算的形式化保障。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将复杂度感知的LLM路由与形式化资源代数两个独立方向结合，提出可证明的预算守恒性质。
summary.technical_approach: RGAO架构：(1) 从层次化代码索引中提取结构复杂度向量，(2) 基于复杂度选择编排拓扑，(3) 在Code-Agent框架中用六维预算向量和智能体间形式化契约保障预算守恒。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完成，未提供具体实验结果、模型规模或基线对比数据。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者，无知名学术机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent code generation systems select orchestration topologies without consulting the codebase structure, leading to mismatched routing decisions; formal resource guarantees under dynamic topology are also lacking.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: combines complexity-conditioned LLM routing with formal resource algebras to yield provable budget conservation, a property neither approach admits alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: RGAO architecture: (1) extract structural complexity vectors from a hierarchical code index, (2) select orchestration topology based on complexity, (3) enforce budget conservation via formal contracts with six-dimensional budget vectors within the Code-Agent framework.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is incomplete; no specific experimental results, model sizes, or baseline comparisons are provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researchers; no notable institutional affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 形式化资源预算的思路对多智能体编排有参考价值，但与预训练研究关联较弱，扫读摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The formal budget conservation approach is mildly interesting for multi-agent orchestration but weakly related to pretraining research; glance at abstract only.

paper.title: CircuitFormer: A Circuit Language Model for Analog Topology Design from Natural Language Prompt
paper.abstract: Automating analog circuit design remains a longstanding challenge in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). While Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized software code generation, their application to analog hardware design is hindered by two critical limitations: (i) the scarcity of analog design datasets containing natural language description of a design and its corresponding netlist, and (ii) the inefficiency of general-purpose tokenizers (e.g., Byte Pair Encoding (BP

summary.core_problem: 用自然语言提示生成模拟电路拓扑和 netlist 时，缺少配对数据，且通用 BPE tokenizer 难以表达电路图结构。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个领域代码生成数据集和电路图 tokenizer；对预训练研究的可取之处在于它把“结构化符号对象如何 tokenization”做成了具体问题，但整体仍是 EDA 垂直场景。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 31,341 个模拟电路 netlist 与自然语言描述配对样本，覆盖主要电路类别；提出 Circuit Tokenizer，通过显式挖掘高频子电路来编码 netlist 连接关系，替代通用 BPE 对字符或子词的扁平切分。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明其数据集规模为 31,341 对，并强调 CKT 在可扩展性上缓解已有电路图序列化方法的瓶颈；具体模型参数量、训练 token 数、baseline 结果和提升幅度在给定摘要中不可确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Florida。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets natural-language-to-analog-netlist generation, where paired data are scarce and generic BPE tokenizers poorly capture circuit graph connectivity.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a domain dataset and a structure-aware tokenizer for circuit language modeling. The useful angle for pretraining researchers is the tokenizer design for structured symbolic objects, although the setting remains EDA-specific.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors curate 31,341 netlist-description pairs across major analog circuit classes and introduce Circuit Tokenizer, which mines frequent subcircuits to encode graph connectivity rather than flattening netlists with a generic subword tokenizer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the dataset size and claims scalability advantages over prior circuit graph sequence representations. Model scale, data budget, baselines, and quantitative gains are not available from the provided excerpt.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Florida.

recommendation.zh: 只看 tokenizer 设计即可；它是结构化符号 tokenization 的小样本案例，不是通用代码 LM 的关键进展。
recommendation.en: Skim only the tokenizer design; it is a useful structured-symbol tokenization case, not a major advance for general code LMs.

paper.title: KernelBench-X: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
paper.abstract: LLM-based Triton kernel generation has attracted significant interest, yet a fundamental empirical question remains unanswered: where does this capability break down, and why? We present KernelBench-X, a benchmark designed to answer this question through category-aware evaluation of correctness and hardware efficiency across 176 tasks in 15 categories. Our systematic comparison of five representative methods yields three main findings. First, task structure determines correctness more than metho

summary.core_problem: LLM 生成 Triton GPU kernel 的能力到底在哪些任务结构上失效，以及失败来自语义错误还是硬件效率不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码生成与系统内核生成 benchmark。KernelBench-X 用类别化任务拆解 correctness 和 performance，让评估不只看能否编译或单点加速，而是分析任务结构、方法差异和迭代修复之间的关系。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 176 个任务、15 个类别的评测集，分别评估语义正确性和硬件效率；比较五类代表性 LLM kernel 生成方法；用方差解释或 deviance 分解分析任务类别与方法设计对正确率的贡献；还研究 iterative refinement 对编译率、正确性和速度的不同影响。
summary.experiments: 主要结果包括：任务结构比方法设计更能解释语义正确性，类别解释 9.4% deviance，方法只解释 3.3%；72% Fusion 任务在五种方法下全部失败，而 Math 类任务较稳定；GEAK 迭代让编译率从 52.3% 升到 68.8%，但平均 speedup 从 1.58x 降到 1.44x，新修好的 kernel 往往比一直正确的 kernel 慢。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark asks where LLM-generated Triton kernels fail, and whether failures are driven by semantic correctness, compilation, or hardware efficiency.
summary_en.importance: KernelBench-X is a benchmark contribution for code generation and systems-oriented kernel synthesis. Its value is the category-aware breakdown of correctness and performance rather than a single pass/fail metric.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 176 tasks across 15 categories and evaluates both semantic correctness and hardware efficiency. It compares five representative generation methods, decomposes variance by task category and method, and studies how iterative refinement affects compilation, correctness, and speed.
summary_en.experiments: Task structure explains more correctness variance than method design: 9.4% explained deviance from category versus 3.3% from method. Fusion tasks are especially hard, with 72% failing across all five methods, while Math tasks are consistently solved. GEAK-style refinement raises compile rate from 52.3% to 68.8%, but average speedup drops from 1.58x to 1.44x.

recommendation.zh: 作为 kernel 生成 benchmark 备查即可；真正有用的是“修正确率和加速不一致”这个负结果。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a kernel-generation benchmark reference; the useful signal is the negative result that fixing correctness does not preserve speed.

paper.title: Exploring Pass-Rate Reward in Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit-test feedback has become a standard post-training recipe for improving large language models (LLMs) on code generation. However, the pass-all-tests binary reward can be sparse, yielding no learning signal on challenging problems where none of the sampled solutions passes all tests. A common remedy is to use the test-case pass rate as a surrogate reward.   In this work, we study pass-rate rewards in critic-free RL for code generation (e.g., GRPO and RLOO) and

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个看起来直接、但在代码 RL 里并不简单的问题：把 unit test 的 binary reward（全部通过才给 1）换成更稠密的 pass-rate reward（按通过测试比例给分），是否真的能在 critic-free RL 中带来更好的学习效果。论文关心的不只是 reward sparsity，而是更深一层的 reward alignment：部分通过的程序，是否真的比低通过率程序更接近“完全正确”。作者的结论是否定的。在 GRPO、RLOO 这类组内相对优势更新框架下，pass-rate reward 虽然更密，但并不稳定带来更高的最终 pass@k 或成功率；原因是它对“接近正确”的刻画失真，导致梯度方向噪声大、组内相互抵消，训练未必朝 full correctness 推进。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发主要有两点。第一，它提醒人们不要把“更密的奖励”直接等同于“更好的优化信号”。这和预训练里常见的 proxy mismatch 是同一类问题：目标更容易优化，不代表更接近真正想要的能力。第二，这篇工作对 RLVR 尤其是代码与推理任务很有参考价值，因为很多后续方法都默认 finer-grained verifier 会自然优于 binary verifier。这里给出的证据更克制：如果 reward 不能保持正确的排序关系，critic-free policy gradient 很容易学到 exploit test suite 的局部策略，而不是学到可泛化的程序构造能力。贡献量级不在于提出新算法，而在于把一个流行经验法则拆开，说明它何时失效、为什么失效。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，这篇论文不是做新 RL 算法，而是做严格控制变量的 reward study。作者在多个 base model、两类常见 critic-free 算法 GRPO 和 RLOO 上，对比了几种 reward 设计：标准 binary reward、直接 pass-rate reward、对测试样例重加权的 pass-rate 变体，以及先用 pass-rate 再切换到 binary 的 two-stage 方案。分析重点有两个层面。

第一层是 reward density。作者先验证 pass-rate 确实比 binary 稠密，很多 rollout 会拿到中间分，而不是全 0/1。也就是说，问题不在“信号有没有”。

第二层是 gradient direction。作者进一步看这些中间分对应的更新方向是否有用。结论是，pass-rate 不是 full correctness 的可靠 surrogate。一个程序可能靠 brute force、特判、对公开测试过拟合拿到较高 pass rate，但离真正正确还很远；反过来，一个只差边界条件或一个小 bug 的近正确程序，可能 pass rate 并不高。放到 GRPO/RLOO 里，这会带来两个后果：
1. 组内 advantage 排序失真。高 pass-rate 样本未必是最值得放大的样本。
2. 当一组 rollout 里没有任何 fully correct 解时，不同 partial solutions 对应的更新方向彼此分散，group-level update 容易抵消。

论文的机制分析围绕“miscalibration”展开：reward 更密，但与最终目标的单调关系不够好，因此 policy gradient 的有效信噪比没有随之提升。相比一些默认把 pass-rate 当作 reward shaping 的做法，这篇文章更强调 surrogate reward 的排序质量，而不是数值分辨率。
summary.experiments:
从全文可确认的实验设计看，作者做了多 base models、多算法、多 reward 形式的 controlled experiments，核心比较对象是 binary reward 与 pass-rate reward 在 critic-free RL 下的最终代码生成表现。摘要和正文前半部分给出的主结论很一致：pass-rate reward 在不同 base models、GRPO 与 RLOO 上都没有稳定超过 binary reward 的最终性能上限。

实验结果的关键观察不是单一平均分，而是训练动态和组内样本结构：
- pass-rate reward 确实提高了非零奖励样本比例，缓解了“整组全 0”的情况；
- 但最终 pass-all-tests 指标没有对应提升，说明 reward density 与 end-task gain 脱钩；
- 在困难题上，如果没有 rollout 达到 full pass，partial-pass 样本提供的优势信号方向分散，更新幅度弱；
- 一些高 pass-rate 样本表现出 shortcut 行为，说明 reward 被测试覆盖不全所误导；
- two-stage 或 reweighted 变体可以在部分阶段改善优化稳定性，但没有改变核心结论：只要 surrogate 与 full correctness 的对齐不够，最终 ceiling 仍受限。

用户给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数值、模型参数量、训练步数和具体 benchmark 分数，因此不能负责任地编造具体数字。精读时应直接核对主表、附录中的 reward ablation 表，以及分析不同难度题目分桶结果的图。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住分析部分，不建议只看摘要。优先顺序如下：
1. 先看 Introduction，明确作者不是在否认 dense reward 的价值，而是在限定 critic-free code RL 这个具体设定。
2. 再看实验主表，确认 binary、pass-rate、reweighted、two-stage 在不同 base model 和 GRPO/RLOO 下的相对关系。
3. 重点看机制分析部分，也就是 reward density 与 gradient direction 的拆分。这里是全文最有信息量的地方。要注意作者如何证明“有信号”不等于“有用信号”。
4. 看案例分析，尤其是高 pass-rate 但错误的程序，与低 pass-rate 但接近正确的程序对比。这部分最能帮助理解 miscalibration。
5. 最后看附录里的实现细节和控制变量设置，确认比较是否公平，比如 rollout 数、测试集构造、group size、归一化方式。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若你关心 RL pretrain、verifiable reward 或 reasoning/code post-training，这篇最值得看的不是方法，而是它对 reward design 的负结果和机制解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question in code RL: if binary unit-test reward is too sparse, does replacing it with test-case pass rate actually improve critic-free RL? The answer is largely no. The issue is not reward density alone, but whether pass rate is a faithful surrogate for progress toward full correctness. In GRPO- and RLOO-style training, denser rewards do provide more non-zero feedback, yet they do not reliably yield better final coding performance because partial-pass programs are often poorly ranked with respect to true correctness.
summary_en.importance: The main value is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. It challenges a common assumption in RLVR for code and reasoning: that a denser verifier signal should naturally make optimization better. The paper shows that this is only true when the surrogate preserves useful ordering. If not, critic-free policy gradients can amplify shortcut solutions, overfitting to the visible test suite instead of moving toward genuinely correct programs. For people working on the pretrain–posttrain interface, this is a clean example of proxy mismatch: an easier objective can still be a worse training signal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is a controlled reward-design study rather than a new RL method. It compares several reward choices under two critic-free policy-gradient algorithms, GRPO and RLOO, across multiple pretrained code-capable base models. The reward variants include standard binary reward, direct pass-rate reward, reweighted pass-rate variants, and two-stage schedules that combine dense and sparse rewards.

The analysis has two layers. First, the authors verify that pass-rate rewards are indeed denser: many rollouts receive intermediate scores instead of collapsing to all-zero feedback. So the failure mode is not the absence of signal.

Second, they study whether those intermediate rewards induce useful gradient directions. Their central claim is that pass rate is miscalibrated with respect to full correctness. A program can achieve a high pass rate through brittle heuristics, memorized patterns, or overfitting to the provided tests while still being far from correct. Conversely, a nearly correct solution with a small bug may receive only a modest pass rate. Under group-relative updates, this causes ranking errors inside the sampled batch. When no rollout fully solves the problem, different partial solutions push the policy in different directions, and the resulting update tends to be weak or cancel out.

This is the key distinction from naive reward shaping: the paper argues that numerical granularity is not enough. What matters is whether the surrogate reward preserves a meaningful optimization geometry toward the target behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a reward-analysis paper, not a methods paper. Start with the introduction to see the exact claim boundary: the paper is not saying dense rewards are useless in general, only that pass-rate rewards are unreliable in critic-free code RL. Then inspect the main comparison tables for binary vs. pass-rate vs. hybrid variants under GRPO and RLOO. The most important section is the mechanistic analysis of reward density versus gradient direction. That is where the paper earns its point. The case studies contrasting high-pass-rate wrong programs with lower-pass-rate near-correct programs are also worth attention. Finally, check the appendix for rollout settings, group size, normalization, and fairness of the controlled comparisons.

Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它直接拆穿了“稠密奖励天然更好”这个偷懒 prior；先看梯度分析部分，若 setup 干净，代码 RL 的 reward design 该立刻重做一轮内测。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it attacks the lazy prior that denser rewards are automatically better; read the gradient analysis first, and if the setup is clean, revisit your code-RL reward design ablations.

paper.title: Themis: Training Robust Multilingual Code Reward Models for Flexible Multi-Criteria Scoring
paper.abstract: Reward models (RMs) have become an indispensable fixture of the language model (LM) post-training playbook, enabling policy alignment and test-time scaling. Research on the application of RMs in code generation, however, has been comparatively sparse, with existing work largely focusing on execution feedback. This choice constrains post-training to optimizing functional correctness over self-contained executable code. In this work, we examine the training and evaluation of multilingual, multi-cr

summary.core_problem: 代码奖励模型长期只盯功能正确性，难以对代码质量做多维、跨语言、可用于后训练的稳定打分。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在后训练基础设施而非预训练本身：一是做了多语言、多维度代码 RM benchmark；二是构建了 35 万+ 偏好对数据集；三是训练可做灵活多标准评分的代码奖励模型。这对代码模型的 RL/DPO 管线有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先构建 Themis-CodeRewardBench，在 8 种编程语言、5 个偏好维度上系统评测 50+ 代码/数学/通用奖励模型；随后整理 Themis-CodePreference 偏好数据集，并基于该数据训练 Themis 系列代码奖励模型，目标是让 RM 不只学会执行正确性，还能覆盖风格、可读性、效率等多标准偏好。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键信息包括：8 种语言、5 个偏好维度、50+ 奖励模型评测、35 万+ 偏好对。论文核心实验应是 benchmark profiling 与新训练 RM 的跨语言泛化和多维打分能力对比；但从摘要看，它更像数据与评测驱动的 RM 工作，而不是 clean 的大规模 policy optimization 研究。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Würzburg 的 Center for Artificial Intelligence and Data Science，团队在多语言 NLP、评测与偏好建模上较活跃；不是顶级实验室的范式型代码后训练工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Code reward models have mostly focused on functional correctness, making them weak at robust multi-criteria scoring across languages for post-training.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly post-training infrastructure rather than pretraining: a multilingual, multi-criteria benchmark for code RMs, a 350k+ preference dataset, and trained reward models for flexible code scoring. This is directly useful for RL/DPO pipelines on code models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first builds Themis-CodeRewardBench to evaluate 50+ code, math, and general-purpose reward models across 8 programming languages and 5 preference dimensions. It then introduces Themis-CodePreference, a large preference dataset, and trains Themis reward models to score code beyond execution correctness, including broader quality dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: Key numbers from the abstract are 8 languages, 5 criteria, 50+ reward models profiled, and 350k+ preference pairs. The main experiments likely center on benchmark profiling and cross-lingual, multi-criteria generalization of the trained RMs. From the abstract, this looks more like a data-and-evaluation paper than a clean large-scale policy optimization study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Center for Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at the University of Würzburg, a group active in multilingual NLP, evaluation, and preference modeling. This is not a top-lab paradigm paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 code RL/RM，这篇可当数据与评测底座看；但它不改变 pretrain prior，读 benchmark 设计和 error breakdown 就够了。
recommendation.en: Useful as infrastructure for code RL/RM, but it does not move pretraining priors; read the benchmark design and failure breakdown, then stop.

paper.title: Social Bias in LLM-Generated Code: Benchmark and Mitigation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to generate code for human-centered applications where demographic fairness is critical. However, existing evaluations focus almost exclusively on functional correctness, leaving social bias in LLM-generated code largely unexamined. Extending our prior work on Solar, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study using SocialBias-Bench, a benchmark of 343 real-world coding tasks spanning seven demographic dimensions. We evaluate four prominent L

summary.core_problem: 评测并缓解 LLM 生成代码在面向人的应用中引入的人口统计偏见。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码安全与公平性 benchmark。论文指出现有代码模型评测过度关注功能正确性，较少检查生成代码在性别、种族等人口维度上的差别对待；SocialBias-Bench 用 343 个真实风格 coding task 覆盖 7 个维度。
summary.technical_approach: 作者评测 4 个主流 LLM 在 SocialBias-Bench 上的 Code Bias Score，并比较几类干预：普通提示、Chain-of-Thought、公平性 persona，以及结构化多 Agent 软件流程。多 Agent 流程通过早期角色约束需求边界，减少代码中不应使用的人口属性。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 包含 343 个 coding tasks 和 7 个人口统计维度。摘要报告所有 4 个模型都有明显偏见，Code Bias Score 最高达到 60.58%；CoT 和公平性 persona 可能放大偏见；结构化多 Agent 流程在早期需求界定正确时能降低偏见。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Concordia University 和 York University。该方向更接近代码 Agent 评测与安全，不是代码模型预训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and mitigates demographic bias in LLM-generated code for human-centered applications.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding safety and fairness benchmark. It argues that current code-generation evaluation focuses heavily on functional correctness while under-measuring demographic bias. SocialBias-Bench contains 343 realistic coding tasks across seven demographic dimensions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate four prominent LLMs using a Code Bias Score and test prompt-level interventions such as Chain-of-Thought and fairness personas. They also study structured multi-agent software processes, where early roles define what the code should and should not consider.
summary_en.experiments: SocialBias-Bench has 343 coding tasks across seven demographic dimensions. The abstract reports severe bias across all four models, with Code Bias Scores up to 60.58%. CoT and fairness personas can amplify bias, while structured multi-agent workflows reduce bias when early scoping is correct.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Concordia University and York University. The work is closer to code-agent evaluation and safety than to code-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 作为代码评测备查即可；有用点是 CoT/persona 放大偏见，别把提示工程当安全修复。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a coding-eval reference; the useful signal is that CoT/persona prompting can amplify bias, so do not treat prompting as a safety fix.

paper.title: Improving LLM Code Generation via Requirement-Aware Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Code generation, which aims to automatically generate source code from given programming requirements, has the potential to substantially improve software development efficiency. With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based code generation has attracted widespread attention from both academia and industry. However, as programming requirements become increasingly complex, existing LLMs still exhibit notable performance limitations. To address this challenge, recent studie

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂编程需求下 LLM 代码生成性能不足，以及现有 curriculum reinforcement learning 对需求难度估计和采样策略不够匹配的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码生成后训练方法改进。它聚焦 requirement-aware curriculum RL，把训练课程从粗粒度样本排序改成围绕编程需求难度进行感知、优化和采样。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出面向代码生成的需求感知课程强化学习框架，核心是重新建模 requirement difficulty，优化需求难度评估，并改进 curriculum sampling，使模型从更合适的难度序列中学习。属于对已有 CRL 思路的任务特化改进。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出基础模型规模、代码数据集、奖励定义、baseline 列表和通过率提升。需要看是否在 HumanEval、MBPP 或更复杂的需求集合上对比普通 SFT、RL、现有 CRL，并确认提升是否来自更强的样本筛选而非额外数据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自天津大学和大连海事大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses weak LLM code generation under complex programming requirements and the mismatch between existing curriculum RL strategies and requirement difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method improvement for code generation. Its main contribution is requirement-aware curriculum reinforcement learning, shifting the curriculum signal toward difficulty perception, optimization, and sampling over programming requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds a requirement-aware CRL framework for code generation. It redefines or estimates requirement difficulty, optimizes that difficulty signal, and uses an improved curriculum sampling strategy so the model is trained on a better difficulty progression. It is a task-specific extension of existing CRL ideas.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide base model sizes, code datasets, reward definitions, baselines, or pass-rate gains. The key checks are whether it evaluates on HumanEval, MBPP, or harder requirement sets against SFT, RL, and prior CRL, and whether gains come from the curriculum rather than extra filtering data.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tianjin University and Dalian Maritime University.

recommendation.zh: 偏代码任务的 curriculum RL 增量；只看实验设置和消融，重点排查 difficulty estimator 是否泄漏测试分布。
recommendation.en: This looks like incremental curriculum RL for code; only inspect the setup and ablations, especially whether the difficulty estimator leaks the test distribution.

paper.title: HAVEN: Hybrid Automated Verification ENgine for UVM Testbench Synthesis with LLMs
paper.abstract: Integrated Circuit (IC) verification consumes nearly 70% of the IC development cycle, and recent research leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate testbenches and reduce verification overhead. However, LLMs have difficulty generating testbenches correctly. Unlike high-level programming languages, Hardware Description Languages (HDLs) are extremely rare in LLMs training data, leading LLMs to produce incorrect code. To overcome challenges when using LLMs to generate Univers

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 直接生成 UVM 硬件验证 testbench 时错误率高、协议时序难以保证的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向硬件验证的代码生成系统工作，贡献在于把 LLM 从直接写 HDL/UVM 代码改为生成结构化计划，再由模板引擎保证协议和时序正确性；对通用代码 Agent 有一些工程启发，但领域性较强。
summary.technical_approach: HAVEN 使用 LLM agent 解析设计规格并生成结构化架构计划，避免让模型直接输出底层 HDL/UVM 细节；随后由 HAVEN Template Engine 结合预定义模板和协议特定模板生成 UVM components，并引入面向协议的 sequence 生成流程，以减少总线握手和验证语义错误。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体基准、模型、样本量或提升幅度。实验预计评估生成 UVM testbench 和 sequence 的正确率、编译通过率、协议时序正确性，以及相对直接 LLM 生成的改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自台湾阳明交通大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the high error rate of LLM-generated UVM testbenches, especially failures in HDL details and protocol timing.
summary_en.importance: This is a hardware-verification code-generation system. Its main idea is to keep the LLM at the planning level and delegate low-level UVM/HDL construction to protocol-aware templates. It is useful as an engineering pattern for code agents, but the domain is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: HAVEN uses LLM agents to analyze design specifications and produce structured architectural plans rather than raw HDL. A template engine then combines predefined and protocol-specific templates to generate UVM components with correct bus-handshake timing, with a separate protocol-aware flow for UVM sequence generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, model choices, dataset size, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation measures UVM testbench and sequence correctness, compilation success, protocol timing validity, and improvement over direct LLM generation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统分工思路即可：让 LLM 做计划、模板管约束；硬件验证领域太窄，不值得深读。
recommendation.en: Skim the division of labor—LLM for planning, templates for constraints; the hardware-verification setting is too narrow for a full read.
