paper.title: ClassEval-Pro: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Class-Level Code Generation
paper.abstract: LLMs have achieved strong results on both function-level code synthesis and repository-level code modification, yet a capability that falls between these two extremes -- compositional code creation, i.e., building a complete, internally structured class from a specification -- remains underserved. Current evaluations are either confined to isolated functions or rely on manually curated class-level tasks that are expensive to scale and increasingly susceptible to data contamination. We introduce

summary.core_problem: 补足函数级代码生成与仓库级代码编辑之间的评测空档，系统评估模型从规格生成完整类结构的能力。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。对基座预训练研究员的价值有限，但 class-level compositional code generation 确实比函数补全更接近真实软件构造，也更容易暴露训练数据污染与组合泛化问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ClassEval-Pro，包含 300 个跨 11 个领域的类级代码生成任务，使用自动化三阶段流程构建：复杂度增强、跨域类组合，以及引入 2025 年 1 月之后的 GitHub 代码以降低污染风险。再用 LLM Judge Ensemble 和高覆盖率测试套件做验证。
summary.experiments: 评测 5 个前沿模型和 5 种生成策略。摘要给出的关键结果是最优模型 class-level Pass@1 只有 45.6%，说明类级组合式代码生成仍明显弱于常见函数级基准。没有看到与训练数据、模型规模或 repo-level agent 的更细分诊断，需要正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark targets the gap between function-level code generation and repository-level code editing by evaluating whether models can generate a complete, internally structured class from a specification.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark contribution. Its relevance to a pretraining researcher is limited, but class-level compositional code generation is closer to real software construction and can better expose contamination and compositional generalization issues.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces ClassEval-Pro, a 300-task benchmark across 11 domains, built with an automated three-stage pipeline: complexity enhancement, cross-domain class composition, and integration of GitHub code contributed after January 2025 to reduce contamination. Tasks are validated with an LLM judge ensemble and high-coverage test suites.
summary_en.experiments: Five frontier LLMs and five generation strategies are evaluated. The headline result is that the best model reaches only 45.6% class-level Pass@1, suggesting that compositional class construction remains substantially unsolved. The provided text does not include deeper breakdowns by model scale, training data, or repo-level agent behavior.

recommendation.zh: 基准本身还算干净，能提醒你函数级代码能力被高估了；但这是评测不是方法，读 headline number 和污染控制设计就够，不必深读正文。
recommendation.en: The benchmark is reasonably clean and usefully shows that function-level coding ability overstates real class construction, but this is evaluation rather than method—read the headline number and contamination controls, then move on.

paper.title: OMEGA: Optimizing Machine Learning by Evaluating Generated Algorithms
paper.abstract: In order to automate AI research we introduce a full, end-to-end framework, OMEGA: Optimizing Machine learning by Evaluating Generated Algorithms, that starts at idea generation and ends with executable code. Our system combines structured meta-prompt engineering with executable code generation to create new ML classifiers. The OMEGA framework has been utilized to generate several novel algorithms that outperform scikit-learn baselines across a robust selection of 20 benchmark datasets (infinity

summary.core_problem: 现有自动ML研究无法实现从算法想法生成到可执行代码的端到端自动化，生成算法泛化性差
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出端到端ML算法生成框架，推出配套Python包供落地使用
summary.technical_approach: 结合结构化元提示工程与可执行代码生成，遍历算法设计空间生成新的ML分类器
summary.experiments: 在20个基准数据集（infinity-bench）上生成的算法性能超过scikit-learn基线
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学计算机系、Infinity AI研究院团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated ML research cannot implement end-to-end automation from algorithm idea generation to executable code, and generated algorithms have poor generalization
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes an end-to-end ML algorithm generation framework, and releases supporting Python package for deployment
summary_en.technical_approach: Combines structured meta-prompt engineering with executable code generation to traverse algorithm design space and generate new ML classifiers
summary_en.experiments: Generated algorithms outperform scikit-learn baselines on 20 benchmark datasets (infinity-bench)
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Stanford University, Infinity Artificial Intelligence Institute

recommendation.zh: 仅作为自动ML Agent的参考案例，无需精读，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Only for reference as an auto-ML agent case, no need to read full text, just check the abstract

paper.title: Aligned Multi-View Scripts for Universal Chart-to-Code Generation
paper.abstract: Chart-to-code generation converts a chart image into an executable plotting script, enabling faithful reproduction and editable visualizations. Existing methods are largely Python-centric, limiting practical use and overlooking a critical source of supervision: the same chart can be expressed by semantically equivalent scripts in different plotting languages. To fill this gap, we introduce Chart2NCode, a dataset of 176K charts paired with aligned scripts in Python, R, and LaTeX that render visua

summary.core_problem: 解决 chart image 到可执行绘图代码生成时过度依赖 Python、缺少多语言等价监督的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据和轻量适配方法：Chart2NCode 提供 176K 图表及 Python、R、LaTeX 对齐脚本，能支持更贴近实际编辑需求的 chart-to-code 评测与训练。
summary.technical_approach: 数据侧用 metadata-to-template 流水线生成多语言脚本，并通过渲染验证和人工质检保证视觉等价；模型侧基于 LLaVA 风格架构，提出 CharLuMA，在多模态 projector 上加入语言条件的低秩子空间混合，让共享视觉理解和目标绘图库/语言专门化解耦。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，但未给出完整模型规模、训练 token、baseline 名称或提升幅度；可确认的是任务覆盖 Python、R、LaTeX 三种输出语言，并围绕视觉等价的 chart reproduction 评估。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore Management University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets chart-to-code generation beyond Python-only settings, where the same chart should be reproducible as executable scripts in multiple plotting languages.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a dataset and adaptation contribution: Chart2NCode contains 176K charts aligned with visually equivalent Python, R, and LaTeX scripts, enabling multi-language supervision for editable chart reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built with a metadata-to-template pipeline, rendering verification, and human quality checks. The model, CharLuMA, follows a LLaVA-style design and adds a language-conditioned mixture of low-rank subspaces to the multimodal projector, sharing chart understanding while routing generation toward the target language.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments but does not expose model sizes, data scale beyond the dataset, named baselines, or numeric gains. The confirmed setup evaluates chart reproduction across Python, R, and LaTeX.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Singapore Management University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 到结构化代码输出的数据点可扫，CharLuMA 更像任务适配模块，不会改变预训练侧 prior。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a VLM-to-structured-code data point; CharLuMA is task adaptation rather than a pretraining-level idea.

paper.title: MEMCoder: Multi-dimensional Evolving Memory for Private-Library-Oriented Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at general code generation, but their performance drops sharply in enterprise settings that rely on internal private libraries absent from public pre-training corpora. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers a training-free alternative by providing static API documentation, we find that such documentation typically provides only isolated definitions, leaving a fundamental knowledge gap. Specifically, LLMs struggle with a task-level lack of coordinatio

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在企业私有库代码生成中不了解内部 API 用法、参数约束和跨 API 协作模式的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码生成系统方法。它不是预训练工作，但触及一个真实缺口：私有库知识很难出现在公开预训练语料中，静态 RAG 文档又常常只给 API 定义，不能教会任务级组合模式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MEMCoder，一个面向私有库的多维演化记忆框架。系统从模型自己的解题轨迹中蒸馏 Usage Guidelines，并沿任务级 API 协作模式和 API 级参数/边界条件两条维度累积更新；推理时使用 dual-source retrieval，同时注入静态文档和动态记忆。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、私有库 benchmark 名称、baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的对比对象包括 training-free 的静态文档 RAG，目标场景是 enterprise/private-library-oriented code generation。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsinghua University College of AI。未能从给定信息确认作者在代码模型或 LLM 预训练方向的知名代表作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses code generation for enterprise private libraries, where LLMs lack knowledge of internal APIs, parameter constraints, boundary cases, and coordination patterns across APIs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a code-generation system method rather than pretraining. The useful observation is that private-library knowledge is absent from public pretraining corpora, and static RAG over API docs often provides definitions without executable usage patterns.
summary_en.technical_approach: MEMCoder introduces a multi-dimensional evolving memory. It distills usage guidelines from the model's own problem-solving trajectories, maintaining task-level API coordination patterns and API-level parameter or boundary-condition knowledge. At inference time, dual-source retrieval injects both static documentation and evolved memory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmark names, baseline details, or improvement numbers. The main baseline implied is training-free static documentation RAG, and the target setting is private-library-oriented code generation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the College of AI at Tsinghua University. No widely known prior work by the listed authors in code models or LLM pretraining can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和记忆更新规则即可；它对预训练无直接动作，但私有 API 的知识形态分析是有用负样本。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and memory-update rule only; it does not change pretraining, but its analysis of private-API knowledge is a useful failure case.

paper.title: No Test Cases, No Problem: Distillation-Driven Code Generation for Scientific Workflows
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) frameworks for code generation typically use execution feedback and improve iteratively using Input/Output (I/O) test cases. However, this does not work for scientific workflows, where I/O test cases do not exist, and generating them requires solving the very problem at hand. To address this, we introduce MOSAIC, a training-free multi-agent framework for scientific code generation without I/O supervision. Instead of execution feedback, MOSAIC emplo

summary.core_problem: 解决科学工作流代码生成缺少 I/O 测试用例时，LLM 多 Agent 框架无法依赖执行反馈迭代改进的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向代码 Agent 的训练无关框架，重点在无测试用例场景下的生成约束和幻觉缓解。它不是通用代码模型训练方法，也不提供预训练或后训练信号，但对 test-free code generation 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MOSAIC，用 student-teacher 式知识蒸馏组织多 Agent 生成：教师侧利用领域示例和结构化问题分解来约束学生生成，而不是依赖 I/O execution feedback；同时提出 Consolidated Context Window，将链式子问题中的上下文合并，减少跨 Agent 推理不一致和幻觉。
summary.experiments: 在 SciCode benchmark 上评估，指标包括 accuracy、executability 和 numerical precision。摘要称 MOSAIC 使用轻量模型即可优于已有方法，但未给出模型名称、参数量、样本规模或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Purdue University 和 Argonne National Laboratory。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses scientific code generation when no I/O test cases are available, making execution-feedback-based multi-agent refinement ineffective.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free coding-agent framework for test-free generation and hallucination reduction. It is not a general code-model training method and does not provide a pretraining or post-training signal, but it is a useful reference for code generation without executable supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: MOSAIC uses a student-teacher distillation-style multi-agent setup. Instead of relying on I/O execution feedback, it grounds generation in domain-specific examples and structured problem decomposition. A Consolidated Context Window maintains consistent context across chained subproblems to reduce hallucinations between agents.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on the SciCode benchmark using accuracy, executability, and numerical precision. The abstract claims improvements over existing approaches with lightweight models, but does not report model names, parameter counts, dataset sizes, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Purdue University and Argonne National Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 作为 no-test code agent 的备查即可；真正可迁移的点是 CCW，上升不到代码模型训练方法。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a no-test code-agent reference; the portable idea is the consolidated context window, not a code-model training recipe.

paper.title: Fix Initial Codes and Iteratively Refine Textual Directions Toward Safe Multi-Turn Code Correction
paper.abstract: Recent work on large language models (LLMs) has emphasized the importance of scaling inference compute. From this perspective, the state-of-the-art method Scattered Forest Search (SFS) has been proposed, employing Monte Carlo Tree Search with carefully crafted initial seeds and textual optimization for multi-turn code correction. However, its complexity makes it unclear what factors contribute to improvements in inference performance. To address this problem, we analyze SFS and propose a simpler

summary.core_problem: 现有多轮代码纠错SOTA方法SFS依赖复杂MCTS结构，无法明确性能提升的核心贡献因子
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出更简化的多轮代码纠错方法，首次给出该任务的理论安全证明
summary.technical_approach: 提出IRTD方法，固定初始代码，迭代优化文本修正方向，基于OGIS理论证明方法安全性
summary.experiments: 在多个代码生成基准上，IRTD性能与带复杂MCTS的SFS方法相当
summary.authors_note: 东京大学计算机科学系团队

summary_en.core_problem: State-of-the-art multi-turn code correction method SFS relies on complex MCTS structure, making it hard to identify core contributors to performance gain.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes simpler multi-turn code correction approach with first theoretical safety proof for this task.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose IRTD, which fixes initial codes and iteratively refines textual correction directions, with safety proof based on OGIS framework.
summary_en.experiments: IRTD achieves comparable performance to SFS with complex MCTS on multiple code generation benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Department of Computer Science, The University of Tokyo team

recommendation.zh: SFS简化方案，仅看摘要和实验结果即可，无预训练相关核心启发。
recommendation.en: Simplified alternative to SFS, only read abstract and experiment results, no core insight for pretraining.

paper.title: Leveraging LLMs for Multi-File DSL Code Generation: An Industrial Case Study
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on general-purpose code generation, yet their applicability to enterprise domain-specific languages (DSLs) remains underexplored, especially for repository-scale change generation spanning multiple files and folder structures from a single natural-language (NL) instruction. We report an industrial case study at BMW that adapts code-oriented LLMs to generate and modify project-root DSL artifacts for an Xtext-based DSL that drives downstream Java/TypeS

summary.core_problem: 评估并适配代码 LLM 以完成企业 DSL 的多文件、仓库级代码生成与修改。
summary.importance: 这是工业代码生成案例研究，不是基座模型方法论文；但它涉及 repository-scale 表示、跨文件依赖建模和小模型适配，对代码模型数据组织与评测设计有一点实务参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建端到端流程：从企业 DSL 项目中制作数据集，把文件夹层级编码成保留路径信息的 JSON，使模型能在单次响应中生成整个项目根目录下的多文件工件；然后比较 baseline prompting、one-shot ICL 与参数高效微调在 Qwen2.5-Coder/DeepSeek-Coder 7B 上的表现。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是两个 7B instruction-tuned code LLM，任务为 Xtext-based DSL 的仓库级生成与修改。摘要未给出明确提升幅度或强基线，只能判断其价值主要在工业任务定义和数据表示，而非方法突破。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Technical University of Munich 与 BMW Group 的工业案例研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to adapt code LLMs for repository-scale, multi-file generation and editing in an enterprise domain-specific language.
summary_en.importance: This is an industrial code-generation case study rather than a foundation-model methods paper, but it offers some practical signal on repository-scale representations, cross-file dependency handling, and evaluation design for code models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build an end-to-end pipeline: dataset construction from enterprise DSL projects, path-preserving JSON serialization of folder hierarchies so the model can emit multi-file artifacts in one response, and comparison of baseline prompting, one-shot ICL, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning on Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder 7B.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use two 7B instruction-tuned code LLMs on Xtext-based DSL generation and modification tasks. The abstract does not provide clear effect sizes or strong baselines, so the main value appears to be in task formulation and data representation rather than a methodological advance.
summary_en.authors_note: An industrial case study from Technical University of Munich and BMW Group.

recommendation.zh: 典型工业 case study，方法新意有限；若你关心代码数据如何序列化成仓库级训练样本，只看 JSON 表示和评测设定。
recommendation.en: A standard industrial case study with limited novelty; only read the data serialization and evaluation setup if you care about repo-scale code training examples.

paper.title: CharTide: Data-Centric Chart-to-Code Generation via Tri-Perspective Tuning and Inquiry-Driven Evolution
paper.abstract: Chart-to-code generation demands strict visual precision and syntactic correctness from Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, existing approaches are fundamentally constrained by data-centric limitations: despite the availability of growing chart-to-code datasets, simply scaling homogeneous chart-code pairs conflates visual perception with program logic, preventing models from fully leveraging the richness of multimodal supervision. We present CharTide, a novel data-centric framework that syst

summary.core_problem: 解决chart-to-code任务中，现有VLM训练数据把视觉感知与代码逻辑混在一起，导致模型难以同时学好图表理解、程序结构和跨模态对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在数据设计与后训练接口，而不是新基座架构。它有两点值得看：一是把训练数据拆成视觉、纯文本代码、模态融合三路，二是把对齐从启发式打分改成可验证的询问式RL，这对“如何构造训练信号”有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CharTide数据中心框架。先用Tri-Perspective Tuning构建200万样本数据，将训练显式分为视觉感知、纯文本代码逻辑和视觉-代码融合三种视角；再提出Inquiry-Driven RL，把对齐视为数据验证问题，通过询问和核验生成结果来提供更可靠的奖励信号，而不是依赖粗糙的启发式评分。
summary.experiments: 摘要称使用2M样本训练，7B模型仅靠监督训练就超过专门基线；随后再用Inquiry-Driven RL进一步提升。任务是chart-to-code生成，评价应同时覆盖视觉精度与代码可执行/语法正确性。没有看到能直接外推到通用LLM预训练的clean scaling或架构结论，因此更适合作为数据与训练信号设计案例阅读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、Shopee、华东师范大学、南京理工大学、中南大学等。Alex Jinpeng Wang在多模态与医疗AI方向较活跃，但这篇工作更像面向图表代码生成的数据与对齐工程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets chart-to-code generation, arguing that existing VLM training data entangles visual perception and code logic, which prevents models from learning both reliably.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is in data design and post-training signal design rather than a new foundation architecture. Two parts are relevant: decomposing training data into visual, pure-code, and fusion streams, and reframing alignment as verifiable inquiry-driven RL instead of heuristic scoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: CharTide is a data-centric framework. It first builds a 2M-sample dataset with Tri-Perspective Tuning, explicitly separating visual perception, text-only code logic, and multimodal fusion supervision. It then introduces Inquiry-Driven RL, where alignment is treated as a data-verification problem through question-and-check style reward construction rather than heuristic reward proxies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that a 7B model trained on the 2M dataset surpasses specialized baselines using supervised training alone, and improves further with inquiry-driven RL. The task evaluates both visual fidelity and code correctness. However, the paper does not appear to offer clean scaling or architectural conclusions that transfer directly to general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Nanjing University, Shopee, East China Normal University, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, and Central South University. Alex Jinpeng Wang is known in multimodal and medical AI, but this work is primarily a data-and-alignment engineering effort for chart-to-code generation.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座论文，但“把监督拆成感知/逻辑/融合三路”这个数据配方值得借鉴；只看数据构造和RL奖励定义，别被任务指标带跑。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but the split of supervision into perception/logic/fusion is a useful recipe; read the data design and reward construction, not the task leaderboard.

institutions: Nanjing University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Feedback Over Form: Why Execution Feedback Matters More Than Pipeline Topology in 1-3B Code Generation
paper.abstract: Small language models (1-3B) are practical to run locally, but individually limited on harder code generation tasks. We ask whether composing them into pipelines can recover some of that lost capability. We study code generation pipelines built from 1-3B models with execution feedback, and use a NEAT-inspired evolutionary search to test whether more complex pipeline structure helps beyond a simple refinement loop. We evaluate on HumanEval (164 problems) and sanitized MBPP (427 problems), all wit

summary.core_problem: 在 1-3B 小模型本地代码生成场景中，复杂 pipeline 拓扑是否真的比简单的执行反馈自改循环更重要。
summary.importance: 价值不在提出新模型，而在给一个常见直觉降温：小模型代码 agent 的收益主要来自 execution feedback，而不是把流程图堆复杂。对做代码 agent 或训练数据闭环的人有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较多种由 1-3B 模型组成的代码生成 pipeline，并引入受 NEAT 启发的进化搜索来探索更复杂的 pipeline 结构。核心对照是：复杂拓扑 versus 简单 self-refinement loop，且都接入执行反馈。论文还细分了错误类型，分析改进究竟来自修复哪类错误。
summary.experiments: 评测在 HumanEval（164 题）和 sanitized MBPP（427 题）上进行，全部使用单台笔记本本地推理。结果显示，带执行反馈的 self-refinement 在两个 benchmark 上都带来超过 4 个标准差的提升；但收益机制较窄，主要修复 NameError、SyntaxError 等运行时错误，对 AssertionError 这类逻辑错误帮助有限。作者还发现 refiner 的能力比 generator 身份更关键，1.5B generator + 3B refiner 可接近单个 3B 模型同时承担两角色的效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether, for local 1-3B code generation, complex multi-stage pipelines matter more than a simple refinement loop with execution feedback.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mostly negative but useful: it pushes back on the intuition that better pipeline topology is the main lever. For small-model coding agents, execution feedback appears to dominate architectural complexity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author studies multiple code-generation pipelines built from 1-3B models and uses a NEAT-inspired evolutionary search to explore more complex topologies. The key comparison is between sophisticated pipeline structures and a simple self-refinement loop, both equipped with execution feedback. Error categories are analyzed to identify where gains actually come from.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on HumanEval (164 problems) and sanitized MBPP (427 problems), all with local inference on a single laptop. Self-refinement with execution feedback improves performance by more than four standard deviations on both benchmarks. The gains are narrow in mechanism: runtime errors such as NameError and SyntaxError are often fixed, while logic errors like AssertionError are rarely repaired. The paper also finds that refiner quality matters more than generator identity: a 1.5B generator plus a 3B refiner can match a 3B model doing both roles.

recommendation.zh: 增量但结论干净：别把小模型代码 agent 的收益误记到 pipeline 花活上，读错误类型分析即可，正文不用细抠。
recommendation.en: Incremental but clean: don’t over-credit fancy pipeline topology in small-model coding agents; the error-type breakdown is the only part really worth your time.

paper.title: Call-Chain-Aware LLM-Based Test Generation for Java Projects
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for generating project-level unit tests. However, existing state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on execution-path information to guide prompt construction, which is often insufficient for complex software systems with rich inter-class dependencies, deep call chains, and intricate object initialization requirements. In this paper, we present CAT, a novel call-chain-aware LLM-based test generation approach that explicitly inco

summary.core_problem: 提升 LLM 在 Java 项目级单元测试生成中的可执行性与语义有效性，尤其处理深调用链和复杂依赖。
summary.importance: 这是代码智能/软件工程方向的 prompt+静态分析增强方法，价值主要在仓库级上下文构造，而不是新的 LLM 训练或 agent 范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CAT，通过静态分析显式抽取 caller-callee 关系、对象构造器和第三方依赖，把 call-chain-aware 上下文注入 prompt；同时加入迭代式 test fixing 处理首次生成失败。
summary.experiments: 在 Defects4J 和 4 个晚于模型 cutoff 的 GitHub 项目上评估，比较现有 LLM-based test generation 方法，报告在可执行率、覆盖率或缺陷触发能力上的提升。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Limerick、University of Ottawa、浙江大学及华为，属于软件工程与工业代码智能合作团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves project-level Java unit test generation with LLMs by handling deep call chains and complex inter-class dependencies more explicitly.
summary_en.importance: This is a software-engineering and code-intelligence paper. Its main value lies in repository-level context construction via static analysis, not in a new LLM training paradigm or agent architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAT augments prompts with call-chain-aware context extracted through static analysis, including caller-callee relations, constructors, and third-party dependencies, and adds iterative test fixing when initial generations fail.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is conducted on Defects4J and four post-cutoff GitHub projects, against prior LLM-based test generation baselines, with gains in executability, semantic validity, and likely coverage or bug-triggering ability. The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes or exact margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Limerick, University of Ottawa, Zhejiang University, and Huawei, representing a software engineering and industrial code-intelligence collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 典型仓库级代码应用，方法是静态分析补 prompt，不会改变你对基座训练的 prior；若做 code agent，只看上下文构造和失败修复流程即可。
recommendation.en: This is a standard repo-level coding application—static analysis plus better prompts; it will not move your pretraining priors, but the context-construction pipeline may be worth skimming for code agents.

Despite evident progress, less attention has been paid to their effectiveness in handling declarative paradigms such as Answer Set Programming (ASP), to date. In this paper we introduce BLAST: The first dedicated benchmarking methodology and associated dataset for evaluating the accuracy of LLMs in generating ASP

However, the transition from informal natural language to precise formal specification remains an arduous task. Our work addresses this

We demonstrate that this approach dramatically underestimates bias in practice by examining a more realistic task: generating machine learning (ML) pipelines. Testing both code-specialized and general-instruction large language models, we find that generated pipelines exhibit significant bias dur

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成偏见评测仅使用简单条件语句，严重低估了真实场景下代码生成的偏见程度

paper.title: DryRUN: On the Role of Public Tests in LLM-Driven Code Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-agent frameworks are widely used in autonomous code generation and have applications in complex algorithmic problem-solving. Recent work has addressed the challenge of generating functionally correct code by incorporating simulation-driven planning and debugging, where language models trace execution steps to verify logic. However, these approaches depend on human-provided public test cases to ground the debugging and simulation loop. Manually authoring comprehensive input-output examples

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 驱动代码生成对公开测试用例的依赖，及其导致的过拟合与隐藏测试失效问题。
summary.importance: 这是代码生成评测与 agent 设定的反思性工作，贡献更像 benchmark hygiene 和 failure analysis，而不是新的训练或推理范式。
summary.technical_approach: 论文指出多 agent 代码生成框架常依赖人工提供的 public tests 做模拟、调试和规划；作者把这种依赖视为偏置信号来源，提出 DryRUN 视角来分析 public tests 带来的 overconfidence gap，并讨论外部采样或无测试条件下的替代路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型、数据集和量化结果，只明确声称 public tests 会让框架过拟合简单样例，在 hidden evaluation 上失败；需要正文确认实验设计是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 WSO2，主题集中在 LLM-driven code generation 的评测设定。

summary_en.core_problem: It examines the role of public test cases in LLM-driven code generation and how they induce overfitting and failure on hidden evaluations.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark-hygiene and failure-analysis paper for code-generation agents, rather than a new training or inference paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that many multi-agent code-generation frameworks rely on human-provided public tests for simulation, debugging, and planning; it frames this dependency as a source of bias, studies the resulting overconfidence gap, and discusses alternatives under missing-test conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete models, datasets, or effect sizes, but claims that reliance on public tests causes frameworks to overfit simple examples and fail on hidden evaluations; the cleanliness of the setup needs to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author affiliation is WSO2, and the work is centered on evaluation assumptions in LLM-driven code generation.

recommendation.zh: 结论方向大概率对，但像是把大家心里知道的问题系统化；若你做 code agent，只需看 hidden-test 失效分析是否做干净。
recommendation.en: The direction is probably right, but it mostly systematizes an already suspected issue; if you work on code agents, only inspect whether the hidden-test failure analysis is actually clean.

paper.title: Co-Located Tests, Better AI Code: How Test Syntax Structure Affects Foundation Model Code Generation
paper.abstract: AI coding assistants increasingly generate code alongside tests. How developers structure test code, whether inline with the implementation or in separate blocks, has traditionally been a matter of testing philosophy. We investigate whether this choice affects AI code generation quality.   We conduct a large-scale empirical study (830+ generated files, 12 models, 3 providers) using SEGA, a three-dimensional evaluation framework measuring Determinism, Preservation, and Correctness. Comparing inli

summary.core_problem: 研究测试代码的书写结构会不会系统性影响 foundation model 的代码生成质量。
summary.importance: 这是代码生成行为分析，不是预训练方法；但它触及一个对数据格式和上下文组织敏感的现象，对做代码数据配方或 repo-level training 的人有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较两种测试语法：与实现共置的 inline tests（Python doctest）和分离的 test blocks（Rust #[test]）。用 SEGA 框架从 Determinism、Preservation、Correctness 三维评估 12 个模型在 d-ary heap 实现任务上的输出差异，并尝试给出机制解释。
summary.experiments: 实验规模为 830+ 生成文件、12 个模型、3 家提供商。摘要称 inline tests 在 preservation 上接近 100%，correctness 为 92-100%；而 separated tests 下不同模型差异很大，correctness 从 0 到 100% 不等。任务较窄，外推到一般代码建模需谨慎。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Cosmic AI。未见明显顶级实验室背景；工作更像针对代码生成提示/上下文结构的经验研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether the syntactic structure of tests systematically affects foundation-model code generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a code-generation behavior study rather than a pretraining paper, but it does expose sensitivity to data formatting and context organization, which is mildly relevant for code data recipes and repo-level training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares co-located inline tests (Python doctests) against separated test blocks (Rust #[test]) and evaluates 12 models on a d-ary heap implementation task using the SEGA framework across determinism, preservation, and correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 830+ generated files, 12 models, and 3 providers. The abstract reports near-100% preservation and 92-100% correctness for inline tests, while separated tests produce wide model-tier gaps with correctness ranging from 0 to 100%. The task is narrow, so generalization to broader code modeling should be treated cautiously.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from Cosmic AI. There is no clear signal of a major frontier-lab team; the work reads as an empirical study of prompt/context structure in code generation.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座论文，但它提醒你代码模型对上下文排布很脆；只看实验表和机制猜想，别把单任务结果外推成 tokenizer 或 pretrain 结论。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but it is a useful reminder that code models are brittle to context layout; read the tables and mechanism hints, not as tokenizer or pretraining evidence.

paper.title: ChipCraftBrain: Validation-First RTL Generation via Multi-Agent Orchestration
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for generating Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code from natural language specifications, but single-shot generation achieves only 60-65% functional correctness on standard benchmarks. Multi-agent approaches such as MAGE reach 95.9% on VerilogEval yet remain untested on harder industrial benchmarks such as NVIDIA's CVDP, lack synthesis awareness, and incur high API costs.   We present ChipCraftBrain, a framework combining symbolic-neural reasoning with ada

summary.core_problem: 解决自然语言到 RTL 代码生成在工业级 benchmark 上功能正确率不足、验证成本高、单次生成不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 属于代码/工程 agent 方向，价值在于把验证优先、符号方法和多 agent 编排结合到硬件代码生成；对 LLM 预训练本身帮助有限，但对“程序生成需要外部验证闭环”这一点有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ChipCraftBrain：用 PPO 策略在六个专门 agent 间做自适应编排；把 K-map、truth-table 等可算法化子问题交给符号模块，波形时序和一般 RTL 交给专门 agent；再结合知识增强检索和验证优先流程，减少无效生成与 API 成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到对 VerilogEval 与更难的 NVIDIA CVDP 做评测，并与单次生成及 MAGE 类多 agent 方法比较；强调功能正确率、综合感知和成本，但摘要未给出完整数值与模型规模，结论需看正文表格确认 setup 是否干净。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the low functional correctness and high verification cost of natural-language-to-RTL generation, especially on harder industrial benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding/engineering-agent paper. Its value is in combining validation-first execution, symbolic subroutines, and multi-agent orchestration for hardware code generation; the direct payoff for pretraining is limited, but the external-verification loop is worth noting.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChipCraftBrain uses a PPO policy to orchestrate six specialized agents, routes algorithmic subproblems such as K-map and truth-table tasks to symbolic modules, and handles waveform timing and general RTL with specialized LLM agents, augmented by retrieval and validation-first control.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions evaluation on VerilogEval and the harder NVIDIA CVDP benchmark, comparing against single-shot generation and prior multi-agent systems such as MAGE. It emphasizes correctness, synthesis awareness, and API cost, but the exact setup and numbers need verification in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“能符号求解的子任务别让 LM 硬猜”这个设计是对的；只看系统分工和验证闭环，别把结果数字当强证据。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the design instinct is sound: do not force the LM to guess what can be solved symbolically; read the orchestration and validation loop, not the headline numbers.

paper.title: On the Quantization Robustness of Diffusion Language Models in Coding Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Auto-regressive Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on coding tasks, but incur high memory and inference costs. Diffusion-based language models (d-LLMs) offer bounded inference cost via iterative denoising, but their behavior under post-training quantization (PTQ) has been sparsely explored. We investigate the application and robustness of PTQ techniques, specifically GPTQ and a modified Hessian-Aware Quantization (HAWQ) algorithm, on a diffusion-based coding LLM (CoDA) and o

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问的是：扩散语言模型在低比特后训练量化下，是否比同规模自回归模型更稳，尤其是在代码任务上。问题看起来属于部署，但它背后其实牵到一个更基础的研究点：不同生成范式训练出来的参数分布、曲率结构和误差容忍度是否不同，进而影响量化可压缩性。作者选择 CoDA 1.7B 作为 diffusion LM，对比 Qwen3-1.7B 作为 AR 基线，在统一评测流水线下考察 GPTQ 和改造版 HAWQ 的效果。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，因为论文没有控制训练数据、训练目标、架构细节之外的全部混杂因素，也没有把“为什么 diffusion 更抗量化”追到训练动力学或权重统计层面。但它提供了一个有意思的经验信号：生成范式可能会改变模型对参数扰动的敏感性，尤其在 2-4 bit 这种激进量化区间。若这个现象在更严格控制下仍成立，它会反过来影响大家对非 AR 语言模型的训练目标、损失曲率、以及部署友好性的判断。贡献量级更像一篇探索性实证论文，而不是定论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上比较直接：作者把两类 PTQ 方法应用到 diffusion coding LM 和 AR coding LM 上，并尽量统一评测条件。

第一类是 GPTQ。它是典型的 weight-only PTQ，用校准集近似每层 Hessian 的逆，对分组权重按顺序量化，并在量化后更新剩余权重以补偿误差。文中使用 WikiText 作为 calibration dataset，group size 设为 128，量化位宽覆盖 2/3/4/8 bit。实现上还提到为了稳定激活统计，校准阶段关闭 fused attention kernel，改用 eager attention，并为两种模型加了适配 hook。

第二类是作者改造过的 HAWQ。原始 HAWQ 依赖 Hessian 特征值评估层敏感度，再做 sensitivity-aware 的混合精度分配，且常带逐层 finetune。作者明确说做了改造，原因之一是他们想聚焦 post-training setting，因此大概率去掉了需要额外训练的部分，保留“按二阶敏感度分配位宽”的核心思想。也就是说，这篇论文真正比较的不只是统一位宽量化，还包括混合精度量化在 diffusion LM 上是否更平滑地给出 accuracy-latency-memory 折中。

论文的技术价值不在提出新量化算法，而在于把 diffusion LM 纳入现有 PTQ 框架，并尝试控制评测变量。作者也比较谨慎，明确承认 CoDA 与 Qwen3 的训练数据和训练目标不同，因此结果不能被解读为“扩散范式天然更抗量化”的严格因果结论。这一点是加分项，因为很多类似工作会把范式差异和 checkpoint 差异混在一起下结论。
summary.experiments:
可从正文确认的实验设置包括：模型为 CoDA 1.7B 与 Qwen3-1.7B；量化方法为 GPTQ 与改造版 HAWQ；位宽测试 2、3、4、8 bit；校准集为 WikiText；group size 为 128；评测任务是 coding benchmarks，并且作者强调使用了统一的 evaluation pipeline。

核心结果层面，摘要和引言都给出一致结论：在他们的设置下，CoDA 在低比特区间，尤其 2-4 bit，性能下降小于 Qwen3-1.7B；同时混合精度 diffusion LM 在准确率、延迟、显存之间呈现更平滑的 Pareto 折中。也就是说，若目标是在极低显存预算下保住代码能力，diffusion LM 至少在这组模型上表现出更好的鲁棒性。

但当前提供的全文内容同样被截断在方法部分，没有看到完整结果表、具体 benchmark 名称、pass@k 或 accuracy 数值、延迟与显存测量口径，也没有看到层敏感度分析图。因此无法可靠给出“提升了多少点”“哪一档 bit 最优”这类精确数字。

如果拿到完整正文，最值得核对的实验点有四个：
- CoDA 与 Qwen3 的 tokenizer、参数分布、训练语料是否足够可比；
- 量化后推理延迟是否按相同 kernel 与 batch/prompt 条件测量；
- diffusion LM 的多步去噪是否在低 bit 下出现误差累积，还是反而因每步预测更冗余而更稳；
- HAWQ 分配出的高精度层是否集中在 embedding、attention out proj、还是 MLP up/down proj，这会帮助判断鲁棒性来自哪里。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不是量化公式，而是现象是否可信。建议先看 Experimental Setup，确认两模型的可比性边界；再看结果表和 Pareto 图，判断“更抗量化”到底是普遍现象还是只在某几个 benchmark/bitwidth 上成立。若有层敏感度或 Hessian 相关分析图，一定要看，那部分最接近机制解释。

推荐阅读顺序：
1. Introduction 里作者对混杂因素的限定；
2. GPTQ/HAWQ 实现细节，尤其 calibration 和 mixed precision 设定；
3. 主结果表：2/3/4/8 bit 下 CoDA 与 Qwen3 的对比；
4. latency-memory-accuracy Pareto 图；
5. 若有的话，看 per-layer sensitivity 或 error analysis。

预计 25-35 分钟可以读完主线。值得深挖的问题是：这种鲁棒性到底来自 diffusion 训练目标、权重谱更平滑、还是 CoDA checkpoint 本身更容易量化。没有更严格的 matched training setup，这个问题还不能下结论。
summary.authors_note: 当前提供的正文片段未包含作者与机构信息，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether diffusion language models are more robust than autoregressive models under aggressive post-training quantization, especially on coding tasks. This is a deployment-oriented question, but it also touches a deeper modeling issue: different generation paradigms may induce different weight distributions, curvature profiles, and tolerance to parameter perturbations. The study compares CoDA 1.7B, a diffusion coding LM, against Qwen3-1.7B, its autoregressive counterpart, under a shared evaluation pipeline using GPTQ and a modified HAWQ procedure.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining research is limited, because the comparison does not fully eliminate confounders such as training data and objective differences. Still, it offers a useful empirical signal: generation paradigm may affect quantization robustness, particularly in the 2-4 bit regime where perturbations are severe. If that pattern survives more controlled studies, it would matter for how people think about non-AR objectives, loss curvature, and deployment-friendliness of alternative language modeling paradigms. This is best read as an exploratory empirical paper, not a definitive causal claim.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is straightforward but useful. The authors apply two PTQ methods to both a diffusion coding LM and an autoregressive coding LM while trying to keep the evaluation pipeline aligned.

The first method is GPTQ, a standard weight-only PTQ approach. It uses a calibration set to approximate layerwise inverse Hessian information, quantizes weights groupwise, and compensates quantization error by updating the remaining weights. The paper uses WikiText for calibration, group size 128, and evaluates 2-, 3-, 4-, and 8-bit quantization. Implementation details matter here: fused attention kernels were disabled during calibration, eager attention was used for stable activation statistics, and custom hooks were added so GPTQ could handle the model inputs correctly.

The second method is a modified HAWQ-style approach. Original HAWQ uses second-order sensitivity to assign higher precision to more curvature-sensitive layers, often followed by layerwise finetuning. The authors explicitly state that they adapted HAWQ because they wanted to stay in a post-training setting, so the modified version likely keeps the sensitivity-based mixed-precision allocation while avoiding retraining-heavy components.

The paper’s technical contribution is not a new quantization algorithm. Its value lies in bringing diffusion LMs into a PTQ comparison framework and examining whether mixed-precision allocation behaves differently for diffusion-trained models. The authors are also careful not to overclaim: they note that CoDA and Qwen3 differ in training data and objective, so the results should be interpreted as suggestive evidence rather than proof that diffusion is inherently more quantization-robust.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided text confirms the main setup: CoDA 1.7B versus Qwen3-1.7B, GPTQ and modified HAWQ, bit widths 2/3/4/8, WikiText calibration, group size 128, and evaluation on coding benchmarks under a standardized pipeline.

The main reported finding is consistent across the abstract and introduction: in this setup, CoDA degrades less than Qwen3 at low bit widths, especially in the 2-4 bit range. The paper also claims that mixed-precision diffusion LMs yield smoother accuracy-latency-memory Pareto trade-offs. In practical terms, that suggests diffusion LMs may retain coding ability better under tight memory budgets.

However, the full experimental section is not included in the provided content. There are no benchmark names, no exact pass@k or accuracy values, no latency tables, and no detailed ablations visible in the excerpt. So it is not possible to report precise numbers responsibly.

If reading the full paper, the most important checks are:
- whether CoDA and Qwen3 are comparable enough in tokenizer, architecture details, and training data,
- whether latency and memory are measured under matched kernels and prompt settings,
- whether diffusion denoising accumulates quantization error across steps or instead benefits from redundancy,
- and which layers receive higher precision under HAWQ, since that could reveal where robustness actually comes from.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. The main question is not how GPTQ works, but whether the reported robustness pattern is credible. Start with the experimental setup and the authors’ caveats about confounders. Then go straight to the main result tables and Pareto plots. If the paper includes layer sensitivity or Hessian-based analysis, that is the most informative part because it gets closest to mechanism.

Suggested reading order:
1. the framing and caveats in the introduction,
2. implementation details for GPTQ and modified HAWQ,
3. the main comparison across 2/3/4/8 bits,
4. latency-memory-accuracy Pareto plots,
5. any per-layer sensitivity or error analysis.

Roughly 25-35 minutes should be enough for the main story. The key open question is whether the robustness comes from the diffusion objective itself, smoother weight geometry, or simply checkpoint-specific differences. Without a more tightly matched training setup, that remains unresolved.

recommendation.zh: 非常有趣的发现：Diffusion LM 在低比特量化下比 AR 模型更鲁棒。这为 Diffusion LM 的实际部署提供了一个重要优势，建议关注其量化实验的对比设置（§4）。
recommendation.en: Intriguing finding: Diffusion LMs are more robust to low-bit quantization than AR models. This provides a significant advantage for deploying Diffusion LMs; the comparative setup in the quantization experiments (§4) is worth skimming.

paper.title: SolidCoder: Bridging the Mental-Reality Gap in LLM Code Generation through Concrete Execution
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art code generation frameworks rely on mental simulation, where LLMs internally trace execution to verify correctness. We expose a fundamental limitation: the Mental-Reality Gap -- where models hallucinate execution traces and confidently validate buggy code. This gap manifests along two orthogonal dimensions: the Specification Gap (overlooking edge cases during planning) and the Verification Gap (hallucinating correct behavior for flawed code). We propose SolidCoder with a simple p

summary.core_problem: 现有基于心理模拟的代码生成多Agent框架存在心理-现实落差，具体分为规划阶段忽略边界用例的规范落差，和验证阶段幻觉执行轨迹的验证落差，导致错误生成的代码仍被判定为正确。
summary.importance: 为预训练阶段的代码能力对齐提供新思路，验证了基于属性的断言可替代真值Oracle做正确性校验，无需依赖标注测试用例，可用于代码SFT/RL的数据合成流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出S.O.L.I.D.多Agent架构，左移规划阶段先枚举边界用例再做算法设计，解决规范落差；用沙箱真实执行替代心理模拟，结合基于属性的断言做正确性验证，解决验证落差；中间模拟作为低成本预筛选，防御式积累防止迭代过程中能力回退。
summary.experiments: 基于GPT-4o在HumanEval上pass@1达95.7%，较基线高0.6个百分点；CodeContests上达77.0%，高4.3个百分点；APPS上达26.7%，高3.4个百分点。消融实验显示去掉左移规划性能下降23.7个百分点，去掉真实执行下降7.9个百分点，两者结合性能优于单独使用任意模块。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章架构设计和第4章消融实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟，无需深究实现细节，重点理解属性断言替代真值测试用例的逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent code generation frameworks relying on mental simulation suffer from the Mental-Reality Gap, which includes two independent dimensions: the Specification Gap (overlooking edge cases during planning) and the Verification Gap (hallucinating execution traces during validation), leading to incorrect code being falsely marked as valid.
summary_en.importance: The property-based verification mechanism provides a new direction for code capability alignment in pre-training and post-training stages, as it enables correctness validation without ground-truth test cases, which can be integrated into data synthesis pipelines for code SFT and RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: The S.O.L.I.D. multi-agent framework is proposed. Shift-left planning forces edge case enumeration before algorithm design to close the Specification Gap. Sandboxed live execution replaces imagined mental simulation, paired with property-based oracles for correctness check to close the Verification Gap. Intermediate simulation acts as a low-cost pre-filter, and defensive accumulation prevents performance regression during iterative refinement.
summary_en.experiments: With GPT-4o as the base model, SolidCoder achieves 95.7% pass@1 on HumanEval (+0.6pp over baseline), 77.0% on CodeContests (+4.3pp), and 26.7% on APPS (+3.4pp). Ablation shows removing shift-left planning leads to a 23.7pp performance drop, removing live execution leads to a 7.9pp drop, and the full system outperforms either single module.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (architecture design) and Section 4 (ablation results). Estimated reading time is 15 minutes. No need to dive into implementation details, just understand the logic of using property assertions instead of ground-truth test cases.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座论文，但把 code failure 拆成 specification/verification 两个 gap 这点讲得清楚；先看消融，别急着信 headline 分数。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but the specification-vs-verification split is a clean lens for coding failures; read the ablations first and don’t over-trust the headline scores.

paper.title: Coding with Eyes: Visual Feedback Unlocks Reliable GUI Code Generating and Debugging
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have shown remarkable progress in code generation. However, current agent methods mainly rely on text-output-based feedback (e.g. command-line outputs) for multi-round debugging and struggle in graphical user interface (GUI) that involve visual information. This is mainly due to two limitations: 1) GUI programs are event-driven, yet existing methods cannot simulate user interactions to trigger GUI element logic 2) GUI programs possess vi

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI 代码生成与调试中，纯文本反馈无法覆盖事件驱动逻辑和视觉布局正确性的难题。
summary.importance: 主要价值在 benchmark 和 agent 反馈回路设计：把视觉反馈引入 GUI coding/debugging。对基座预训练没有直接方法论推进，但对多模态 agent 的评测和闭环调试有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 InteractGUI Bench，覆盖 984 个真实桌面 GUI 任务；同时提出 VF-Coder，多智能体系统通过视觉感知界面状态、模拟交互触发事件逻辑，并基于渲染结果做多轮调试。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调 benchmark 规模和真实任务设置，但未给出所用基础模型、与哪些 coding agent 基线比较、以及具体提升幅度；从定位看，benchmark 可能比方法本身更值得看。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自深圳先进技术相关研究机构和电子科技大学，属于学术界的 GUI coding agent 工作，不是顶级实验室的基座研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets GUI code generation and debugging, where text-only feedback fails to capture event-driven logic and visual layout correctness.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is in benchmark design and feedback-loop engineering: bringing visual feedback into GUI coding/debugging. It does not directly advance foundation-model pretraining, but it is somewhat relevant for multimodal agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces InteractGUI Bench with 984 real-world desktop GUI tasks, and proposes VF-Coder, a multi-agent system that perceives rendered interfaces, simulates user interactions, and debugs code using visual feedback over multiple rounds.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights benchmark scale and realism, but does not specify the underlying models, coding-agent baselines, or effect sizes. The benchmark is likely more useful than the method itself.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shenzhen-based research institutes and UESTC. This is an academic GUI coding-agent paper rather than a foundation-model study from a top lab.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态 agent 评测，可以只看 benchmark 设计；方法本身更像把视觉闭环补上，对基座训练启发有限。
recommendation.en: If you care about multimodal agent evaluation, read the benchmark design; the method is mostly a visual feedback patch, with limited implications for foundation training.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

paper.title: CreativeGame:Toward Mechanic-Aware Creative Game Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models can generate plausible game code, but turning this capability into \emph{iterative creative improvement} remains difficult. In practice, single-shot generation often produces brittle runtime behavior, weak accumulation of experience across versions, and creativity scores that are too subjective to serve as reliable optimization signals. A further limitation is that mechanics are frequently treated only as post-hoc descriptions, rather than as explicit objects that can be pl

summary.core_problem: 如何解决 LLM 在生成游戏代码时难以进行迭代式创意改进，以及游戏机制常被视为事后描述而非可规划对象的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一个用于迭代式 HTML5 游戏生成的多智能体系统，尝试将游戏机制显式化为可规划和评估的对象，为复杂代码生成任务提供了一种新的系统级解决方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CreativeGame 多智能体系统，包含四个核心思想：1) 基于程序化信号而非纯 LLM 判断的代理奖励；2) 用于跨版本经验积累的谱系范围记忆；3) 集成到修复和奖励中的运行时验证；4) 机制引导的规划循环，将检索到的机制知识作为显式对象进行处理。
summary.experiments: 针对 HTML5 游戏生成任务，但摘要未提供具体的量化评估指标或 Baseline 对比结果。
summary.authors_note: University of Bristol, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shandong University, Nanjing University, Sreal AI

summary_en.core_problem: How to overcome the difficulty of iterative creative improvement in LLM game code generation, where mechanics are often treated as post-hoc descriptions rather than plannable objects?
summary_en.importance: Introduces a multi-agent system for iterative HTML5 game generation that explicitly treats game mechanics as plannable and evaluable objects, offering a novel system-level approach for complex code generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CreativeGame, a multi-agent system featuring: 1) proxy rewards based on programmatic signals rather than pure LLM judgment; 2) lineage-scoped memory for cross-version experience; 3) runtime validation integrated into repair and reward; 4) a mechanic-guided planning loop.
summary_en.experiments: Targeted at HTML5 game generation, though the abstract lacks specific quantitative metrics or baseline comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Bristol, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shandong University, Nanjing University, Sreal AI

recommendation.zh: 一个针对游戏代码生成的多 Agent 系统，引入了程序化奖励和机制引导规划，属于特定领域的复杂代码生成应用，对通用预训练启发有限。
recommendation.en: A multi-agent system for game code generation using programmatic rewards and mechanic-guided planning; a domain-specific complex code generation application with limited inspiration for general pretraining.

institutions: Institutions: University of Bristol · Shanghai Jiao Tong University ·
Shandong University · Nanjing University · Sreal AI

paper.title: Majority Voting for Code Generation
paper.abstract: We investigate Functional Majority Voting (FMV), a method based on functional consensus for code generation with Large Language Models, which identifies a representative solution from multiple generations using their runtime execution signatures on test inputs. We find that FMV is an effective test-time inference strategy, substantially boosting performance on LiveCodeBench without a large compute overhead. Furthermore, we extend the utility of functional consensus and apply it as an aggregation

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成的多数投票策略仅匹配文本语义，未验证功能正确性，且测试时强化学习的自改进边界不清晰
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将功能共识引入代码生成多数投票，明确了测试时强化学习的性能上限
summary.technical_approach: 提出功能多数投票（FMV），通过测试输入的运行时执行签名从多代理解中选代表性方案，进一步将功能共识作为无标签测试时RL的聚合策略
summary.experiments: 在LiveCodeBench上无大幅计算开销的前提下显著提升性能，测试时RL可提升holdout任务pass@1，但无证据表明能突破基模性能天花板
summary.authors_note: ETH Zurich Andreas Krause团队，该团队长期从事机器学习理论与可信AI研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing majority voting strategies for code generation only match text semantics without verifying functional correctness, and the self-improvement boundary of test-time reinforcement learning is unclear
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first introduces functional consensus into code generation majority voting, and clarifies the performance upper limit of test-time reinforcement learning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Functional Majority Voting (FMV), which selects representative solutions from multiple generations via runtime execution signatures on test inputs, and further extends functional consensus as an aggregation strategy for label-free test-time RL
summary_en.experiments: Significantly improves performance on LiveCodeBench without large compute overhead, test-time RL boosts pass@1 on holdout tasks, but no evidence shows it can break the base model's performance ceiling
summary_en.authors_note: Andreas Krause Group, ETH Zurich, long-term research on machine learning theory and trustworthy AI

recommendation.zh: 代码生成测试时增强的增量工作，仅看实验结论部分即可，无需复现
recommendation.en: Incremental test-time augmentation work for code generation, only review experiment conclusions, no need for reproduction

paper.title: How Many Tries Does It Take? Iterative Self-Repair in LLM Code Generation Across Model Scales and Benchmarks

summary.core_problem: 代码生成基准通常用 pass@1（一次生成）评估，但真实编程是“写—跑—看报错—修复”的多轮迭代过程。本文系统研究迭代式 self-repair：模型先生成代码，运行测试，若失败则把错误类型与 traceback 反馈给模型让其修复，重复多轮。核心问题是：在当代（2024–2025）不同规模、不同架构（dense vs MoE）、不同提供方（开源/闭源）的模型上，self-repair 是否普遍有效？收益集中在第几轮？哪些错误更容易修？以及与“独立重采样多次”相比是否更 token-efficient？
summary.importance: 这项工作把“单次生成评测”拉回到更贴近工程实践的迭代范式，并用跨模型、跨基准的大规模对比更新了早期结论（弱模型可能越修越错）。对部署侧价值很直接：给出修复轮数的边际收益曲线、错误类型与修复成功率的关联、以及 self-repair vs resampling 的效率权衡，可用于设计更省 token、更高成功率的代码代理/IDE 助手流水线。
summary.technical_approach:
（must_read 级别：详细技术分析）
1) 迭代 self-repair 协议：
- 第0轮 R0：给定题目（函数签名+docstring），模型生成代码 c0。
- 执行：把代码与测试用例拼接，在沙箱 Python 环境运行。
- 若失败：捕获错误类型与 traceback e0，构造修复提示词：原题 + 上一版代码 + 错误信息，要求模型输出修复版 ci。
- 最多 5 次尝试（R0–R4），任一轮通过即停止。
2) 评测设置：
- 模型：7个，覆盖 Llama 3.1 8B、Llama 3.3 70B、Llama 4 Scout（MoE 16 experts）、Llama 4 Maverick（MoE 128 experts）、Qwen3 32B、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Gemini 2.5 Pro。
- 基准：HumanEval（164）与 MBPP Sanitized（257）。
- 解码：greedy（temperature=0）确保可复现。
3) 关键分析维度：
- 多轮 pass rate 提升曲线与“收益递减”：量化每一轮新增解决比例，并给出“前两轮覆盖 76–95% 可获得收益”的部署建议。
- 错误类型分解：不同错误（如 NameError、AssertionError 等）修复成功率差异显著，错误类别可作为是否继续修复/是否改用重采样的决策信号。
- dense vs MoE：比较 MoE（Scout/Maverick）与 dense（Llama/Qwen）在修复增益上的差异，讨论交互模式。
- 提示词消融：minimal vs explain-then-fix vs CoT；发现对 70B 模型 CoT 带来额外 +5.5pp 修复增益。
- token 效率：与“独立多次重采样”对比，放在 exploration-exploitation 框架下讨论何时 self-repair 更划算。
（skim 级别：方法概述）
用统一的‘生成-执行-报错反馈-再生成’循环，在 HumanEval/MBPP 上对 7 个模型做最多 5 轮尝试；报告总体提升、收益递减、错误类型可修复性、MoE vs dense 差异、提示词策略与 token 效率。
summary.experiments:
主要结果（来自摘要/引言给出的数值）：
- self-repair 对所有模型都提升：HumanEval +4.9 到 +17.1 个百分点；MBPP +16.0 到 +30.0 个百分点。
- 最终最好：Gemini 2.5 Flash 达到 96.3%（HumanEval）与 93.8%（MBPP）。
- 收益集中在前几轮：两轮修复覆盖 76–95% 的可获得增益。
- 错误类型影响显著：NameError 修复成功率约 77%，AssertionError 约 45%。
- 提示词消融：对 70B，CoT 相对 minimal 额外带来 +5.5pp 修复增益。
- 还包含 dense vs MoE 的对比观察：例如 HumanEval 上 Scout（16 experts）在开源模型里修复增益最高（+14.0pp）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：重点章节/图表/创新点）
- 重点章节：
  1) Methodology：修复 prompt 的构造、停止条件、执行沙箱与代码抽取（去除 CoT、处理 markdown fence、函数补全等）决定结果可信度与可复现性。
  2) 主结果曲线：每轮 pass rate（R0→R4）与边际增益，尤其是“前两轮覆盖大部分收益”的定量依据。
  3) 错误类型分析：错误分类口径、各类错误的修复成功率、以及由此导出的策略含义（例如某些错误更适合重采样而非修复）。
  4) dense vs MoE 对比：关注 Scout vs Maverick 的差异是否来自专家数、路由、还是仅仅模型能力差异。
  5) Prompt ablation：minimal / explain-then-fix / CoT 的具体模板与控制变量。
  6) token 效率对比：与 independent resampling 的公平性（相同 token 预算/相同尝试次数）与结论边界。
- 重点图表（按内容）：
  1) 各模型在两基准上的“轮数-通过率”曲线。
  2) 边际收益递减图（每轮新增解决比例）。
  3) 错误类型→修复成功率柱状图。
  4) self-repair vs resampling 的 token-效率对比图。
- 创新点抓手：
  1) 面向现代模型的大规模、跨家族 self-repair 系统评测。
  2) 首批系统比较 dense 与 MoE 在 self-repair 动态上的差异。
  3) 把“错误类型”提升为可操作的预测信号，并给出轮数/成本的部署指南。

skim（泛读建议：推荐看哪些部分）
- 直接看摘要 + Introduction 的贡献点。
- 只看主结果表/图：两基准的最终通过率与每轮增益。
- 快速扫错误类型分析结论（NameError vs AssertionError）。
- 看结论/建议：推荐修复轮数（2轮）与何时用 self-repair/何时用重采样。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调：在新一代指令微调模型与 MoE 架构普及后，self-repair 已从“可能伤害弱模型”的不稳定技巧，变成跨规模普遍有效的工程策略；但收益强烈递减，且受错误类型制约。因此应把 self-repair 作为可预算、可早停、可按错误类型路由的组件，而不是无脑多轮迭代。

summary_en.core_problem: Code-generation benchmarks typically report pass@1 (single-shot), but real programming is iterative: write, run, read errors, and fix. This paper systematically studies iterative self-repair: generate code, execute tests, feed back the error/traceback, and ask the LLM to repair for multiple rounds. It asks whether self-repair is now universally effective across modern model scales and architectures (dense vs MoE), how many rounds are worth it, which error types are most repairable, and how self-repair compares to independent resampling under token budgets.
summary_en.importance: It updates earlier mixed findings by evaluating a new generation of 2024–2025 models, and provides deployment-relevant guidance: diminishing-returns curves, error-type predictors of repair success, and token-efficiency tradeoffs versus resampling. This directly informs how to build practical coding agents/IDE assistants that are both accurate and cost-efficient.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(must_read: detailed technical analysis)
1) Iterative protocol:
- Round R0: model generates initial code c0 from the problem.
- Execute in a sandbox with the benchmark tests.
- On failure: capture error type + traceback e0; build a repair prompt containing the original spec, previous code, and the error message; generate a revised solution ci.
- Repeat up to R4 (5 total attempts), stopping early upon success.
2) Evaluation setup:
- 7 models across families/providers: Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 4 Scout (MoE 16 experts), Llama 4 Maverick (MoE 128 experts), Qwen3 32B, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro.
- Benchmarks: HumanEval (164) and MBPP Sanitized (257).
- Greedy decoding (temperature=0) for reproducibility.
3) Analyses:
- Pass-rate improvements over rounds and diminishing returns; derive the practical rule that two repair rounds capture most gains.
- Error-type breakdown (e.g., NameError vs AssertionError) as a strong predictor of repair success.
- Dense vs MoE comparison of repair dynamics.
- Repair-prompt ablations (minimal vs explain-then-fix vs CoT), showing CoT improves repair gains for a 70B model.
- Token-efficiency comparison against independent resampling within an exploration–exploitation framing.
(skim: method overview)
Run a standardized generate–execute–repair loop for up to 5 attempts on HumanEval/MBPP across 7 models; report overall gains, diminishing returns, error-type repairability, dense vs MoE differences, prompt ablations, and token efficiency vs resampling.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported results (from the provided abstract/introduction):
- Self-repair improves all models: +4.9 to +17.1 pp on HumanEval; +16.0 to +30.0 pp on MBPP.
- Best final performance: Gemini 2.5 Flash reaches 96.3% (HumanEval) and 93.8% (MBPP).
- Diminishing returns: two repair rounds capture 76–95% of achievable gains.
- Error-type effect: Name errors repaired at ~77%, assertion errors at ~45%.
- Prompt ablation: CoT yields +5.5 pp additional repair gain over minimal prompting for the 70B model.
- Dense vs MoE: e.g., on HumanEval, Scout (16 experts) shows the largest repair gain among open-weight models (+14.0 pp).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep reading)
- Focus sections:
  1) Methodology: exact repair prompt construction, stopping criteria, sandbox execution, and code-extraction pipeline (removing CoT tags, handling markdown fences, function completion). These details determine validity.
  2) Main results: per-round pass-rate curves and marginal gains; verify the quantitative basis for the “2 rounds is enough” guideline.
  3) Error-type analysis: taxonomy, success rates, and how it supports routing/early-stop strategies.
  4) Dense vs MoE comparison: interpret Scout vs Maverick and control for overall capability.
  5) Prompt ablations: templates and controlled variables.
  6) Token-efficiency vs resampling: ensure fairness under comparable budgets.
- Priority figures/tables:
  1) Pass rate vs repair round for each model on both benchmarks.
  2) Marginal gain (diminishing returns) plot.
  3) Error-type vs repair-success bar chart.
  4) Token-efficiency comparison vs independent resampling.
- Main contributions to track:
  1) Modern, cross-family self-repair evaluation.
  2) Systematic dense vs MoE comparison for repair.
  3) Actionable deployment guidance based on diminishing returns and error types.

skim (broad reading)
- Read abstract + contribution bullets in the introduction.
- Look at the main result tables/plots (final pass rates and per-round gains).
- Skim the error-type takeaway (NameError vs AssertionError).
- Jump to the practical recommendations (recommended number of rounds; when to prefer self-repair vs resampling).
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s stance is that with modern instruction-tuned models (including MoE), prompt-based self-repair has become broadly effective—even at smaller scales—but it exhibits strong diminishing returns and is constrained by error type. Therefore, self-repair should be deployed as a budgeted, early-stoppable, and error-aware component rather than an unbounded iterative loop.

recommendation.zh: 看边际收益曲线和与重采样的 token 效率对比就够：能直接指导上线时修复轮数/何时停，但注意不同基准下结论波动，别当通用定律。
recommendation.en: Just read the marginal-gain-by-iteration plots and the token-efficiency vs resampling comparison: it’s actionable for choosing repair rounds/stop rules, but treat cross-benchmark variance as a warning.

paper.title: SLM Finetuning for Natural Language to Domain Specific Code Generation in Production

summary.core_problem: 在生产环境做“自然语言→领域特定语言（DSL）代码生成”时，LLM+RAG 虽然效果好，但检索与长上下文带来显著推理延迟与系统复杂度；而小语言模型（SLM）推理快、部署轻，但知识与推理能力不足，容易输出脆弱、幻觉、对提示敏感。论文要解决的是：如何用可部署、低延迟的 SLM 在生产中稳定生成结构化 DSL，并尽量减少对运行时长上下文与检索的依赖。
summary.importance: 大量企业级场景（工作流自动化、API 编排等）对延迟、成本、隐私/安全与可运维性要求极高。RAG+大模型会引入外部文档库维护、检索质量波动、长上下文 prefill 延迟等工程负担。若能用微调后的 SLM 在保持质量的同时显著降低延迟与架构复杂度，将更适合大规模在线产品落地。
summary.technical_approach:
论文主张用参数高效微调（PEFT）将领域知识“写入权重”，以减少运行时上下文：
- 选用数十亿参数级 SLM，通过 LoRA/QLoRA 等 PEFT 在不全量训练的情况下进行领域适配，提升 NL→DSL 生成的准确性与一致性。
- 与 RAG 方案对比：RAG 适合知识动态/广覆盖，但需要检索组件与更长上下文；微调 SLM 则通过缩短 prompt/context 来降低 prefill 延迟，并简化系统。
- 任务场景是低代码工作流平台的 DSL：用函数式 API 调用表达步骤编排、条件逻辑与嵌套调用；论文强调真实 API 生态的规模、命名不一致与条件/嵌套结构是生成难点。
（注：在当前截断内容中，关于数据构造、训练细节、验证检查点/结构化提示等“具体配方”尚未完整展开。）
summary.experiments: 从提供的片段可知作者以生产系统为背景，基线是 GPT-4 + RAG 的 NL→DSL 生成，并指出其在检索与长上下文上带来不适合低延迟场景的开销，同时在条件逻辑与嵌套 API 使用上存在不一致/错误。关于微调 SLM 的定量指标（准确率、语法/语义通过率、延迟、成本、线上 A/B 等）在当前截断内容中未给出具体数值与表格。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 精读 Introduction 中对“生产约束”的拆解：延迟来源（检索+长上下文 prefill）、运维复杂度（外部文档库/检索质量）、以及 SLM 的固有限制（知识/推理/上下文）。
- 重点关注方法章节（若正文后续展开）：(1) 训练数据如何从真实工作流/日志/模板构造与清洗；(2) DSL 的语法约束与语义约束如何在训练或解码时注入；(3) LoRA/QLoRA 的具体插入层、rank、训练超参；(4) 结构化 prompt 与“实时验证检查点（validation checkpoints）”如何设计以减少幻觉。
- 精读实验章节（若有）：至少要看离线质量指标（语法可解析率、执行成功率、字段/参数匹配）、鲁棒性（条件/嵌套）、以及端到端延迟拆分（prefill vs decode）和成本。

skim（泛读）：
- 读 Introduction 抓住结论：RAG+LLM 在生产延迟上吃亏；微调 SLM 通过把领域知识内化来减少上下文。
- 快速看任务示例（NL→DSL flow）理解 DSL 结构与难点。
- 若时间有限，优先扫实验结论与延迟/成本对比图表（如果正文提供）。
summary.authors_note: 作者从工程落地视角强调：在稳定领域边界的 DSL 生成任务上，与其依赖 RAG 在运行时“搬知识”，不如用 PEFT 把知识固化到 SLM 权重中，以换取更低延迟、更简单架构与更可控的生产部署；RAG 仍适合知识频繁变化或覆盖面极广的场景。

summary_en.core_problem: In production NL-to-DSL code generation, LLM+RAG can be accurate but often violates strict latency requirements due to retrieval overhead and long-context prefill. Small language models (SLMs) are faster and easier to deploy, but tend to be brittle, hallucinate more, and struggle with reasoning and long context. The paper addresses how to make SLMs reliably generate structured domain-specific code in production while reducing dependence on runtime retrieval and large prompts.
summary_en.importance: Enterprise workflow automation and API orchestration are latency-, cost-, privacy-, and operability-sensitive. RAG introduces external stores to maintain, retrieval-quality variance, and longer contexts that increase prefill latency. If a fine-tuned SLM can deliver acceptable quality with much lower latency and simpler architecture, it is a strong path for scalable real-world deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper advocates parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) to embed domain knowledge into SLM weights:
- Use LoRA/QLoRA-style PEFT on a few-billion-parameter SLM to improve NL→DSL accuracy and consistency without full retraining.
- Contrast with RAG: RAG is useful for dynamic/broad knowledge but adds retrieval components and longer contexts; fine-tuning reduces required context per request, lowering prefill latency and simplifying the system.
- The target DSL represents workflow automation as sequences of API-call functions with conditional logic and nesting; the paper highlights real-world challenges like API scale, naming inconsistency, and complex control structures.
(Note: the provided excerpt is truncated before many concrete “recipe” details such as dataset construction, training specifics, and validation checkpoints.)
summary_en.experiments: From the excerpt, the production baseline is a GPT-4 RAG pipeline for NL→DSL. The authors report practical issues: latency overhead from retrieval/long context and inconsistent/incorrect handling of conditional logic and nested API usage. Quantitative results (accuracy, parse/execution success, latency/cost numbers, online metrics) are not visible in the provided truncated content.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- In the Introduction, focus on the decomposition of production constraints: where latency comes from (retrieval + long-context prefill), operational complexity (external stores, retrieval quality), and inherent SLM limitations (knowledge, reasoning, context).
- In the methods section (if present later), prioritize: (1) how training data is collected/cleaned from real workflows; (2) how DSL syntax/semantic constraints are enforced during training/decoding; (3) LoRA/QLoRA configuration (layers, rank, hyperparameters); (4) structured prompting and any “real-time validation checkpoints” used to reduce hallucinations.
- In experiments (if present), look for: parseability/executability metrics, robustness on conditionals/nesting, and an end-to-end latency breakdown (prefill vs decode) plus cost.

skim (high level):
- Read the Introduction for the main thesis: RAG+LLM is latency-heavy; fine-tuned SLM reduces context and simplifies deployment.
- Skim the NL→DSL example to understand the DSL structure.
- If time is limited, jump to the results and any latency/cost comparison tables/figures (if provided).
summary_en.authors_note: From an engineering standpoint, the authors argue that for DSL generation with stable domain boundaries, PEFT-tuned SLMs can replace RAG-heavy LLM systems by internalizing domain knowledge into weights, reducing runtime context and latency while simplifying architecture; RAG remains preferable when knowledge is highly dynamic or extremely broad.

recommendation.zh: 当工程经验贴看：关注数据构造/约束输出格式/线上稳定性手段，能帮你判断“SLM 微调替代 RAG”是否划算；算法新意不多别深读。
recommendation.en: Read it as a production note: focus on data recipe, output-constraint tricks, and stability measures to decide if an SLM finetune can replace RAG; little algorithmic novelty.

paper.title: QuanBench+: A Unified Multi-Framework Benchmark for LLM-Based Quantum Code Generation
paper.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet quantum code generation is still evaluated mostly within single frameworks, making it difficult to separate quantum reasoning from framework familiarity. We introduce QuanBench+, a unified benchmark spanning Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq, with 42 aligned tasks covering quantum algorithms, gate decomposition, and state preparation.
  We evaluate models with executable functional tests, report Pass@1 and Pass@5, and use KL-d

summary.core_problem: 评估LLM在量子代码生成上的跨框架能力，现有基准局限于单一框架无法区分量子推理与框架熟悉度。
summary.importance: 提供跨Qiskit/PennyLane/Cirq的统一量子代码benchmark，填补小众领域评测空白，但对通用LLM研究启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 构建42个对齐任务，用可执行功能测试、Pass@1/5和KL散度评估概率输出；并测试反馈修复后的提升。
summary.experiments: 最佳单轮Qiskit 59.5%、Cirq 54.8%、PennyLane 42.9%；带反馈修复后提升至83.3/76.2/66.7%。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluate LLM quantum code generation across frameworks, as single-framework benchmarks conflate quantum reasoning with framework familiarity.
summary_en.importance: Fills a niche multi-framework benchmark gap but has limited bearing on general LLM pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: 42 aligned tasks with executable functional tests, Pass@1/5, KL-divergence acceptance for probabilistic outputs, plus feedback-based repair evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: Best one-shot Pass@1 of 59.5/54.8/42.9% on Qiskit/Cirq/PennyLane; feedback repair raises to 83.3/76.2/66.7%.

recommendation.zh: 小众领域benchmark，方法上没有新意，反馈修复提升20+点的幅度倒是可作为code repair范式的旁证，但仅此而已，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Niche benchmark with no methodological novelty; the +20pt repair gain is a mild data point for feedback-loop code generation, otherwise skip.

paper.title: QuanBench+: A Unified Multi-Framework Benchmark for LLM-Based Quantum Code Generation

summary.core_problem: 如何在不同量子编程框架之间统一评测LLM的量子代码生成能力，从而区分“量子推理能力”与“框架熟悉度”。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：提供跨Qiskit/PennyLane/Cirq的对齐任务与可执行测试，补齐量子代码生成评测的可比性；并引入反馈修复设置，贴近coding agent的迭代调试流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出QuanBench+：42个跨框架对齐任务（量子算法、门分解、态制备等）；用可执行功能测试评估Pass@1/Pass@5；对概率输出用KL散度式接受准则；增加“运行时报错/答案错误后允许模型基于反馈修复”的评测协议。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三框架：Qiskit/Cirq/PennyLane；最佳one-shot分别达59.5%/54.8%/42.9% Pass@1；加入反馈修复后提升到83.3%/76.2%/66.7%。摘要未披露参评模型清单与规模细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate LLM-based quantum code generation consistently across different quantum programming frameworks, disentangling quantum reasoning from framework-specific familiarity.
summary_en.importance: Provides a unified, cross-framework benchmark with executable tests spanning Qiskit, Cirq, and PennyLane, improving comparability in quantum code-generation evaluation. Adds a feedback-based repair setting that better reflects iterative debugging in coding-agent workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces QuanBench+ with 42 aligned tasks across frameworks (e.g., quantum algorithms, gate decompositions, state preparation). Uses executable functional tests to compute Pass@1/Pass@5; handles probabilistic outputs with a KL-divergence-style acceptance criterion; and defines a protocol where models can revise solutions after runtime errors or incorrect outputs using feedback.
summary_en.experiments: Reports best one-shot Pass@1 of 59.5% (Qiskit), 54.8% (Cirq), and 42.9% (PennyLane), improving to 83.3%/76.2%/66.7% with feedback-based repair; the abstract does not enumerate all evaluated models or their sizes.

recommendation.zh: 主要价值是把量子代码评测做成可执行、跨框架可比；当作基准目录备查即可，不太改预训练侧的 prior。
recommendation.en: Useful as a cross-framework, executable benchmark catalog; doesn’t really shift pretraining priors, so keep it as a reference rather than a deep read.
